priority_groups.title: 客户、代表、有关连者与拥有人分清
priority_groups.reason: 先会判断谁是客户、谁代表客户、谁拥有或控制谁；合伙／信托有关连者、身份重叠、BO 与最终拥有人分开，不能只记25%。

priority_groups.title: 内部职责及中介责任边界
priority_groups.reason: 补前政治人物停止加强尽调的高层批准；不能把持续监察责任交给中介；一并补CO支持高层及高层资源保障。

priority_groups.title: 电汇各机构的职责区别
priority_groups.reason: 补无账户时及非电汇的汇款人身份、中介／收款机构缺失资料责任、同一MSO控制两端时向每个受影响地区报告；一并核对完整筛查主体。

priority_groups.title: 重要定义的遗漏范围
priority_groups.reason: 补恐怖分子财产的两条定义路径、通风报讯的主观条件、接收境外款项也属汇款服务、主业附带兑换例外；按已定来源差异分别表述。

priority_groups.title: 指引的法律作用
priority_groups.reason: 区别不遵指引本身是否自动构罪，与法院及有关当局仍须考虑指引；和总体审核B15合并。

priority_groups.title: 机关具体权限及监管对象
priority_groups.reason: 区分联合国指定、行政长官刊宪／向法院申请／订规例、保安局局长冻结及特许解冻；补邮政署长受AMLO约束及其有关当局。

priority_groups.title: 国际组织及政治人物的定义条件
priority_groups.reason: 补国际组织以正式政治协议及条约地位设立的条件，以政治人物判定为应用情境；已有家属／关系密切者题作为复习基础。

priority_groups.title: 证明人、见证人及面见代表

points: 政府间组织；制定国际标准并推动法律/监管/操作措施有效实施
通过司法管辖区评估及严格跟进监察遵从，识别高风险及受监察地区

tested.point: 性质、标准、评估跟进、反制及香港义务

snapshot.en: Formed in 1989, the FATF is an inter-governmental body whose objectives are to set standards and promote effective implementation of measures for combating ML, TF and PF.
snapshot.tc: 在1989年成立的特別組織屬跨政府組織，宗旨是制訂標準及推動有效執行打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的措施。

snapshot.en: Recognised as the international standard for combating ML, TF and PF, the FATF Recommendations also help ensure a level playing field.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織建議有助營造公平競爭的環境，並獲承認為打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準。

snapshot.en: To ensure full and effective implementation of its standards, the FATF conducts evaluations on jurisdictions and undertakes stringent follow-up after them.
snapshot.tc: 為確保其標準在全球全面而有效地執行，特別組織會透過評核來監察各司法管轄區的合規情況，並在評核後進行嚴格的跟進程序。

snapshot.en: Jurisdictions it identifies as high-risk could be subject to enhanced scrutiny by the FATF or counter-measures by its members and the international community.
snapshot.tc: 被識別為高度風險的司法管轄區，可能會受到特別組織加強審查，或受到特別組織成員及國際社會採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: As a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations, which can be found on the FATF website.
snapshot.tc: 作為特別組織的成員，香港有責任實施最新的特別組織建議，而特別組織建議可在特別組織的網站查閱。

tested.point: 措施种类、目标不限ML/TF/PF、协调应对与全球成员交流

snapshot.en: Legal, regulatory and operational measures are among the measures whose effective implementation the FATF promotes to combat ML, TF and PF.
snapshot.tc: 財務行動特別組織的宗旨包括推動有效執行法律、監管及作業措施，以打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集。

snapshot.en: In setting standards and promoting effective measures, the FATF’s objectives cover only ML, TF and PF as threats to the integrity of the international financial system.
snapshot.tc: 財務行動特別組織在制訂標準及推動有效措施時，其宗旨僅涵蓋洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集對國際金融體系的威脅。

snapshot.en: The FATF Recommendations provide a basis for a co-ordinated response to threats to the integrity of the international financial system.
snapshot.tc: 財務行動特別組織所訂立的建議，為協調應對影響國際金融體系完整性的相關威脅提供基礎。

snapshot.en: Many major economies have joined the FATF, forming a global network for international cooperation that facilitates exchanges between member jurisdictions.
snapshot.tc: 很多大型經濟體系加入財務行動特別組織，形成國際合作的全球網絡，促進成員司法管轄區之間的交流。

tested.point: EDD/反制及风险分析

snapshot.en: The FATF calls on all members and urges all jurisdictions to apply enhanced due diligence to the countries identified as high-risk and, in the most serious cases, countermeasures.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求所有成員及促請所有司法管轄區對被識別為高風險的國家採取更嚴格的盡職審查，並在最嚴重的情況下採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: The countermeasures listed by the FATF include terminating correspondent relationships with DPRK banks and limiting business relationships with DPRK persons.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織列出的針對措施包括終止與朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的銀行的代理關係，以及限制與朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的人士的業務關係。

snapshot.en: The FATF requires its members to take into account, in their risk analysis, the information in its updated statement on jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求其成員在進行風險分析時，參考其發布的有關被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新聲明所載述的資料。

tested.point: 识别战略缺陷及改善进度

snapshot.en: The factors include whether the FATF identifies the jurisdiction as having strategic AML/CFT deficiencies and its recent progress in improving its AML/CFT regime.
snapshot.tc: 考慮因素包括司法管轄區是否被財務行動特別組織識別為缺乏執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略，以及近期改善制度的進度。

tested.point: FATF指导文件及名称

snapshot.en: For more red flag indicators, reference can be made to relevant guidance issued from time to time by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities.
snapshot.tc: 如需了解可疑交易及活動指標的詳情，可參考特別組織、跨政府組織、各地政府及主管當局不時發出的相關導引。

snapshot.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Guidance for Money Service Operators in Detecting Terrorist Financing”.
snapshot.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《金錢服務經營者偵測恐怖分子資金籌集指引》。

snapshot.en: The guidance that the Guideline names for further red flag indicators includes the FATF's “Money Laundering through Money Remittance and Currency Exchange Providers”.
snapshot.tc: 指引列出可供參考以了解指標詳情的導引，包括特別組織發出的《藉匯款和貨幣兌換供應商洗錢》。

tested.point: FATF文件和类型学可作培训

snapshot.en: An MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies as part of its training materials.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可考慮使用特別組織的文章及典型案件作為培訓材料。

rows.name: UNSC／联合国安全理事会及联合国成员国

points: 通过防止/遏制TF的决议及相关名单；成员国须冻结及报告疑似匹配
决定金融制裁；PF采取全球及特定国家两层方法，形成成员国强制义务

tested.point: TF决议、名单、成员国冻结与报告

snapshot.en: By passing UNSCR 1373 (2001), the UN Security Council has called on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts.
snapshot.tc: 藉著通過安理會第1373 (2001)號決議，聯合國安全理事會要求全體成員國以行動防止及遏制恐怖分子資金籌集行為。

snapshot.en: All UN member states are required to freeze the funds of persons named in the lists relating to Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban, and to report suspected name matches.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國全體成員國均須凍結名列涉及基地組織、伊黎伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）和塔利班組織的名單的人等的資金，並就可疑的吻合姓名／名稱向有關當局報告。

snapshot.en: A decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) on preventing travel for the purpose of terrorist acts or terrorist training is further implemented by the UNATMO.
snapshot.tc: 安理會第2178 (2014)號決議有關防止為恐怖主義行為或恐怖主義培訓而進行旅程的決定，亦由《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》進一步實施。

snapshot.en: The UNATMO is principally directed towards implementing UNSCR decisions that seek to prevent the financing of terrorist acts and to combat the threat of foreign terrorist fighters.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》旨在實施安理會的相關決定，以防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金，並減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員的威脅。

tested.point: PF全球/国别安排及决议强制性

snapshot.en: UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions form the basis of the UNSC's global approach to combating PF.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國安全理事會遏止擴散資金籌集的全球層面方針，以安理會第1540 (2004)號決議及其後續決議為依據。

snapshot.en: UNSCR 1718 (2006) and its successor resolutions form the basis of the UNSC's country-specific approach against Iran.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國安全理事會針對伊朗遏止擴散資金籌集的國家層面方針，以安理會第1718 (2006)號決議及其後續決議為依據。

snapshot.en: The UNSC resolutions combating PF, made under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, are recommendations that UN member states may adopt.
snapshot.tc: 聯合國安全理事會根據《聯合國憲章》第七章通過以遏止擴散資金籌集的決議，屬成員國可自行採納的建議。

snapshot.en: Hong Kong's counter proliferation financing regime includes the regulations made under the UNSO which are specific to the DPRK and Iran.
snapshot.tc: 香港根據法例實施的打擊擴散資金籌集制度，包括根據《聯合國制裁條例》針對朝鮮及伊朗訂立的規例。

tested.point: UNSC公布有关决议/名单更新

snapshot.en: Whenever the UNSC promulgates updates to UNSCRs or sanctions lists relating to terrorism, TF and PF, the CCE draws them to the attention of MSOs from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 每當聯合國安全理事會就有關恐怖主義、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的安理會決議或制裁名單頒布更新，關長會不時通知金錢服務經營者。

rows.notes: 制裁委员会具体指定职责单列，避免UNSC的大主题掩盖。

untested.quote_tc: 凡某人或財產如第[6.2]段所述被根據相關的聯合國安理會決議成立的聯合國安理會委員會分別指定為恐怖分子／與恐怖分子有聯繫者或恐怖分子財產

snapshot.en: Except under a licence granted by the Chief Executive, it is an offence to deal, directly or indirectly, with funds belonging to, or owned or controlled by, a designated person.
snapshot.tc: 除獲行政長官批予的特許授權外，直接或間接處理屬於被指認的個人或由其擁有或控制的資金，即屬犯罪。

snapshot.en: An MSO seeking a licence from the Chief Executive under a regulation made under the UNSO should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.
snapshot.tc: 尋求行政長官根據《聯合國制裁條例》下的規例批予特許的金錢服務經營者，應向商務及經濟發展局提出書面申請。

rows.notes: 接收申请的部门与有权发特许的局长已在同句区分。

rows.name: CEDB／商务及经济发展局

points: 网站公布指定人士/实体名单；接收向CE寻求UNSO特许的书面申请

tested.point: 指定名单网站不是C&ED；UNSO申请写往CEDB

snapshot.en: Notices specifying the persons and entities designated under the UNSO are published in the Gazette or on the website of the Customs and Excise Department.
snapshot.tc: 指明根據《聯合國制裁條例》被指認的個人及實體的公告，會在憲報或海關網站刊登。

snapshot.en: An MSO seeking a licence from the Chief Executive under a regulation made under the UNSO should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.
snapshot.tc: 尋求行政長官根據《聯合國制裁條例》下的規例批予特許的金錢服務經營者，應向商務及經濟發展局提出書面申請。

rows.notes: 不能将收件部门写成特许授予者。

rows.name: CCE／海关关长

points: 发布指引；判断附表2违法时须顾及相关指引；监督CDD/记录及其他AMLO规定；纪律处分
接收风险评估及不能适用较高海外标准的通知；通知较高风险
可提供/认可身份核实来源及数字身份系统；书面指定高风险/要求EDD或反制措施；通函提示差劣控制地区
提醒制裁名单更新；STR反馈；查阅资料及要求延长保留；接收电汇完整资料及汇款记录

tested.point: 发布与AMLO执行

snapshot.en: The Guideline is issued by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise (CCE), and compliance with the Guideline is enforced through the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 本指引由海關關長（關長）公布，而本指引的遵行情況會按照《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》強制執行。

snapshot.en: Disciplinary and other actions under the AMLO may be taken against an MSO that fails to comply with the Guideline, for non-compliance with the relevant requirements.
snapshot.tc: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》採取的紀律行動及其他行動，或會因沒有遵守相關規定而施加於未有遵守本指引的金錢服務經營者。

tested.point: AMLO监督主体不是JFIU

snapshot.en: The AMLO imposes requirements relating to CDD and record-keeping on MSOs, and gives the JFIU powers to supervise compliance with these and the AMLO's other requirements.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》向金錢服務經營者施加盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定，並賦予財富情報組權力監督該等及其他規定的合規情況。

tested.point: 纪律权力及程序

snapshot.en: Subject to the requirements on procedure and penalty guidelines, the Commissioner may use any one or more of the powers, which include a public reprimand and an order to take remedial action by a set date.
snapshot.tc: 在符合程序及指引的規定下，關長可行使一項或多於一項權力，包括公開譴責該經營者及命令其在指明日期或之前採取糾正行動。

snapshot.en: Having exercised such a power, the Commissioner may disclose to the public details of the decision, the reasons for which it was made and any material facts relating to the case.
snapshot.tc: 關長行使該等權力後，可向公眾披露其決定的詳情、作出該決定的理由以及關於該個案的任何重要事實。

snapshot.en: The Commissioner must inform the operator of the decision by notice in writing, stating the reasons and that the operator may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review of the decision.
snapshot.tc: 關長須藉書面通知將決定告知該經營者，通知須載有作出決定的理由及該經營者可向覆核審裁處申請覆核的提示。

snapshot.en: Where they apply, the terms of any reprimand and the action the operator must take under the decision are also to be stated in the Commissioner's notice of the decision.
snapshot.tc: 在適用範圍內，關長的決定通知亦須載有根據該決定譴責該經營者的內容，以及根據該決定規定其採取的行動。

tested.point: 风险评估接收方

snapshot.en: Having mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the JFIU, rather than to the CCE, when required to do so
snapshot.tc: 設有適當機制，在被要求時向財富情報組（而非海關關長）提供該風險評估

tested.point: 通知较高风险

snapshot.en: The assessment may take into account Hong Kong's jurisdiction-wide ML/TF risk assessment, and should take into account any higher risks notified to MSOs by the CCE
snapshot.tc: 評估可考慮香港在司法管轄區層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，並應顧及關長通報的任何較高風險

tested.point: 接收海外不容许较高标准的通知

snapshot.en: The MSO informs the CCE of the failure in its next routine filing, having first recorded the failure and its causes in its own internal records
snapshot.tc: 該經營者會在下一次例行提交資料時將該情況通知關長，並先在其內部記錄該情況及其成因

tested.point: 核实来源和数字识别认可

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by the relevant authority or by any other relevant authority.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據有關當局或任何其他有關主管當局所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by any other source, so long as that source is reliable and independent.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據任何其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，只要該來源屬可靠及獨立即可。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system, a source the AMLO names.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據認可數碼識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，該系統屬《打擊洗錢條例》所列的來源之一。

snapshot.en: For an MSO, a recognized digital identification system is a digital identification system recognized as a reliable and independent source by the relevant regulatory body.
snapshot.tc: 就金錢服務經營者而言，認可數碼識別系統指獲有關監管機構認可的、屬可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統。

tested.point: 境外类似主管当局来源

snapshot.en: An authority in a place outside Hong Kong performing functions similar to those of the CCE or any other relevant authority is among the reliable and independent sources the Guideline lists.
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方執行與關長或任何其他有關主管當局職能相類似的職能的主管當局，屬指引所列的可靠及獨立來源之一。

tested.point: 书面指定高风险情况

snapshot.en: The requirements apply in a situation the Commissioner specifies in a written notice to the MSO, and in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 有關規定適用於關長藉給予金錢服務經營者的書面通知所指明的情況，及任何其他以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況。

tested.point: 书面反制措施

snapshot.en: Where the FATF calls for mandatory EDD or countermeasures, the CCE may, by notice in writing, require MSOs to undertake specific countermeasures described in the notice.
snapshot.tc: 如特別組織呼籲執行更嚴格的盡職審查或採取針對措施，關長可透過書面通知，要求金錢服務經營者採取通知內所述的特定針對措施。

tested.point: 名单更新提醒

snapshot.en: Whenever the UNSC promulgates updates to UNSCRs or sanctions lists relating to terrorism, TF and PF, the CCE draws them to the attention of MSOs from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 每當聯合國安全理事會就有關恐怖主義、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的安理會決議或制裁名單頒布更新，關長會不時通知金錢服務經營者。

snapshot.en: The database should include the lists the CCE draws to the attention of MSOs, be subject to timely update whenever there are changes, and be made easily accessible by relevant staff.
snapshot.tc: 數據庫應收錄關長不時告知金錢服務經營者的名單；每當資料有變化時，數據庫亦應及時更新，讓相關職員易於查閱。

tested.point: STR质量反馈

snapshot.en: An MSO should ensure that its STRs are of high quality, taking into account the feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and by the CCE from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應留意財富情報組在季度報告及關長不時提供的反饋意見及導引，以確保其可疑交易報告屬高水平。

tested.point: 书面延长纪录保留

snapshot.en: The CCE may, by written notice, require records on a specified customer to be kept for longer than these periods.
snapshot.tc: 關長可藉書面通知，要求金錢服務經營者把指定客戶的紀錄備存一段較長的期間。

tested.point: 有适当授权时迅速取得资料

snapshot.en: All CDD information and transaction records should be available swiftly to the CCE, other authorities and auditors upon appropriate authority.
snapshot.tc: 所有盡職審查資料及交易紀錄應迅速地提供予有適當授權的關長、其他機構及核數師。

tested.point: 收到请求后三营业日补全电汇资料

snapshot.en: Where a domestic wire transfer carries the originator's account or reference number instead of full details, the MSO must give the other originator details within 3 business days after the transfer, if the relevant authority or receiving institution asks.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉賬以匯款人的戶口號碼或參考編號代替完整資料，該經營者須在有關當局或收取其轉賬指示的機構要求下，於轉賬後3個營業日內提供所記錄的其他匯款人資料。

tested.point: 汇款记录供CCE而非JFIU查阅

snapshot.en: For a remittance, the MSO should be able to justify that it has taken steps under the record-keeping chapter to keep the record of the originator and the transaction, so as to make it available to the JFIU if needed.
snapshot.tc: 就匯款交易而言，金錢服務經營者應能證明已按照指引第8章的規定採取步驟保存匯款人的紀錄及相關交易的資料，以便有需要時向財富情報組提供該等資料。

untested.point: CCE考虑某人是否违反附表2时须顾及相关指引条文，现有题只测试指引由谁发布及一般监督
untested.quote_en: the CCE must have regard to the relevant provision in this Guideline
untested.quote_tc: 關長在考慮某人有否違反附表2的條文時，須顧及本指引內相關的條文

rows.notes: 监管/牌照/纪律完整职权另由AMLO和发牌资料负责人盘点；本行只汇总02明确出现的权责。无需以无FATF呼吁等细枝条件另增加机构题。

rows.name: 警方、海关人员及执法机关

points: 警方及海关人员调查有组织罪行与三合会活动
执行搜查令/提交令/限制令/没收令，查犯罪情报；调查主管提供期限困难指引；获记录协助追踪及可即时索取完整电汇资料

tested.point: OSCO调查者是警方和海关，不是廉署替代海关

snapshot.en: The OSCO empowers officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Independent Commission Against Corruption to investigate organized crime and triad activities.
snapshot.tc: 調查有組織罪行及三合會活動的權力，由《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予香港警方及廉政公署人員。

tested.point: 执法文件、联络人员、期限及受害者边界

snapshot.en: As such court documents are crucial to investigations and to restraining and confiscating illicit proceeds, an MSO should have clear policies and procedures to handle them effectively and in a timely manner.
snapshot.tc: 這類法庭文件對執法機構的調查以至限制及沒收非法得益至為重要，金錢服務經營者應制訂清晰的政策和程序，以有效及合時的方式處理。

snapshot.en: The policies and procedures for handling court documents should include providing accurate information, allocating sufficient resources and appointing a staff member as the main point of contact with law enforcement agencies.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者處理法庭文件的政策和程序，應包括為此提供準確資料、分配足夠資源及委任一名人員作為與執法機構的中央聯絡點。

snapshot.en: An MSO must respond to any search warrant and production order within the required time limit, by providing all the information or material within the scope of the court document.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須確保在規定期限內就任何搜查令及提交令作出回應，提供一切屬該等法庭文件範圍內的資料或材料。

snapshot.en: Where an MSO has difficulty in complying with the timeframes stipulated for a search warrant or production order, it should contact the officer-in-charge of the investigation at the earliest opportunity for further guidance.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在遵守搜查令或提交令的規定時限方面如遇到困難，應第一時間聯絡調查的主管人員，尋求進一步導引。

snapshot.en: On receiving a crime-related intelligence request, such as a notification letter, on a particular customer, the MSO should timely assess the risks involved and the need for an appropriate review of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 如接獲執法機構就特定客戶發出與罪行相關的情報要求（例如通知書），金錢服務經營者應適時評估所涉風險及是否需要進行適當覆核。

snapshot.en: An MSO served with a court document relating to a particular customer should be aware that the customer to whom the document relates can be a victim of crime.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者接獲執法機構就特定客戶送達的法庭文件時，應留意法庭文件所涉的客戶，或是罪案的受害人。

tested.point: 四类法院文件

snapshot.en: The court documents with which law enforcement agencies may serve an MSO, pursuant to relevant legislation in Hong Kong, include search warrants, production orders, restraint orders and confiscation orders.
snapshot.tc: 執法機構根據香港相關法例向金錢服務經營者送達的法庭文件，例如可以是搜查令、提交令、限制令或沒收令。

tested.point: 建立嫌疑人财务概况及追踪

snapshot.en: Record-keeping helps the investigating authorities establish a suspect's financial profile and trace criminal or terrorist funds, and assists the Court to examine relevant past transactions.
snapshot.tc: 備存紀錄有助調查當局確定疑犯的財政狀況及追查罪犯或恐怖分子的資金，並協助法院審查相關的過往交易。

tested.point: 即时提供完整电汇资料

snapshot.en: Where a domestic wire transfer omits the complete required originator information, that information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon their request.
snapshot.tc: 如本地電傳轉帳略去部分所需匯款人資料，匯款機構亦需在執法機構提出要求時，立即向其提供全部所需匯款人資料。

rows.notes: 不将警方/海关调查权泛化成JFIU拥有全部执法权。

rows.name: 法院／原讼法庭

points: 指引可作AMLO诉讼证据并须考虑相关条文；OSCO没收、限制及押记令；接收资料决定适当加重判刑
应CE申请作指定令；定罪后没收犯罪得益及恐怖财产充公；以记录审查过去交易

tested.point: OSCO限制/押记/没收职权

snapshot.en: The OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to issue restraint orders and charging orders over the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法院司法管轄權，就被控觸犯該條例所指罪行的被告人的財產發出限制令及押記令。

snapshot.en: Under the OSCO, the Courts are given jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes, among other matters.
snapshot.tc: 除其他事項外，《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法院司法管轄權，沒收來自有組織及嚴重罪行的得益。

tested.point: 定罪后没收与恐怖财产充公

snapshot.en: Once a defendant has been charged, a court may order the confiscation of his criminal proceeds, and an MSO holding funds deemed to represent his benefit from the crime may be served with a confiscation order.
snapshot.tc: 被告一經落案起訴，法院可下令沒收其犯罪所得，而持有法院認為代表其犯罪得益的資金的金錢服務經營者，可能會收到沒收令。

snapshot.en: Besides ordering the confiscation of a defendant's criminal proceeds, a court may also order the forfeiture of property where it is satisfied that the property is terrorist property.
snapshot.tc: 除下令沒收被告的犯罪所得外，如法院信納某些財產屬恐怖分子財產，亦可下令充公有關財產。

tested.point: 审查过去交易

snapshot.en: Record-keeping helps the investigating authorities establish a suspect's financial profile and trace criminal or terrorist funds, and assists the Court to examine relevant past transactions.
snapshot.tc: 備存紀錄有助調查當局確定疑犯的財政狀況及追查罪犯或恐怖分子的資金，並協助法院審查相關的過往交易。

untested.point: AMLO诉讼可接纳指引为证据；相关规定须被法院考虑
untested.quote_en: this Guideline is admissible in evidence
untested.quote_tc: 本指引可獲接納為證據

untested.point: OSCO法院可接收违法者及罪行资料，判断是否适宜加重判刑
untested.quote_en: to receive information about an offender and an offence in order to determine whether the imposition of a greater sentence is appropriate
untested.quote_tc: 收取有關違法者及有關罪行的資料，以決定當有關罪行構成有組織／與三合會有關的罪行或其他嚴重罪行時，是否適宜作出更重的判刑

untested.point: 原讼法庭可应CE申请作恐怖分子/关联者/财产指定令
untested.quote_en: the Chief Executive may make an application to the Court of First Instance for an order
untested.quote_tc: 行政長官可向原訟法庭提出申請，要求作出命令

rows.notes: 程序背景层面的加强，非重大实务缺口；指定令与RG009同一命题应合并补题。

rows.name: JFIU／联合财富情报组

points: STR接收方及MLRO对外联络点；确认收报；一般无迫切行动时给予同意；同意不是风险保证
推广SAFE/系统查询法；季度报告分析STR、反馈事项，面向全金融行业；经注册访问

tested.point: MLRO与JFIU的联络分工

snapshot.en: The MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，也是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點

tested.point: 名称应为Intelligence而非Information

snapshot.en: Besides law enforcement agencies, the MLRO is the MSO's main point of contact with the Joint Financial Information Unit.
snapshot.tc: 除執法機構外，洗錢報告主任亦是金錢服務經營者與聯合財務情報組聯繫的主要聯絡點。

tested.point: STR不是报给CCE

snapshot.en: A person who knows or suspects that any property is terrorist property must, as soon as reasonable, file an STR with the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如知道或懷疑任何財產是恐怖分子財產，須在合理範圍內盡快向關長提交可疑交易報告。

tested.point: TF/PF/制裁怀疑向JFIU报告

snapshot.en: In case of any suspicion of terrorist financing, proliferation financing or sanctions violations, the MSO should make a report to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者懷疑有任何涉及恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集或制裁的違規情況，便應該向財富情報組作出報告。

tested.point: 系统查询法和收报确认

snapshot.en: In evaluating an internal report, the MLRO may question the customer appropriately, per the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions recommended by the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 評估內部報告時，洗錢報告主任的工作可包括按照財富情報組推薦的有系統方法來適當地查問客戶，藉以識別可疑交易。

snapshot.en: Where an MSO has made an STR under section 25A of the DTROP and the OSCO or under section 12 of the UNATMO, the JFIU will acknowledge its receipt of the report.
snapshot.tc: 根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》或《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》提交的可疑交易報告，財富情報組會確認收到。

tested.point: SAFE及并非一概自动STR

snapshot.en: Where applicable, an MSO may adopt the “SAFE” approach promoted by the JFIU, which includes screening the account for suspicious indicators and asking the customer appropriate questions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可按情況採用財富情報組所推廣的「SAFE」方法，其中包括篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標及向客戶作出恰當提問。

snapshot.en: The steps of the “SAFE” approach that an MSO may adopt include finding out the customer's records and then filing an STR with the JFIU on what has been found.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可採用的「SAFE」方法，包括翻查客戶的已知紀錄，然後就所得結果向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

tested.point: 季度分析/反馈、全行业和访问方式

snapshot.en: An MSO should ensure that its STRs are of high quality, taking into account the feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and by the CCE from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應留意財富情報組在季度報告及關長不時提供的反饋意見及導引，以確保其可疑交易報告屬高水平。

snapshot.en: The JFIU's quarterly report is written specifically for the MSO sector, and consists of an analysis of STRs and matters of interest and feedback.
snapshot.tc: 財富情報組的季度報告是專為金錢服務經營者行業編寫的，分為可疑交易報告的分析及注意事項及反饋意見兩部分。

snapshot.en: The quarterly report sits in a secure area of the JFIU's website, for which an MSO may apply for a login name and password through the registration form or by contacting the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 季度報告可於財富情報組網站的限制區查閱，金錢服務經營者可填妥登記表格或直接聯絡財富情報組申請登入帳戶及密碼。

tested.point: 同意和抗辩的有限效果

snapshot.en: Where the report is made before the MSO undertakes the disclosed acts, the defence applies if the acts are undertaken with the JFIU's consent.
snapshot.tc: 如報告是在作出所披露作為之前作出，而該作為是得到財富情報組同意的，即可提供法定免責辯護。

snapshot.en: If there is no need for imminent action, such as a restraint order on an account, consent will usually be given for the MSO to operate the account.
snapshot.tc: 如無需立即採取行動（例如發出限制令），財富情報組一般會同意金錢服務經營者運作該戶口。

snapshot.en: The statutory defence does not absolve the MSO from the legal, reputational or regulatory risks associated with the account's continued operation.
snapshot.tc: 法定免責辯護不會免除金錢服務經營者因該帳戶的持續運作而涉及的法律、聲譽或監管風險。

snapshot.en: A “consent” response to a pre-transaction report should not be construed as a “clean bill of health” for the continued operation of the account.
snapshot.tc: 財富情報組就交易前的報告作出「同意」的回應，不應被解釋為該戶口持續運作的「健康證明」。

rows.notes: 02不足以支持完整JFIU组织架构、成立方式或其全部分析/转介/调查权限清单；这些若由其他官方文件提供应另核。B21保留官方样题名称处理决定。

rows.name: HKMA／香港金融管理局

points: 非面对面首笔付款的境外机构，应受执行类似HKMA职能的当局监管；HKMA简称含义
HKMA发布2010年cover payment参考指引；仅资料出处

tested.point: 境外首笔付款的监管者应类似HKMA而非CCE

snapshot.en: An institution in an equivalent jurisdiction may be used for the first payment of a customer not physically present if, among other conditions, authorities there with functions like the Commissioner's supervise it.
snapshot.tc: 對等司法管轄區的機構如要供不曾為身分識別目的而現身的客戶作第一次付款，條件之一是受到當地職能與關長的職能相類似的主管當局監管。

rows.notes: 02没有完整金管局职能清单。本行已测的是上述银行监管对应关系，不代表货币政策等完整职能已覆盖。 脚注68的具体参考指引出版身份未出题，属来源细节，非完整监管职能缺口。

rows.name: RA／有关主管当局及境外类似当局

points: 作为身份核实可靠来源；监督适格境外中介；对相关外地FI集体监督延伸至该机构

tested.point: 核实来源与认可主体

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by the relevant authority or by any other relevant authority.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據有關當局或任何其他有關主管當局所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by any other source, so long as that source is reliable and independent.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據任何其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，只要該來源屬可靠及獨立即可。

snapshot.en: For an MSO, a recognized digital identification system is a digital identification system recognized as a reliable and independent source by the relevant regulatory body.
snapshot.tc: 就金錢服務經營者而言，認可數碼識別系統指獲有關監管機構認可的、屬可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統。

tested.point: 境外类似主管当局可提供可靠资料

snapshot.en: An authority in a place outside Hong Kong performing functions similar to those of the CCE or any other relevant authority is among the reliable and independent sources the Guideline lists.
snapshot.tc: 在香港以外地方執行與關長或任何其他有關主管當局職能相類似的職能的主管當局，屬指引所列的可靠及獨立來源之一。

tested.point: 境外中介本地监督与相似CDD/记录条件

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, a lawyer, notary public, auditor or tax advisor practising in an equivalent jurisdiction must be supervised for compliance with the requirements by a relevant authority in Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區執業的律師、公證人、核數師或稅務顧問如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，須在遵從有關規定方面受到香港的有關當局監管。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, an institution doing business in an equivalent jurisdiction similar to an authorized institution's must have measures to ensure compliance with requirements similar to the AMLO's due diligence and record-keeping ones.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區經營與認可機構相類似業務的機構如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，須已有措施確保遵從與《打擊洗錢條例》的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定。

tested.point: 相关外地FI的集团层面监督

snapshot.en: To be relied on, a related foreign financial institution must be supervised at a group level by a relevant authority, or by an authority in an equivalent jurisdiction performing like functions for the MSO's holding company or head office.
snapshot.tc: 相關外地金融機構如要獲依賴，須在集團層面受有關當局監管，或受對等司法管轄區就該經營者的控權公司或總行執行類似有關當局職能的主管當局監管。

rows.notes: 各RA管辖哪些业者须看AMLO，02未完整列明；不据本行推断已测试所有监管分工。

rows.name: 董事会／获授权委员会

points: 理解MSO风险并确保风险得到管理；在适用情况下由授权委员会参与治理

tested.point: 董事会/授权委员会及高层均理解并管理风险

snapshot.en: The board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, and the senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的董事會（或獲其授權的委員會，如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解該經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

snapshot.en: The board, or its delegated committee, and senior management should ensure the MSO's ML/TF risks are adequately managed
snapshot.tc: 董事會或獲其授權的委員會及高級管理層應確保已妥善管理金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

tested.point: 治理主体范围

snapshot.en: Both senior management and the board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, should clearly understand the MSO's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層，以及董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用），均應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

rows.notes: 管理资料收件人的中英差异按E29；不以仅英文要求所有资料直接送董事会作为新双语题缺口。

rows.name: 高级管理层

points: 批准风险评估/更新和系统/简化系统；治理、落实系统、委任CO/MLRO；确保任职资格、独立性、资讯、资源等
待核实个案获定期报告、例外第三方付款批准；高风险/PEP关系批准；前PEP解除EDD决定批准；STR后必要升级决定

tested.point: 风险评估批准

snapshot.en: Obtaining the approval of the MSO's own senior management on the results of the risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 就該項風險評估的結果，取得該經營者本身高級管理層的審批

tested.point: 更新审批主体非CCE

snapshot.en: The results of the review should be documented and approved by the CCE rather than by the MSO's senior management
snapshot.tc: 覆核的結果應記錄在案，並由海關關長（而非該經營者的高級管理層）審批

tested.point: 简化系统审批与复核

snapshot.en: Simplified AML/CFT Systems need the approval of senior management and must be reviewed from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 簡化的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度須經高級管理層審批，並須由金錢服務經營者不時覆核。

tested.point: 监督、资讯品质、实施及CO/MLRO任命区别

snapshot.en: Both senior management and the board of directors, or its delegated committee where applicable, should clearly understand the MSO's ML/TF risks.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層，以及董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用），均應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Management information on ML/TF risks should reach senior management in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner.
snapshot.tc: 關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層。

snapshot.en: Senior management is responsible for implementing effective AML/CFT Systems that can adequately manage the ML/TF risks identified.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的高級管理層有責任推行有效的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以妥善管理已識別的風險。

snapshot.en: Senior management should appoint the MLRO at the management level, with overall responsibility for establishing and maintaining the AML/CFT Systems.
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的洗錢報告主任，全面負責建立及維持打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

tested.point: 资格、按规模独立性、驻港与资历、信息及替补主体

snapshot.en: They should be appropriately qualified, with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge to discharge their responsibilities properly
snapshot.tc: 他們應擁有合適資格，並具備足夠的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識以履行職責

snapshot.en: They should be placed within, rather than independent of, the MSO's own operational and business functions, regardless of the MSO's size
snapshot.tc: 不論該經營者的規模如何，他們均應置於該經營者的營運及業務職能之內，而非獨立於該等職能

snapshot.en: They should normally be based in Hong Kong and be of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO
snapshot.tc: 他們通常應長駐香港，並在該金錢服務經營者具有一定的資歷及權力

snapshot.en: They should be capable of accessing, on a timely basis, all available internal information such as CDD records and external sources such as CCE circulars
snapshot.tc: 他們應能及時取得一切可得資料，包括客戶盡職審查紀錄等內部來源及關長通函等外部來源

snapshot.en: They should be provided with an alternate or deputy who is appointed by the CCE rather than by the MSO's senior management
snapshot.tc: 他們應獲配替補人選，而該替補人選由關長而非由高級管理層委任

tested.point: 非指定专业资格、接触高层、规模限制

snapshot.en: They are appropriately qualified, with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge.
snapshot.tc: 擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識。

snapshot.en: They are independent of all operational and business functions.
snapshot.tc: 獨立於金錢服務經營者的所有營運及業務職能。

snapshot.en: They are of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 在金錢服務經營者內部具有一定的資歷及權力。

snapshot.en: They hold a professional AML qualification recognised by the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 持有關長認可的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集專業資格。

snapshot.en: They have regular contact with senior management and, when required, direct access.
snapshot.tc: 與高級管理層保持定期聯絡，並在有需要時能直接聯絡高級管理層。

tested.point: 待核实个案定期报告及例外付款批准

snapshot.en: As one of the risk management procedures it adopts, cases in which verification is still pending completion should be reported to the CCE periodically, keeping it informed.
snapshot.tc: 作為所採取的風險管理程序之一，尚待完成身分核實的個案應定期向關長報告，讓關長知悉有關情況。

snapshot.en: Exceptions allowing payments to a third party are subject to conditions that include the risk being assessed as low and the transaction being approved by senior management.
snapshot.tc: 支付資金予第三者的例外安排須符合多項條件，其中包括有關風險評定屬於低度，以及交易經高級管理層批准。

tested.point: 高风险关系与偶发交易批准边界

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship is to be established with the customer concerned, the MSO must obtain approval from its senior management to establish it.
snapshot.tc: 如將要與有關客戶建立業務關係，金錢服務經營者須取得其高級管理層的批准，以建立該業務關係。

snapshot.en: Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the MSO must take additional measures to mitigate the risk; senior management approval is not required.
snapshot.tc: 如將執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者須採取額外措施以減低所涉風險，而無須取得高級管理層的批准。

tested.point: 既有高风险关系继续批准

snapshot.en: In a situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing, continuing an established business relationship needs the approval of the senior management.
snapshot.tc: 在任何以性質而論屬可引致洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的高度風險的情況下，如要繼續已建立的業務關係，須取得有關高級管理層的批准。

tested.point: 跨地区高管可批准PEP关系

snapshot.en: Senior management approving a PEP relationship may include personnel in another jurisdiction, if this reflects the MSO's organisational structure and risk management practices.
snapshot.tc: 如能反映組織結構及風險管理方法，批准與政治人物建立業務關係的高級管理層可包括其他司法管轄區的人員。

tested.point: STR后升级到高层而非JFIU

snapshot.en: If necessary, the issue should be escalated to the JFIU to determine how to handle the relationship and mitigate its risks.
snapshot.tc: 如有需要，有關問題應上報至財富情報組，以斷定如何處理該段關係及減低其風險。

tested.point: 高风险客户批准不属MLRO主要职能

snapshot.en: The principal functions of the MLRO should include having oversight of the approval of the MSO's business relationships with high-risk customers.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任所履行的主要職能，應包括監督金錢服務經營者與高風險客戶建立業務關係的批核。

untested.point: 须在可行范围确保CO/MLRO完全熟悉适用法规及该MSO业务风险；一般AML知识不等同这一明确要求
untested.quote_en: fully conversant with the MSO’s statutory and regulatory requirements and the ML/TF risks arising from the MSO’s business
untested.quote_tc: 完全熟悉適用於金錢服務經營者的法定及監管規定，以及金錢服務經營者的業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

untested.point: 须配备足够资源（包括职员）；替补任命已测但人员/资源保障未测
untested.quote_en: equipped with sufficient resources, including staff and appropriate cover for the absence of the CO and MLRO
untested.quote_tc: 配備充足資源，包括職員及合規主任及洗錢報告主任的適當替補人選

untested.point: 决定不再对前非香港PEP执行EDD必须由高层批准并已评估不再高风险；现题只否定固定年限
untested.quote_en: approval of the MSO’s senior management and on the basis that the PEP no longer presents a high risk of ML/TF
untested.quote_tc: 有關決定須獲金錢服務經營者的高級管理層批准，而該政治人物須不再構成高度洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

rows.notes: 前PEP缺口与FAQ及旧G041合并。替补同等地位可行性限定存在E28，避免用该语言差异出真假。

rows.name: CO／合规主任

points: 管理层级；总体建立/维持系统；预防侦测活动中枢
支持及指导高层；发展/持续复核（含集团）系统；监督有效性；传达关键事项/重大缺陷；确保培训充足适当有效
接受管理人员级别的培训

tested.point: 管理层级与整体系统责任

snapshot.en: Senior management should appoint a Compliance Officer at the management level within the MSO itself
snapshot.tc: 高級管理層應委任一名屬該經營者管理層的人員，出任其合規主任一職

snapshot.en: The CO has the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 合規主任全面負責建立及維持該經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度

tested.point: 四项具体职责

snapshot.en: Developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory requirements and are effective
snapshot.tc: 制定及／或持續覆核金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以確保其反映現況、符合現行法定規定並且有效

snapshot.en: Overseeing all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including monitoring their effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary
snapshot.tc: 監督金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的所有方面，包括監察其成效並在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序

snapshot.en: Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including, where appropriate, significant compliance deficiencies
snapshot.tc: 與高級管理層就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的主要問題進行溝通，包括（如適用）重大的合規不足情況

snapshot.en: Ensuring that the AML/CFT training provided to the staff of the MSO is adequate, appropriate and effective
snapshot.tc: 確保向金錢服務經營者的職員所提供的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓充足、適當及有效

tested.point: 中枢、系统、关键而非每项琐事、培训

snapshot.en: Acting as the focal point for the oversight of all activities relating to the prevention and detection of ML/TF
snapshot.tc: 作為金錢服務經營者的中心點，監督一切防止及偵察洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的活動

snapshot.en: Continuously reviewing the AML/CFT Systems, including any group-wide Systems of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to keep them up-to-date
snapshot.tc: 持續覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度（在香港成為法團者包括集團層面的制度），確保制度反映現況

snapshot.en: Overseeing every aspect of the AML/CFT Systems, which includes monitoring how effective they are and enhancing controls where necessary
snapshot.tc: 全方位監督打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括監察成效及在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控

snapshot.en: Communicating every AML/CFT issue that arises to senior management, the minor issues as well as the key ones
snapshot.tc: 就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的每一個問題（包括輕微的問題）與高級管理層進行溝通

snapshot.en: Making sure that the AML/CFT training of the MSO's staff is adequate, appropriate and effective
snapshot.tc: 確保為職員提供的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓是充足、適當而且有效的

tested.point: 管理培训及向JFIU报告

snapshot.en: The specific training that may be appropriate for managerial staff, including internal audit officers and COs, includes training on supervising or managing staff and on reporting suspicious transactions to the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 或適用於經理級人員（包括內部審計人員及合規主任）的特定培訓，包括涵蓋監督或管理職員及向關長舉報可疑交易的職責的培訓。

untested.point: 向高层提供支持和导引，确保风险妥善识别、理解和管理；并非仅上报关键合规问题
untested.quote_en: providing support and guidance to the senior management to ensure that ML/TF risks are adequately identified, understood and managed
untested.quote_tc: 向高級管理層提供支援及導引，確保妥為識別、了解和管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

rows.notes: 3.9(a)–(d)四项职责均已有题，不称整张CO职责清单缺失。支持/导引是导语中独立明确职能。任职保障缺口归RG020。

rows.name: MLRO／洗钱报告主任

points: 高阶职员；内部报告中枢、JFIU/执法联络点；积极识别和报告
监督内部披露/例外报告审核、记录、防通风报信指引；确认收报并提醒；评估所有资料、关系式查询、及时性与搜集资料平衡
决定是否报告、及时向JFIU报告、善意不报须留记录；持续可疑事项必要再报；专门评估/报告与更新培训

tested.point: 对外联络及三类主要职责

snapshot.en: The MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，也是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點

snapshot.en: The MLRO's functions include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and deciding whether a JFIU report is necessary
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否須向財富情報組報告

snapshot.en: Oversight of the records of internal reviews of disclosures and exception reports is the Compliance Officer's responsibility
snapshot.tc: 監督備存內部披露及例外情況報告的覆核紀錄，屬合規主任的主要職能

snapshot.en: The MLRO's principal functions include oversight of the provision of guidance on how to avoid “tipping off”
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督提供有關如何避免「通風報訊」的導引

tested.point: 机构名称、积极识别、记录与指导

snapshot.en: Besides law enforcement agencies, the MLRO is the MSO's main point of contact with the Joint Financial Information Unit.
snapshot.tc: 除執法機構外，洗錢報告主任亦是金錢服務經營者與聯合財務情報組聯繫的主要聯絡點。

snapshot.en: The MLRO's principal functions should include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的主要職能應包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告。

snapshot.en: The MLRO should play an active role in the identification, as well as the reporting, of suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任應在識別及報告可疑交易方面擔當積極的角色。

snapshot.en: Keeping all records related to the internal reviews of disclosures is among the matters the MLRO should oversee.
snapshot.tc: 備存內部覆核的所有紀錄，屬洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能之一。

snapshot.en: Among the functions the MLRO should oversee is the provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off.
snapshot.tc: 提供有關如何避免通風報訊的導引，屬洗錢報告主任應監督的主要職能之一。

tested.point: 收报确认由MLRO，不负责高风险关系审批

snapshot.en: Upon an internal report, the reporting staff member's supervisor should acknowledge its receipt and remind the staff member of the obligation regarding tipping off.
snapshot.tc: 職員作出內部報告後，其主管必須確認收到報告，並提醒報告的職員在責任上不可作出通風報訊。

snapshot.en: The principal functions of the MLRO should include having oversight of the approval of the MSO's business relationships with high-risk customers.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任所履行的主要職能，應包括監督金錢服務經營者與高風險客戶建立業務關係的批核。

tested.point: 评估、关系方式、及时、文档、报告与善意决定

snapshot.en: The MLRO must take reasonable steps to consider all relevant information, including CDD and ongoing monitoring information.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任必須採取合理步驟，考慮所有相關資料，包括盡職審查及持續監察資料。

snapshot.en: A review of transaction patterns through connected accounts should preferably be made transaction by transaction, not relationship-based.
snapshot.tc: 覆核透過有關連戶口進行的交易模式時，應盡可能以個別交易為本，而非以關係為本。

snapshot.en: The search for information on connected accounts should strike an appropriate balance with the statutory requirement to make a timely STR.
snapshot.tc: 搜尋關連戶口的資料時，應與及時提交可疑交易報告的法定規定取得適當平衡。

snapshot.en: Any conclusions drawn from the MLRO's review should be documented, while documenting the review process itself is optional.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任覆核所得出的結論應記錄在案，至於覆核過程本身則可選擇是否記錄。

snapshot.en: Having found grounds for suspicion, the MLRO should disclose the information to the JFIU within three working days of his evaluation.
snapshot.tc: 判定有懷疑的理由後，洗錢報告主任應在評估完成後3個工作天內向財富情報組披露。

snapshot.en: If the MLRO, acting in good faith, concludes on all available information that there is no suspicion, criminal liability for not reporting is unlikely.
snapshot.tc: 真誠地考慮所有可獲取的資料後斷定沒有可疑情況而不作報告，不大可能須負上刑事法律責任。

tested.point: 评估依据、查询、报告时点及不报记录

snapshot.en: When an MLRO evaluates an internal report, he may look at any previous patterns of instructions, the length of the business relationship, and CDD and ongoing monitoring information and documentation.
snapshot.tc: 評估內部報告時，洗錢報告主任可參考任何先前的客戶指示模式、業務關係年期，以及有關的盡職審查及持續監察資料和文件。

snapshot.en: In evaluating an internal report, the MLRO may question the customer appropriately, per the systematic approach to identifying suspicious transactions recommended by the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 評估內部報告時，洗錢報告主任的工作可包括按照財富情報組推薦的有系統方法來適當地查問客戶，藉以識別可疑交易。

snapshot.en: Depending on when knowledge or suspicion arises, an STR may be made before a suspicious transaction occurs, whether or not the intended transaction ultimately takes place.
snapshot.tc: 視乎何時得悉或出現可疑情況，金錢服務經營者可在可疑交易發生前提交可疑交易報告，而不論擬作的交易最終有否成事。

snapshot.en: Where an MLRO decides not to file an STR, it is vital that he keeps proper records of the deliberations and actions taken, to demonstrate that he has acted in a reasonable manner.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任決定不提交可疑交易報告時，最重要的是他必須將其慎重考慮和採取的行動妥為備存紀錄，以證明他是以合理的方式行事。

tested.point: 后续疑点继续报

snapshot.en: Further suspicious transactions of the same customer must continue to be reported to the MLRO, whether or not of the same nature.
snapshot.tc: 同一客戶的更多可疑交易，不論是否屬同一性質，均必須繼續向洗錢報告主任報告。

tested.point: MLRO专门培训

snapshot.en: MLROs may be given specific training on assessing the suspicious transaction reports submitted to them and reporting to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任可接受涵蓋評估所收到的可疑交易報告及向財富情報組報告的特定培訓。

tested.point: 保持发展资讯

snapshot.en: The areas of training that may be appropriate for MLROs include training to keep abreast of AML/CFT requirements and developments generally.
snapshot.tc: 或適用於洗錢報告主任的培訓範疇，包括與打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集所有一般規定及發展同步的培訓。

rows.notes: 职位资格/资源保障见RG020；同时控制电汇两端的跨地区STR是MSO义务，单列于电汇角色行。

rows.name: 独立审计及集团合规/审计职能

points: 独立审计直达高层、有专业资源；定期检查系统/风险框架/RBA、STR系统、合规、员工意识；频率适合业务风险及适当外审
集团职能定期独立复核相关外地FI持续遵守集团政策；可验证监察系统及测试汇出资料控制

tested.point: 独立性、直达高层、专业资源及非CO指挥

snapshot.en: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核

snapshot.en: The audit function should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應設有與該經營者高級管理層直接溝通的渠道及途徑

snapshot.en: The audit function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，以使其能夠履行其職責

snapshot.en: The audit function's reviews are carried out under the direction of the Compliance Officer, to whom the function reports
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能的有關覆核在合規主任的指示下進行，並向合規主任作出匯報

tested.point: 四方面审查

snapshot.en: The review should cover the adequacy of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, its ML/TF risk assessment framework and its application of the RBA
snapshot.tc: 覆核應涵蓋打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用情況是否合適

snapshot.en: The review covers the effectiveness of the MSO's suspicious transaction reporting systems every third year rather than at each review
snapshot.tc: 該項覆核每三年才涵蓋金錢服務經營者報告可疑交易的制度的有關成效，而非每次覆核均涵蓋

snapshot.en: The review should also cover the effectiveness of the compliance function operating within the MSO
snapshot.tc: 審核職能的覆核亦應涵蓋金錢服務經營者內部所運作的合規職能是否有效

snapshot.en: The review should cover the level of awareness of the MSO's staff who have AML/CFT responsibilities of their own
snapshot.tc: 覆核應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平

tested.point: 频率和适当外审

snapshot.en: The frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business
snapshot.tc: 有關覆核的頻密程度及範圍應與金錢服務經營者的業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱

snapshot.en: The frequency and extent of the review should also be commensurate with the ML/TF risks that arise from the MSO's own businesses
snapshot.tc: 覆核的頻密程度及範圍亦應與金錢服務經營者的業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱

snapshot.en: The review must be carried out by external parties whenever the MSO's own audit function has been in place for less than three years
snapshot.tc: 凡金錢服務經營者本身的審核職能設立不足三年，有關的覆核均須由外界人士進行，而非由內部職能進行

snapshot.en: Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review of its own AML/CFT Systems from any external parties
snapshot.tc: 在適當情況下，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度進行覆核

tested.point: 审计范围及不必一律外审

snapshot.en: The audit function's regular review should cover the adequacy of the AML/CFT Systems, ML/TF risk assessment framework and use of the RBA.
snapshot.tc: 打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度及風險評估框架是否合適，以及風險為本方法的應用，均屬定期覆核應涵蓋的事項。

snapshot.en: The regular review the audit function makes should cover how effective the MSO's compliance function is.
snapshot.tc: 審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的合規職能是否有效。

snapshot.en: The regular review the audit function makes should cover the level of awareness of staff having AML/CFT responsibilities.
snapshot.tc: 審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋職員對負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識水平。

snapshot.en: The regular review the audit function makes should cover the accuracy of the MSO's financial statements.
snapshot.tc: 審核職能為確保制度成效而作的定期覆核，應涵蓋金錢服務經營者的財務報表是否準確。

snapshot.en: In addition to the audit function's own review, the MSO should seek a review of its AML/CFT Systems from external parties.
snapshot.tc: 除審核職能本身的覆核外，金錢服務經營者亦應尋求外界覆核其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

tested.point: 内部审计或外部验证

snapshot.en: The independent validation of the MSO's transaction monitoring systems and processes can be performed by an external party or by its internal audit function.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的交易監察系統及程序的獨立核實工作，可由外界人士或其內部審核職能執行。

tested.point: 汇出电汇资料控制测试

snapshot.en: An ordering institution's procedures include reasonable measures, such as regular review or testing by internal control or audit, to identify domestic or cross-border wire transfers lacking required information.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構的程序包括採取合理措施（例如定期覆核或藉內部管控或審計職能進行測試，以評估系統功能），識辨本地或跨境電傳轉帳是否欠缺所需資料。

untested.point: 集团合规/审计等职能应定期且独立复核相关外地FI持续遵守集团政策，不能仅以一般审计/监管已测替代
untested.quote_en: regular and independent reviews over its ongoing compliance with the group policy conducted by any group-level compliance, audit or other similar AML/CFT functions
untested.quote_tc: 受到任何集團層面的合規、審核或其他類似的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集職能的定期和獨立的覆核

rows.notes: 与旧G044集团中介条件合并，不新增重复题。员工意识按E36。

rows.name: 全体员工及新员工

points: 员工/管理参与人有个人法律责任；认识MSO及个人CDD/记录/STR/其他责任和后果
识别可疑、及时向MLRO报告并供足够资料；按程序报告即履行其个人报告义务；不通风报信
新员工不论资历尽快初训，定期复训；理解背景及识别/报告程序；按岗位了解新手法

tested.point: MSO及员工各自法律责任

snapshot.en: MSOs and their officers and staff each have responsibilities under these different laws, and it is very important that they understand them fully.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者及它們的主管人員和職員均須充分了解他們在這些法例之下的各種責任，這點至為重要。

tested.point: 雇员/管理参与人致使或准许违法的个人责任

snapshot.en: A person concerned in the management of a financial institution who, with intent to defraud the institution, causes it to contravene a specified provision commits an offence.
snapshot.tc: 關涉金融機構的管理的人，如出於詐騙該機構的意圖而致使該機構違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪。

snapshot.en: An employee charged with causing the institution, with intent to defraud, to contravene a specified provision has a defence if he or she proves following its compliance policies and procedures.
snapshot.tc: 僱員被控出於詐騙意圖而致使金融機構違反指明的條文，如證明其作為是按照該機構為確保遵從而設立的政策及程序，即可作免責辯護。

tested.point: 制裁/TF/PF责任及指导

snapshot.en: The legal and regulatory obligations of the MSO and those of its staff should be well understood, and adequate guidance and training should be provided to its staff.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者及其職員均應充分了解本身的法律及監管責任，而職員亦應獲提供充足的導引及培訓。

tested.point: 内部及时报告与个人义务完成

snapshot.en: Clear policies and procedures should be in place to ensure that all internal reports must reach the MLRO without undue delay.
snapshot.tc: 清晰的政策和程序應確保所有內部報告必須送達洗錢報告主任，不得出現無故延誤。

snapshot.en: A staff member who has reported a suspicion to the MLRO under the MSO's procedures has fully satisfied his statutory obligation.
snapshot.tc: 職員若已按既定政策和程序向洗錢報告主任報告所懷疑事項，即已完全履行有關法定規定。

tested.point: 识别MLRO、程序、报告足够资料

snapshot.en: The MSO's policies and procedures should ensure that all staff are made aware of the identity of the MLRO and of the procedures for making an internal report.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的政策和程序應確保全體職員均知悉洗錢報告主任的身分，以及作出內部報告時應依循的程序。

snapshot.en: An internal report that staff make to the MLRO should include sufficient details of the customer concerned and the information giving rise to the suspicion.
snapshot.tc: 職員向洗錢報告主任作出的內部報告，應包括有關客戶的充分詳情，以及導致產生懷疑的全部資料。

tested.point: 按交易场景获得识别指导

snapshot.en: An MSO should provide sufficient guidance to its staff and agents (if applicable) to enable them to form suspicion or recognise the signs when ML/TF/PF is taking place.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應為職員及代理人（如適用）提供充足導引，讓他們在發生洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集情況時能產生懷疑或辨別出來。

snapshot.en: The guidance should take into account the nature of the transactions and customer instructions staff are likely to encounter, the type of product or service and the means of delivery.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者為職員提供的導引，應顧及職員可能遇到的交易及客戶指示性質、產品或服務類別及交付方式。

tested.point: 培训主体、初训/复训、责任及新手法

snapshot.en: It is the MSO's responsibility to provide adequate training for its staff to implement its AML/CFT Systems.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者有責任提供充分培訓，使職員足以執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: New staff should be required to attend initial training as soon as possible after being hired or appointed.
snapshot.tc: 新職員獲聘用或委任後，金錢服務經營者應要求他們盡快接受初步培訓。

snapshot.en: Apart from initial training, the MSO should also provide refresher training to its staff at least once a year.
snapshot.tc: 除安排初步培訓外，金錢服務經營者亦應最少每年為職員舉辦一次複修培訓。

snapshot.en: Staff should be made aware of the possible consequences for their failure to report suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應促使職員留意他們因未能舉報可疑交易而可能需要承擔的後果。

snapshot.en: Staff should be made aware of new and emerging ML/TF techniques and trends, to the extent needed for their particular roles.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員在其特定職責所需的範圍內，留意洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的嶄新及新興技巧及趨勢。

tested.point: 培训匹配岗位及检验理解

snapshot.en: The scope and frequency of training should be tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the staff's job functions, responsibilities and experience.
snapshot.tc: 培訓的範疇及頻密程度應切合金錢服務經營者面對的特定風險，並應顧及有關職員的職能、職責及經驗。

snapshot.en: An MSO should implement a clear and well articulated policy for ensuring that its relevant staff receive adequate training on AML/CFT matters.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應實施清晰及明確的政策，確保在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面為有關職員提供充分培訓。

snapshot.en: Staff should know the possible consequences of failing to comply with the CDD and record-keeping requirements laid down in the DTROP, as well as their own and their MSO's statutory obligations.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員留意未能遵守《販毒（追討得益）條例》所訂的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定的可能後果，以及本身及金錢服務經營者的法定責任。

snapshot.en: One way to monitor the effectiveness of training is to test staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF and their ability to recognise suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 監察培訓效用的方法之一，是測試職員對金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策及程序的理解，以及他們辨認可疑交易的能力。

tested.point: 所有新员工背景培训

snapshot.en: All new staff, whatever their seniority, may be given an introduction to the background to ML/TF and to the importance that the MSO places on ML/TF.
snapshot.tc: 不論資歷，所有新職員均可接受有關洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的背景，以及金錢服務經營者對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集問題的重視的簡介。

tested.point: 个人法律责任及内部程序

snapshot.en: The ordinances under which staff should be made aware of statutory and regulatory obligations concerning their MSO and themselves, and of the possible consequences of breaches, include the WMD(CPS)O.
snapshot.tc: 應促使職員留意與其本身及金錢服務經營者有關的法定及監管責任以及違反的可能後果，所涉條例包括《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT policies and procedures of the MSO, including those for identifying and reporting suspicious transactions, are among the matters of which staff should be made aware.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的政策及程序（包括如何識別及舉報可疑交易），屬應促使職員留意的事項。

rows.notes: 只审主体责任，不在此复审所有刑罚数值；新员工非仅前线，也不受资历限制。

rows.name: 前线／直接接触公众员工

points: 潜在洗钱者第一接触点；须获与岗位相关CDD/记录程序训练及识别疑点、报告线和加强警觉训练

tested.point: 第一接触角色

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public may be trained on the importance of their roles as the first point of contact with potential money launderers.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員，可接受有關其作為與潛在洗錢人第一個接觸點的重要性的培訓。

tested.point: CDD/记录与疑点/报告/警觉

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel, may be trained on the MSO's policies and procedures for the CDD and record-keeping requirements relevant to their job responsibilities.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）可接受培訓，認識金錢服務經營者在客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄方面與其職責相關的政策及程序。

snapshot.en: Staff dealing directly with the public may be trained in circumstances that may give rise to suspicion and in the relevant policies and procedures, such as lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required.
snapshot.tc: 與公眾有直接接觸的職員可就可能出現可疑交易的情況及相關政策及程序接受培訓，例如報告的流程及應何時提高額外警覺。

tested.point: 不可把管理层全制度高级训练归作前线特定要求

snapshot.en: Higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime is identified as appropriate for staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel.
snapshot.tc: 涵蓋金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度各方面的更高層次培訓，被列為或適用於與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）。

rows.name: 后台员工

points: 按职责接受客户核实及处理程序培训；识别异常结算、付款或交付指示

tested.point: 客户核实及相关流程

snapshot.en: Back-office staff, depending on their roles, may be trained on appropriate customer verification and relevant processing procedures.
snapshot.tc: 後勤職員可視乎他們的職責，接受有關客戶核實及相關處理程序的適當培訓。

tested.point: 异常活动识别

snapshot.en: Back-office staff, depending on their roles, may be trained on how to recognise unusual activities, including abnormal settlements, payments or delivery instructions.
snapshot.tc: 後勤職員（視乎他們的職責）可接受如何識別不尋常活動的培訓，包括不正常的結算、付款及交付指示。

rows.name: 主管／经理及管理人员

points: 可在报告前供员工咨询，但无报告/合规职责者不得过滤报告；尽量缩短报告链
管理人员受全制度高层次训练和监督员工、审计/抽查、报告训练

tested.point: 咨询不等于过滤报告

snapshot.en: Under no circumstances should supervisors or managers without ML reporting or compliance responsibility filter out staff reports.
snapshot.tc: 在任何情況下，非負責洗錢報告／合規職能的主管或經理均不得過濾職員所提交的報告。

snapshot.en: An MSO may set up internal systems that allow staff to consult supervisors or managers before sending a report to the MLRO.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可建立內部制度，讓職員向洗錢報告主任發送報告前先諮詢其主管或經理。

tested.point: 不代替MLRO确认报告及短报告线

snapshot.en: Upon an internal report, the reporting staff member's supervisor should acknowledge its receipt and remind the staff member of the obligation regarding tipping off.
snapshot.tc: 職員作出內部報告後，其主管必須確認收到報告，並提醒報告的職員在責任上不可作出通風報訊。

snapshot.en: Because the legal obligation is to report as soon as it is reasonable to do so, short reporting lines are meant to ensure speed, confidentiality and accessibility to the MLRO.
snapshot.tc: 因法律責任是在合理範圍內盡快作出報告，報告流程應盡可能縮短，確保報告能迅速、保密及無障礙地送交洗錢報告主任。

tested.point: 审计/随机抽查培训

snapshot.en: Managerial staff, including internal audit officers, may be given specific training on auditing the system and performing random checks.
snapshot.tc: 經理級人員（包括內部審計人員）可接受涵蓋系統審查及進行隨機抽查職責的特定培訓。

tested.point: 高级训练对象区别前线

snapshot.en: Higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime is identified as appropriate for staff dealing directly with the public, such as front-line personnel.
snapshot.tc: 涵蓋金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度各方面的更高層次培訓，被列為或適用於與公眾有直接接觸的職員（例如前線工作人員）。

tested.point: 管理/监督及JFIU报告培训

snapshot.en: The specific training that may be appropriate for managerial staff, including internal audit officers and COs, includes training on supervising or managing staff and on reporting suspicious transactions to the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 或適用於經理級人員（包括內部審計人員及合規主任）的特定培訓，包括涵蓋監督或管理職員及向關長舉報可疑交易的職責的培訓。

rows.notes: 实际任CO或MLRO的主管仍按相应职责办事，不把所有管理者都视为不能参与。

rows.name: 海外分行／附属公司／集团职能

points: 本地注册MSO有分支须集团评估；评估反映本地风险
集团适用相关指引及类似CDD/记录；保密防通风报信下按必要性双向共享；所在地容许则从高，不能时通知CCE加措施
海外办事处可维持名单或筛查，但MSO最终责任不转移

tested.point: 本地注册主体的集团风险评估及依赖其他评估须反映本地风险

snapshot.en: An MSO with branches or subsidiaries should perform a group-wide ML/TF risk assessment even if it is incorporated outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 設有分行或附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，即使在香港以外成立為法團，亦應進行集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。

snapshot.en: An MSO that is part of a financial group may refer to or rely on a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment once one has been conducted.
snapshot.tc: 屬金融集團成員的金錢服務經營者，可參考或依賴在集團或地區層面已進行的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估。

tested.point: 集团风险评估与本地反映

snapshot.en: It applies for the purposes of both the institutional ML/TF risk assessment in paragraph 2.2 and the group-wide ML/TF risk assessment in paragraph 2.7
snapshot.tc: 該項依賴為施行第2.2及2.7段（機構層面及集團層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估）而適用

snapshot.en: It applies where the MSO is part of a financial group and a group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment has been conducted
snapshot.tc: 該項依賴適用於該經營者屬某金融集團的成員，而在集團或地區層面已進行有關風險評估的情況

snapshot.en: The MSO may make reference to, or place reliance on, the financial group’s group-wide or regional ML/TF risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可參考或依賴所屬金融集團在集團或地區層面所進行的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估

snapshot.en: Such reliance is permitted only where the assessment adequately reflects the ML/TF risks that are posed to the MSO in the local context
snapshot.tc: 惟有關評估須充分反映該經營者在本地層面所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，方可如此依賴

tested.point: 集团适用范围

snapshot.en: The requirement applies to every MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings, whether or not the MSO is incorporated in Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 該規定適用於所有設有外地分行或附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，不論該經營者是否在香港成立為法團

snapshot.en: It applies where the overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO
snapshot.tc: 該規定適用於外地分行或附屬企業經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的情況

snapshot.en: Subject to host laws and regulations, group-wide Systems should apply the Guideline's relevant and applicable requirements to all overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings in the financial group
snapshot.tc: 在當地法律及規例准許的範圍內，集團層面制度應向金融集團所有外地分行及附屬企業執行相關及適用的指引規定

snapshot.en: Where a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ, the MSO should require the branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets, so far as host laws permit
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的規定有所不同，須規定分行或附屬企業在當地法律准許的範圍內執行兩者中較嚴格的規定

tested.point: 海外CDD及纪录

snapshot.en: The duty applies to a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO and is discharged through its own group-wide AML/CFT Systems in place
snapshot.tc: 該責任適用於在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者，並透過其集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度履行

snapshot.en: It covers all of the MSO's overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings which carry on the same business as an FI as that term is defined in the AMLO
snapshot.tc: 該責任涵蓋該經營者經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的外地分行及附屬企業

snapshot.en: Those branches and subsidiaries should have procedures for CDD and record-keeping rules similar to Schedule 2 Parts 2–3, as far as local law permits
snapshot.tc: 該等分行及附屬企業應設程序，在當地法律准許範圍內遵從與附表2第2及3部類似的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定

snapshot.en: Those procedures must be applied in full regardless of what the laws and regulations of the place concerned permit
snapshot.tc: 不論有關所在地方的法律及規例是否有所准許，該等有關的程序均須全面地予以貫徹實施

tested.point: 共享前提/内容

snapshot.en: The measures are required only to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of the jurisdictions that are involved in the matter
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者透過集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度實施資料共用措施，以所涉司法管轄區法律及規例准許為限

snapshot.en: The measures are subject to adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of the information being shared, including safeguards to prevent tipping off
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者實施集團層面的資料共用措施，須妥善保障共用資料的保密需要及用途，包括設有防止通風報訊的保障

snapshot.en: The measures should provide for the sharing of information required for the purposes of CDD and ML/TF risk management within the group
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的集團層面資料共用措施，應涵蓋為客戶盡職審查及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理目的所需的資料

snapshot.en: The group-level compliance, audit or AML/CFT functions should receive customer, account and transaction information from overseas branches when necessary for AML/CFT purposes
snapshot.tc: 集團合規、審核或打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集職能應按打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集需要獲提供外地分行的客戶、帳戶及交易資料

tested.point: 异常分析、STR及双向共享

snapshot.en: The information should include information and analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual, where such analysis was done
snapshot.tc: 該等資料應包括似乎異常的交易或活動的相關資料及分析（如已作這類分析）

snapshot.en: A suspicious transaction report, or the fact that one has been submitted, may be provided to group-level functions only after the JFIU gives its consent
snapshot.tc: 可疑交易報告或已提交報告一事，須先取得財富情報組的同意，才可交予集團層面的職能

snapshot.en: The information could also include the underlying information that lies behind any such suspicious transaction report itself
snapshot.tc: 該等資料亦可以包括任何有關可疑交易報告背後所依據的相關資料

snapshot.en: Branches and subsidiary undertakings should likewise receive such information from the group-level functions when relevant and appropriate to risk management
snapshot.tc: 在與風險管理有關及適用的情況下，分支機構及附屬企業亦應從該等集團層面職能取得這類資料

tested.point: 较高标准

snapshot.en: The position concerns the overseas branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO and the jurisdiction in which it is located, referred to as the host jurisdiction
snapshot.tc: 該情況關乎在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，以及其位處的司法管轄區（即所在的司法管轄區）

snapshot.en: Where requirements differ, the MSO should require its branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher standard to the extent permitted by host laws and regulations
snapshot.tc: 如兩套規定有所不同，金錢服務經營者應規定外地分行或附屬企業在當地法律及規例准許的範圍內執行較嚴格的規定

snapshot.en: The branch or the subsidiary undertaking is required to apply the higher requirements to the extent that the host jurisdiction's own laws and regulations permit
snapshot.tc: 外地分行或附屬企業執行兩套規定中較嚴格的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定，以所在司法管轄區法律及規例准許為限

snapshot.en: Where the host jurisdiction's requirements are the less stringent of the two, the branch or subsidiary undertaking may choose to follow them instead
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的有關規定是兩套規定中較為寬鬆者，外地分行或附屬企業可選擇改為遵從該套較寬鬆的規定

tested.point: 不能执行时通知及措施

snapshot.en: The requirement applies where the laws of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements
snapshot.tc: 有關規定適用於在香港成立為法團的經營者的外地分行或附屬企業，因所在地法律不准許而未能執行較嚴格規定的情況

snapshot.en: The MSO informs the CCE of the failure in its next routine filing, having first recorded the failure and its causes in its own internal records
snapshot.tc: 該經營者會在下一次例行提交資料時將該情況通知關長，並先在其內部記錄該情況及其成因

snapshot.en: The requirements of particular concern are the CDD and record-keeping requirements that are imposed under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2
snapshot.tc: 尤其受關注的規定，是根據附表2第2及3部所施加的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定

snapshot.en: The MSO should take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced by the branch or subsidiary undertaking as a result of its inability to comply with the requirements
snapshot.tc: 該經營者應採取額外措施，以有效地減低分行或附屬企業因不能遵從該等規定而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

tested.point: 不得月度固定分享替代必要性

snapshot.en: Through the group-wide Systems, the MSO should apply the Guideline's requirements to every overseas branch and subsidiary undertaking in its financial group, wherever relevant and applicable.
snapshot.tc: 集團層面的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，應在本指引的規定關乎及適用時，對所有屬其金融集團的外地分行及附屬企業執行相關規定。

snapshot.en: The information provided to the MSO's group-level functions could include a suspicious transaction report or the fact that one has been submitted.
snapshot.tc: 交予集團層面的合規及審核等職能的資料，亦可以包括可疑交易報告或已提交可疑交易報告一事。

snapshot.en: The MSO should inform the CCE whenever the AML/CFT requirements of a host jurisdiction differ from those set out in the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定與本指引有差異，金錢服務經營者便應通知關長。

snapshot.en: If a host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ, the MSO should have the branch or subsidiary apply whichever set is higher, to the extent the host's laws and regulations permit.
snapshot.tc: 如所在的司法管轄區的規定有所不同，金錢服務經營者應規定分行或附屬企業於當地法律及規例准許的範圍內執行較嚴格者。

snapshot.en: Subject to the laws involved and to safeguards, group-level functions should receive the overseas branches' customer, account and transaction information monthly.
snapshot.tc: 在法律准許及設有妥善保障的情況下，集團層面的職能應每月收取外地分行的客戶、帳戶及交易資料。

tested.point: 海外筛查不转移MSO最终责任

snapshot.en: Where an MSO relies on its overseas office to maintain the database or undertake screening, the ultimate responsibility for compliance no longer rests with the MSO but with that office.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如依賴其在外地的辦事處備存數據庫或執行篩查程序，確保相關法規獲遵守的最終責任便不再由其承擔，而轉由該辦事處承擔。

rows.notes: 迁册实体按B40。相关外地FI受集团独立复核的特殊要求见RG023，不把一般集团信息共享当成该项覆盖。

rows.name: 代理／外判实体／交易对手

points: 代理外判按MSO程序及管控执行CDD，区别独立第三方中介自用程序
代理网络构成风险因素；员工和代理获识别可疑指导；代理交易异常比较及电汇所在地要求

tested.point: 外判/代理与独立中介的程序与控制区别

snapshot.en: Reliance on intermediaries does not apply to outsourcing or agency relationships, in which the outsourced entity or agent applies CDD measures under the MSO's own procedures and control.
snapshot.tc: 外判或代理關係不視作依賴中介人；在這些關係中，外判實體或代理按照金錢服務經營者的程序代其執行盡職審查措施，並接受其管控。

snapshot.en: In a third-party reliance scenario, the third party usually has an existing business relationship with the customer, independent of the one with the relying MSO, and applies its own CDD procedures.
snapshot.tc: 依賴第三方時，第三方通常已與客戶建立既有的業務關係（獨立於客戶與該金錢服務經營者的關係），並按本身的程序執行盡職審查措施。

tested.point: 适用于代理的可疑识别指导

snapshot.en: An MSO should provide sufficient guidance to its staff and agents (if applicable) to enable them to form suspicion or recognise the signs when ML/TF/PF is taking place.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應為職員及代理人（如適用）提供充足導引，讓他們在發生洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集情況時能產生懷疑或辨別出來。

snapshot.en: The guidance should take into account the nature of the transactions and customer instructions staff are likely to encounter, the type of product or service and the means of delivery.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者為職員提供的導引，應顧及職員可能遇到的交易及客戶指示性質、產品或服務類別及交付方式。

tested.point: 同日多代理交易

snapshot.en: Transmission of funds by the same customer within the same week to several agents or counterparts of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 同一客戶於同一星期內，向多個金錢服務經營者代理人或交易對手地點傳送資金

tested.point: 代理的异常量与同地区其他代理比较

snapshot.en: An agent or counterpart of the MSO with a high volume of large or suspicious transactions in comparison to its own transactions in previous years
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的代理人或交易對手進行大量的大額或可疑交易，有別於其本身在以往年度所進行的交易

tested.point: 直接或透过代理经营仍按所在地及电汇角色履责

snapshot.en: An MSO should follow the relevant wire transfer requirements in the jurisdictions in which it operates, directly or through its agents, with regard to its role in a wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應就其在電傳轉帳中擔當的角色，在其直接營運或通過代理人營運的司法管轄區遵從相關的電傳轉帳規定。

rows.notes: 02未赋予代理独立取代MSO的监管责任；也不把代理与PPTA或独立CDD中介混同。

rows.name: CDD中介人／相关外地金融机构

points: 可受委托执行部分CDD，自用程序且客户关系独立；MSO仍负最终责任；须书面同意并及时供资料/文件
国内/海外/集团相关FI资格及监督条件；记录保存、查询提供和结束服务交付
不得代MSO承担持续监察责任，但可协助更新资料

tested.point: 同意、提供与最终责任

snapshot.en: The MSO may carry out a measure by means of the intermediary only if the intermediary consents in writing to be the MSO's intermediary.
snapshot.tc: 只有在中介人藉書面同意擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人的情況下，金錢服務經營者才可藉著該中介人執行措施。

snapshot.en: The MSO must be satisfied that, when asked, the intermediary will hand over without delay a copy or record of what it obtained in carrying out the measure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須信納，中介人在接到要求時，會毫不延誤地交出其在執行措施時取得的文件複本或數據資料紀錄。

snapshot.en: Using an intermediary does not relieve the MSO of liability under the AMLO for a failure to carry out the customer due diligence measure.
snapshot.tc: 藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施，並不免除金錢服務經營者根據《打擊洗錢條例》就未有執行措施所負的法律責任。

snapshot.en: Immediately after the intermediary carries out a measure, the MSO must obtain the data or information obtained, but need not get copies of documents at the same time.
snapshot.tc: 在中介人執行措施之後，金錢服務經營者須立刻取得中介人取得的數據或資料，但無需同時取得任何文件的複本。

snapshot.en: The MSO must ensure that the intermediary will, if asked within the record-keeping period, provide copies or records of what it obtained as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須確保，如在備存紀錄期間內提出要求，中介人會在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快提供其取得的文件複本或紀錄。

tested.point: 国内/海外类别及条件

snapshot.en: An accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional or TCSP licensee can be the MSO's intermediary only if able to satisfy it that adequate procedures to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing are in place.
snapshot.tc: 會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士或信託或公司服務持牌人，須能令金錢服務經營者信納其有充分程序防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集，方可擔任該經營者的中介人。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, a lawyer, notary public, auditor or tax advisor practising in an equivalent jurisdiction must be supervised for compliance with the requirements by a relevant authority in Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區執業的律師、公證人、核數師或稅務顧問如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，須在遵從有關規定方面受到香港的有關當局監管。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, a trust company carrying on trust business in an equivalent jurisdiction must be required by that jurisdiction's law to be registered or licensed, or be regulated under that law.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區經營信託業務的信託公司如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，該司法管轄區的法律須規定其註冊或領牌，或其須受該法律規管。

snapshot.en: To be the MSO's intermediary, an institution doing business in an equivalent jurisdiction similar to an authorized institution's must have measures to ensure compliance with requirements similar to the AMLO's due diligence and record-keeping ones.
snapshot.tc: 在對等司法管轄區經營與認可機構相類似業務的機構如要擔任金錢服務經營者的中介人，須已有措施確保遵從與《打擊洗錢條例》的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定。

tested.point: 相关外地FI身份、集团监督与政策

snapshot.en: An institution in the same group of companies as the MSO that carries on, outside Hong Kong, a business similar to an authorized institution's can be a related foreign financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 與金錢服務經營者屬同一公司集團、並在香港以外地方經營與認可機構所經營者相類似的業務的機構，可屬相關外地金融機構。

snapshot.en: For an MSO incorporated in Hong Kong, its own branch carrying on, outside Hong Kong, a business similar to an authorized institution's can be a related foreign financial institution.
snapshot.tc: 就在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者而言，其在香港以外地方經營與認可機構相類似業務的分行，可屬相關外地金融機構。

snapshot.en: To be relied on, a related foreign financial institution must be supervised at a group level by a relevant authority, or by an authority in an equivalent jurisdiction performing like functions for the MSO's holding company or head office.
snapshot.tc: 相關外地金融機構如要獲依賴，須在集團層面受有關當局監管，或受對等司法管轄區就該經營者的控權公司或總行執行類似有關當局職能的主管當局監管。

snapshot.en: Where its intermediary is a related foreign financial institution, the MSO must take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved.
snapshot.tc: 如所藉的中介人屬相關外地金融機構，金錢服務經營者須採取合理措施，以減低涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。

snapshot.en: To be relied on, a related foreign financial institution must be required by group policy to have measures for compliance with requirements like the AMLO's due diligence and record-keeping ones, and to run programmes against ML/TF.
snapshot.tc: 相關外地金融機構如要獲依賴，須按集團政策設有措施確保遵從與《打擊洗錢條例》盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定，並須針對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集實施計劃。

tested.point: 独立中介与代理、保留、结束服务承诺、疑问重做及抽查

snapshot.en: Reliance on intermediaries does not apply to outsourcing or agency relationships, in which the outsourced entity or agent applies CDD measures under the MSO's own procedures and control.
snapshot.tc: 外判或代理關係不視作依賴中介人；在這些關係中，外判實體或代理按照金錢服務經營者的程序代其執行盡職審查措施，並接受其管控。

snapshot.en: Where the intermediary keeps the underlying CDD documents and records, the MSO should obtain its undertaking to keep them for at least five years from the date it carried out the CDD measures.
snapshot.tc: 如相關文件及紀錄由中介人備存，金錢服務經營者須向中介人取得承諾，由其執行盡職審查措施當日起計至少5年內備存所有相關資料。

snapshot.en: The MSO should secure the intermediary's undertaking that, if it is about to cease trading or stops acting as the MSO's intermediary, it will supply copies of all underlying CDD information.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須取得中介人的承諾：中介人如即將結業或不再以中介人身分代其行事，便會提供所有相關盡職審查資料的複本。

snapshot.en: If the MSO has any doubts about the CDD measures that the intermediary carried out previously, it should require the intermediary to perform the required CDD again as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者對中介人先前執行的盡職審查措施有任何懷疑，便須要求中介人在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快重新執行所需的盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: In a third-party reliance scenario, the third party usually has an existing business relationship with the customer, independent of the one with the relying MSO, and applies its own CDD procedures.
snapshot.tc: 依賴第三方時，第三方通常已與客戶建立既有的業務關係（獨立於客戶與該金錢服務經營者的關係），並按本身的程序執行盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: To make sure that an intermediary produces CDD information and documentation upon demand and without undue delay, an MSO should conduct sample tests from time to time.
snapshot.tc: 為確保其所依賴的中介人會應要求盡快提供客戶盡職審查的資料及文件，金錢服務經營者應不時就此進行抽樣測試。

tested.point: 记录最终责任与即时资料/终止交付

snapshot.en: Where the intermediary holds the customer identification and verification documents, the MSO remains responsible for compliance with all record-keeping requirements.
snapshot.tc: 如中介人持有客戶的識別及核實文件，金錢服務經營者仍有責任遵守所有備存紀錄的規定。

snapshot.en: The MSO should make sure the intermediary it relies on has systems to comply with every record-keeping requirement of the AMLO and the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保中介人已設立系統，以遵從打擊洗錢條例及指引下所有備存紀錄的規定。

snapshot.en: The MSO should make sure the intermediary will provide documents and records as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the MSO's request.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保中介人會在收到其要求後，盡快在合理地切實可行的範圍內提供文件及紀錄。

snapshot.en: The MSO should immediately obtain the data or information that the intermediary has obtained in the course of carrying out the CDD measure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應立刻取得中介人在執行盡職審查措施時取得的數據或資料。

snapshot.en: The MSO should ensure that the intermediary will pass the documents and records to the MSO upon termination of the intermediary's services.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保中介人在終止提供服務後，會將文件及紀錄交回金錢服務經營者。

tested.point: 可以代收及协调更新资料

snapshot.en: An MSO may use an intermediary to collect further documents, data and information, and to provide or coordinate updates, to help keep its CDD records up-to-date and relevant.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可藉中介人收集進一步的文件、數據和資料，及提供或協調相關更新，以協助確保其盡職審查紀錄反映現況及仍屬相關。

untested.point: 不得依赖中介持续监察客户关系；可代收更新资料不等于承接持续监察责任
untested.quote_en: an MSO cannot rely on an intermediary to continuously monitor its business relationship with a customer
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務經營者不可為遵從附表2第5條的規定而依賴中介人持續監察該金錢服務經營者與客戶的業務關係

rows.notes: 角色界线缺口与旧G043/FAQ Q22合并。国内专业人士是否就该客户受附表2约束、集团独立复核等资格细节另见G044/RG023，不以本行声称所有资格均完备。

rows.name: 身分文件认证人／证明人

points: 独立合适且看过原件；签署/日期/大楷姓名/身分职衔，并声明真确副本
合适例子含指定中介、对等司法管辖区司法人員、发证国使领馆人员、太平绅士、会计师/律师/公证人/特许秘书
原则不可客户自证；法人客户内部专业人士受专业操守并以专业身分认证可例外；MSO仍负责并处理真确性疑虑

tested.point: 见原件、署名日期等、使领馆例子、原则不自证及高风险审慎

snapshot.en: Certification by an independent and appropriate person is effective only if the certifier has seen the original documentation.
snapshot.tc: 由獨立的合適人選認證身分核實文件時，證明人須查閱文件正本，認證才屬有效。

snapshot.en: The certifier should sign and date the copy document, print his or her name clearly in capitals underneath, and clearly indicate his or her position or capacity on it.
snapshot.tc: 證明人必須在文件的複本上簽署並寫上日期，在下方以大楷清楚列示其姓名，並清楚註明其職位或身分。

snapshot.en: An officer of an embassy, consulate or high commission of the country of issue of the identification document is among the examples of appropriate certifiers.
snapshot.tc: 發出身分核實文件的國家的大使館、領事館或高級專員公署的人員，是合適證明人的例子之一。

snapshot.en: In general, it is not sufficient for copies of identification documents to be self-certified by the customer whose identity is being verified.
snapshot.tc: 一般來說，由客戶自行認證其身分核實文件的複本，並不足以達到認證的目的。

snapshot.en: The MSO must exercise caution in accepting certified copies, especially where they originate from a country perceived to represent a high risk or from unregulated entities.
snapshot.tc: 接納經認證的文件複本時必須審慎行事，特別是文件來自被視為涉及高風險的國家或不受監管的實體時。

tested.point: 独立认证作为补充措施

snapshot.en: Supplementary measures may include using an independent and appropriate person to certify identification documents, or checking relevant data against reliable databases or registries.
snapshot.tc: 增補措施可包括由獨立的合適人選認證身分證明文件，或根據可靠的數據庫或登記冊核對相關數據。

untested.point: 必须声明是真确副本，不能只有签名、日期和身分
untested.quote_en: The certifier should state that it is a true copy of the original
untested.quote_tc: 證明人必須說明該複本文件為正本文件的真確複本

untested.point: 客户内部专业人士认证例外的两个条件：受专业操守约束且以专业身分认证
untested.quote_en: if that professional person is subject to the professional conduct requirements of a relevant professional body, and has certified the copy documents in his or her professional capacity
untested.quote_tc: 惟該專業人士本身須遵守相關專業團體的專業操守規定，並已經以其專業身分認證該等文件複本

untested.point: 对等司法管辖区司法人員、太平绅士及其他专业认证人类别未直接辨识；只测使领馆人员不足覆盖完整候选类别
untested.quote_en: a member of the judiciary in an equivalent jurisdiction
untested.quote_tc: 在對等司法管轄區的司法人員

rows.notes: 类别缺口包括指定中介、JP、会计师/律师/公证人/特许秘书，可在一题比较，不建议逐个职位凑题。ICSA/指定分部仅在脚注解释特许秘书资格；不推导其宏观职能。公证人/律师也可用于CDD中介，但两种角色条件不互相替代。

rows.name: 交易监察及调查人员

points: 须及时获得充分资料，以识别、分析和有效监察客户交易

untested.point: 系统须向执行监察与调查的相关人员提供及时、充分资料；CO/MLRO一般资料权不覆盖本岗位
untested.quote_en: provide all relevant staff who are tasked with conducting transaction monitoring and investigation with timely and sufficient information
untested.quote_tc: 向所有負責執行交易監察及調查的相關職員提供適時而充分的資料

rows.notes: m5-18#4主语为CO/MLRO；m6-347测系统设计因素，均未直接测试本岗位的资料保障。

rows.name: 电汇汇款机构／ordering institution

points: 按所担任角色及所在地规定履责；MSO本人是汇款/收款人时非这类机构
收集并随电汇传递分金额所需资料、>=8000确保汇款人资料准确；特定低额不必核实但怀疑或关联门槛例外
批次/本地汇款简化信息须可追溯；请求后三营业日补齐、执法机关即时；控制与测试防资料缺失

tested.point: 角色、同一机构两端、本人转账及cover payments

snapshot.en: An MSO should follow the relevant wire transfer requirements in the jurisdictions in which it operates, directly or through its agents, with regard to its role in a wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應就其在電傳轉帳中擔當的角色，在其直接營運或通過代理人營運的司法管轄區遵從相關的電傳轉帳規定。

snapshot.en: The beneficiary institution of a wire transfer may be the ordering institution itself, for example where the transfer is conducted between branches of the same MSO.
snapshot.tc: 電傳轉帳的收款機構可以是匯款機構本身，例如在同一金錢服務經營者的分行之間進行的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: An MSO that is itself the originator or the recipient of a wire transfer is not acting as an ordering, intermediary or beneficiary institution, so the wire transfer requirements do not bind it for that transaction.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者本身是電傳轉帳的匯款人或收款人時，並非以匯款機構、中介機構或收款機構的身分行事，因此無需就該交易遵守電傳轉帳規定。

snapshot.en: The wire transfer requirements of Schedule 2 and the Guideline also apply to wire transfers that use a cover payment mechanism, of which MT202COV payments are given as an example.
snapshot.tc: 附表2及指引的電傳轉帳規定，亦適用於採用直接撥付機制的電傳轉帳，以MT202COV付款即為其中一例。

tested.point: 低额所需资料的角色义务

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the originator's address before carrying it out.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄匯款人的地址。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the MSO need not record the recipient's name before carrying it out.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，金錢服務經營者在進行轉賬前無須記錄收款人的姓名或名稱。

snapshot.en: For a wire transfer below $8,000, the message or payment form accompanying it need include only the originator's details.
snapshot.tc: 就涉及$8,000以下款額的電傳轉賬而言，附隨該項轉賬的信息或付款表格只須包括匯款人的資料。

tested.point: 资料编号分工、国内/批次及补资料时点

snapshot.en: Where the originator has no account with the MSO from which the money for the transfer is paid, the MSO must record a unique reference number that it assigns to the wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人並無在該金錢服務經營者開立作為電傳轉賬所付金錢來源的戶口，該經營者須記錄由其本身編配予該電傳轉賬的獨特參考編號。
