snapshot.tc: 相關外地金融機構如要獲依賴，須按集團政策設有措施確保遵從與《打擊洗錢條例》盡職審查及備存紀錄規定相類似的規定，並須針對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集實施計劃。

tested.point: MSO 保留责任

snapshot.en: Using an intermediary does not relieve the MSO of liability under the AMLO for a failure to carry out the customer due diligence measure.
snapshot.tc: 藉著中介人執行客戶盡職審查措施，並不免除金錢服務經營者根據《打擊洗錢條例》就未有執行措施所負的法律責任。

tested.point: 依赖第三方和外判代理的区别

snapshot.en: Reliance on intermediaries does not apply to outsourcing or agency relationships, in which the outsourced entity or agent applies CDD measures under the MSO's own procedures and control.
snapshot.tc: 外判或代理關係不視作依賴中介人；在這些關係中，外判實體或代理按照金錢服務經營者的程序代其執行盡職審查措施，並接受其管控。

snapshot.en: In a third-party reliance scenario, the third party usually has an existing business relationship with the customer, independent of the one with the relying MSO, and applies its own CDD procedures.
snapshot.tc: 依賴第三方時，第三方通常已與客戶建立既有的業務關係（獨立於客戶與該金錢服務經營者的關係），並按本身的程序執行盡職審查措施。

untested.point: 非香港成立且不是迁册实体者，其总行／总行分行也可符合相关外地金融机构定义
untested.quote_en: it is the head office of the financial institution;
untested.quote_tc: 該另一機構是該金融機構的總行；

rows.notes: 源10 S049 已识别同一缺口，勿重复算。迁册者等同香港成立者的分行分支及保险人/保险个人代理/保险代理机构完整本地清单是可合并 P2 子点，银行保险监管专门细则不扩大。本行不把每种合资格中介各算一题。

rows.name: 客户尽职审查 CDD 与看似代表客户行事的人 PPTA

points: CDD 包含客户、BO、关系目的/性质、PPTA 四项；持续监察另为独立义务
PPTA 识别核实身份及核实授权，不自动等于董事、BO或所有签署人
AMLO 要求识别任何 PPTA，未给出封闭职位名单

tested.point: 持续监察不属于法定四项 CDD

snapshot.en: Continuously monitoring a business relationship is a separate duty, and is not one of the measures that the AMLO defines as customer due diligence measures.
snapshot.tc: 持續監察業務關係是另一項獨立的責任，並不屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的客戶盡職審查措施之一。

tested.point: 客户/BO/目的性质及识别来源

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by the relevant authority or by any other relevant authority.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據有關當局或任何其他有關主管當局所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by any other source, so long as that source is reliable and independent.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據任何其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，只要該來源屬可靠及獨立即可。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system, a source the AMLO names.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據認可數碼識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，該系統屬《打擊洗錢條例》所列的來源之一。

snapshot.en: For an MSO, a recognized digital identification system is a digital identification system recognized as a reliable and independent source by the relevant regulatory body.
snapshot.tc: 就金錢服務經營者而言，認可數碼識別系統指獲有關監管機構認可的、屬可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統。

snapshot.en: For any beneficial owner of the customer, the CDD measures call for identifying it and for reasonable measures to verify its identity, so that the MSO is satisfied it knows who that owner is.
snapshot.tc: 就客戶的任何實益擁有人，客戶盡職審查措施規定須識別該實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，使金錢服務經營者信納知道其為何人。

snapshot.en: Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the CDD measures include obtaining information on the purpose and intended nature of the transaction, unless they are obvious.
snapshot.tc: 如將執行非經常交易，客戶盡職審查措施包括取得關於該交易的目的及擬具有的性質的資料，但如有關目的及性質屬顯而易見則除外。

tested.point: PPTA 定义范围、签署人及至少一名代表

snapshot.en: Whether a person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of the person's roles and authorised activities, and the ML/TF risks associated with those roles and activities.
snapshot.tc: 判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Although FATF Recommendation 10 and the AMLO require any PPTA to be identified and verified, neither the FATF Recommendations nor the AMLO defines the scope of a PPTA.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織第10項建議及《打擊洗錢條例》雖要求識別及核實任何看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，但兩者均沒有界定其涵蓋範圍。

snapshot.en: An MSO is not required to identify and verify every authorized signatory of a customer: signatories are only required to be identified and verified if they are PPTAs.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者無須識別及核實客戶的所有獲授權簽署人；僅當獲授權簽署人為看似代表客戶行事的人時，才需要進行識別及核實。

snapshot.en: As a general proposition, each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, namely the person acting on its behalf to establish the business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。

tested.point: 授权、董事和 BO 的区别

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

snapshot.en: The Guideline does not mandate that the natural person be a director or a beneficial owner of the customer, so long as that person has been properly authorised to act on the customer's behalf.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》並沒有強制規定該自然人須為客戶的董事或實益擁有人，只要該自然人已妥善地獲授權代表客戶行事。

rows.notes: 已通过跨单元题句核对；不能因源10题没有逐字展开 PPTA 缩写就报告缺口。

rows.name: 识别文件、认可数码识别系统及迁册实体

source_units.locator: Sch2s1 identification document, recognized digital identification system, re-domiciled entity
points: 个人、香港公司、注册非香港公司、海外法团、香港/海外合伙的法定文件有区别
迁册公司可用迁册证明书；不是注册非香港公司的海外注册证
MSO 的数码识别系统须由有关当局认可，区别专业人士的监管机构
迁册实体是已按公司法迁册并符合原注册地撤销注册条件的实体（技术边界）

tested.point: 个人/公司/合伙/迁册文件

snapshot.en: An individual's certificate of identity or document of identity, as each of those documents is defined in the Immigration Ordinance
snapshot.tc: 個人的身分證明書或簽證身分書（該等文件為《入境條例》所界定者）

snapshot.en: An individual's driving licence, issued to the individual by a governmental body and bearing the individual's own photograph
snapshot.tc: 由政府機構發給個人並載有該名個人本身相片的駕駛執照

snapshot.en: A document issued by a governmental body evidencing the formation or registration of a partnership that does not carry on business in Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 由政府機構發出、證明並無在香港經營業務的合夥成立或註冊的文件

snapshot.en: A registered non-Hong Kong company's certificate of incorporation, issued to it by an authority in the place where it was incorporated
snapshot.tc: 由註冊非香港公司成立為法團所在地方的主管當局發出予該公司的公司註冊證書

snapshot.en: The business registration certificate issued under the Business Registration Ordinance to a partnership that carries on business in Hong Kong
snapshot.tc: 根據《商業登記條例》發出予在香港經營業務的合夥的商業登記證

snapshot.en: A certificate of re-domiciliation issued under the Companies Ordinance in respect of a company as that Ordinance defines the term
snapshot.tc: 根據《公司條例》就該條例所界定的公司發出的遷冊證明書

tested.point: 认可数码系统及认可主体

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system, a source the AMLO names.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據認可數碼識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，該系統屬《打擊洗錢條例》所列的來源之一。

snapshot.en: For an MSO, a recognized digital identification system is a digital identification system recognized as a reliable and independent source by the relevant regulatory body.
snapshot.tc: 就金錢服務經營者而言，認可數碼識別系統指獲有關監管機構認可的、屬可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統。

tested.point: 迁册实体在海外分行规则的适用地位

snapshot.en: These duties bind an MSO that is incorporated in Hong Kong, and they bind in exactly the same way an MSO that is a re-domiciled entity, as the Ordinance defines that term.
snapshot.tc: 在香港成立為法團的金錢服務經營者須負上該等責任，屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的經遷冊實體的金錢服務經營者亦同樣須負上該等責任。

rows.notes: 迁册完整公司法技术条件未独立测试，作为 reference 子点不扩成 P1；相关外地中介定义中迁册分支见 RS040 P2。

rows.name: 洗钱、恐怖分子资金筹集及财产

source_units.locator: Sch1Pt1s1 money laundering, terrorist financing；Sch1Pt2s1 property
points: 洗钱的意图、可公诉罪行收益、间接/部分及境外行为
TF 的筹集/提供财产和服务、意图/明知/罔顾各自门槛不同
terrorist／act／associate 取自 UNATMO，不是 AMLO 自行另建名单
财产不限现金，含动产不动产、将来及或有权益

tested.point: 洗钱完整基本界限

snapshot.en: The definition of money laundering covers property that represents the proceeds of an indictable offence in part, or indirectly, as well as property that is itself such proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 「洗錢」定義所涵蓋的財產，除本身屬可公訴罪行收益的財產外，亦包括部分或間接代表該等收益的財產。

snapshot.en: Proceeds of conduct that would constitute an indictable offence under Hong Kong law, had it occurred in Hong Kong, can be the subject of money laundering as defined.
snapshot.tc: 作出假使在香港發生即屬犯香港法律所訂可公訴罪行的作為而獲取的收益，亦屬「洗錢」定義所涵蓋的收益。

snapshot.en: The definition of money laundering extends to the proceeds of any offence under the laws of Hong Kong, summary offences as well as indictable ones.
snapshot.tc: 「洗錢」的定義涵蓋干犯香港法律所訂任何罪行而獲取的收益，簡易程序罪行與可公訴罪行同樣在內。

snapshot.en: Under the AMLO, money laundering means any act that has the effect of making the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be such proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「洗錢」指具有使可公訴罪行收益看似並非該等收益的效果的任何行為。

tested.point: TF 各定义分支及 UNATMO 交叉释义

snapshot.en: Collecting property knowing that it will be used, in whole or in part, to commit a terrorist act is terrorist financing, whether or not it is actually so used.
snapshot.tc: 知道財產的全部或部分將會用於作出恐怖主義行為而籌集該財產，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集，不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用。

snapshot.en: Providing property by any means, while being reckless as to whether it will be used to commit one or more terrorist acts, is terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 以任何方法提供財產，而罔顧該財產是否會用於作出一項或多於一項恐怖主義行為，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Soliciting financial (or related) services for the benefit of a person, being reckless as to whether the person is a terrorist associate, is terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 罔顧某人是否與恐怖分子有聯繫者，而為該人的利益尋求金融（或有關的）服務，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Making property available to a person known to be a terrorist is terrorist financing, provided that the property is then used to commit a terrorist act.
snapshot.tc: 明知某人是恐怖分子而向該人提供財產，須該財產其後被用於作出恐怖主義行為，方屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Dealing with any property, knowing that it is terrorist property, is one of the acts that the definition of terrorist financing covers.
snapshot.tc: 在知道任何財產屬恐怖分子財產的情況下處理該財產，屬於恐怖分子資金籌集的法定定義所涵蓋的行為之一。

snapshot.en: The meanings of terrorist, terrorist act and terrorist associate in this definition are those given to the terms by the UNATMO.
snapshot.tc: 此定義中的恐怖分子、恐怖主義行為及與恐怖分子有聯繫者，其涵義取自《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》。

tested.point: 将来及或有权益并非排除

snapshot.en: Property includes obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit arising out of or incident to money, goods, choses in action or land, if present and vested.
snapshot.tc: 財產包括金錢、貨品、據法權產或土地所產生或附帶的義務、地役權及各類產業、權益及利潤，但以現有的及既有的為限。

tested.point: 动产不动产、金钱及土地

snapshot.en: For this purpose, “any property” includes both movable and immovable property within the meaning of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance, such as money and land.
snapshot.tc: 就這項責任而言，「任何財產」包括《釋義及通則條例》所指的動產及不動產，例如金錢及土地。

rows.notes: UNATMO 的法院、保安局局长等在源01/02法律框架审计；不把未给定的其他法例全文扩入本源范围。财产逐项历史法律术语不逐字凑题。

rows.name: AMLO、附表与指引的法律性质

points: 法例简称不再带 Financial Institutions 括注
附表2载 CDD/纪录/其他要求；附表3费用、附表4审裁处运行
指引由有关当局/监管机构制定，非附属法例
单独不遵指引不自动产生诉讼责任，但法院及当局须考虑相关条文

tested.point: 现行法例简称

snapshot.en: The Ordinance may be cited by its short title, the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 本條例的簡稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集(金融機構)條例》，本條例可以此引稱。

tested.point: 附表2修订、指引发布/修订及非附属法例

snapshot.en: Schedule 2, which sets out the customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements, may be amended by the Commissioner by notice published in the Gazette.
snapshot.tc: 載有關於就客戶作盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定的附表2，可由關長藉憲報公告予以修訂。

snapshot.en: A relevant authority or a regulatory body may publish in the Gazette any guideline it considers appropriate for giving guidance on the operation of any provision of Schedule 2.
snapshot.tc: 有關當局或監管機構可在憲報公布它認為對就附表2任何條文的施行提供導引屬適當的指引。

snapshot.en: A relevant authority may from time to time amend all or part of a guideline it has published, in a manner consistent with its power to publish that guideline.
snapshot.tc: 有關當局可不時修訂其所公布的指引的全部或任何部分，修訂方式須與其公布該指引的權力相符。

snapshot.en: A guideline published to give guidance on the operation of Schedule 2 is not subsidiary legislation, although it is published in the Gazette by a relevant authority or regulatory body.
snapshot.tc: 有關當局或監管機構為就附表2的施行提供導引而在憲報公布的指引，並不是附屬法例。

tested.point: CCE发布及遵行要求

snapshot.en: The Guideline is issued by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise (CCE), and compliance with the Guideline is enforced through the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 本指引由海關關長（關長）公布，而本指引的遵行情況會按照《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》強制執行。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT standards set out in the Guideline are ones that MSOs may adopt at their discretion in order to comply with the statutory requirements under the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 本指引所載的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集準則，是金錢服務經營者為履行《打擊洗錢條例》的法定規定而可酌情採用的準則。

untested.point: 非附属法例不等于无法律作用：不遵指引本身不自动成罪，但可作证据且法院须考虑相关内容
untested.quote_en:
A failure by any person to comply with a provision in any 
guideline published under this section does not by itself 
render the person liable to any judicial or other proceedings 
but, in any proceedings under this Ordinance before any court, 
the guideline is admissible in evidence; and if any provision 
set out in the guideline appears to the court to be relevant to 
any question arising in the proceedings, the provision must be 
taken into account in determining that question.
untested.quote_tc:
如任何人沒有遵守根據本條公布的指引的條文，此事本
身不會令致該人可在任何司法或其他法律程序中被起訴，
但在根據本條例提起而於任何法院進行的法律程序中，
該指引可獲接納為證據；及如該法院覺得該指引內所列
條文，攸關該法律程序中產生的任何問題，該法院在裁
斷該問題時，須考慮該條文。

untested.point: 有关当局判断有否违反附表2时，也须顾及相关指引
untested.quote_en:
a relevant authority or a regulatory body must 
have regard to any provision in the guideline published under 
this section that is relevant to the requirement.
untested.quote_tc:
有關當局或監管機構在考慮某人有否違反附表2 的條文
時，須顧及根據本條公布的指引內攸關有關規定的任何
條文。

rows.notes: 与主覆盖 S062／G001 为同一缺口，应只合编1题；附表3各费用及附表4完整程序不是本次名词清单新增内容。

rows.name: 订明人士、订明规定及业务处所：例行视察范围

source_units.locator: s8 prescribed person, prescribed requirement, business premises
points: MSO 为金融机构，因此属于可受第9条例行视察的订明人士
MSO 的订明规定以附表2要求为核心，不能把 VAS 的较广行业要求直接套用
MSO 业务处所按获牌经营的处所定义，不能推成任何办业务地点

tested.point: MSO 为例行视察对象

snapshot.en: The authorized person may enter the business premises of the operator at any time, to ascertain whether it is complying with a prescribed requirement.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人可於任何時間進入該經營者的業務處所，以確定其是否正遵從訂明規定。

snapshot.en: The authorized person may require the operator to give access to a specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified by the authorized person.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人可要求該經營者讓其取覽指明業務紀錄，並在其指明的限期內及指明的地點交出該等紀錄。

tested.point: 未来合规、订明规定及业务处所边界

snapshot.en: The inspection powers may be exercised to ascertain whether the operator is likely to be able to comply with a prescribed requirement, not only whether it is complying or has complied.
snapshot.tc: 例行視察可用以確定該經營者是否相當可能有能力遵從訂明規定，而不限於確定其是否正遵從或已遵從該規定。

snapshot.en: For the operator, the prescribed requirements include the requirement not to contravene any provision in a guideline published under the Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 就該經營者而言，訂明規定包括不得違反根據本條例公布的指引中的任何條文的規定。

snapshot.en: For the purposes of routine inspection, the operator's business premises are any premises that it uses in connection with its business of operating a money service.
snapshot.tc: 就例行視察而言，該經營者的業務處所指其在與經營金錢服務的業務有關連的情況下使用的任何處所。

rows.notes: VAS 及有联系实体的订明人士/规定附加类别明确排除；这些仅为 source10 合并法例其他行业范围，不漏算成 MSO 补题。

rows.name: 指明决定与指明当局

points: MSO 指明当局是关长，审裁处对象是法定列明行政决定
牌照条件/续期/撤销、有关人或处所批准及纪律决定可按其列明路径覆核
法院刑事取消资格不因此变成行政指明决定

tested.point: 列明与未列明决定

snapshot.en: The Commissioner's decision, on granting a licence, to impose a condition on the licence
snapshot.tc: 關長在批給牌照時，對所批給的牌照施加條件的決定

snapshot.en: The Commissioner's refusal to approve a person becoming a partner in a partnership that is a licensee
snapshot.tc: 關長拒絕給予批准讓某人成為屬持牌人的合夥的合夥人的決定

snapshot.en: The Commissioner's refusal of a licensee's application to operate a money service at particular premises
snapshot.tc: 關長拒絕批准持牌人要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請的決定

snapshot.en: A court's order disqualifying a person convicted of operating a money service without a licence from holding one
snapshot.tc: 法庭取消被裁定無牌經營金錢服務的人持有牌照資格的命令

snapshot.en: The Commissioner's decision, on renewing a licence, to amend or remove one of the licence's conditions
snapshot.tc: 關長在將牌照續期時，修改或免除該牌照的條件的決定

snapshot.en: The Commissioner's decision to publicly reprimand a licensee that has contravened a condition of its licence
snapshot.tc: 關長公開譴責違反其牌照的任何條件的持牌人的決定

tested.point: 撤牌覆核

snapshot.en: The decision to revoke the licence is a specified decision, which the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal to review.
snapshot.tc: 撤銷牌照的決定屬指明決定，該持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。

tested.point: 双方包含作决定的指明当局

snapshot.en: In reviewing a specified decision, the Tribunal must give the parties, namely the specified authority and the applicant, a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
snapshot.tc: 審裁處在覆核某指明決定時，須給予覆核的各方，即指明當局及申請人，合理的陳詞機會。

rows.notes: 其他行业的指明当局及决定仅 reference；不把其他行业完整决定清单加入 MSO 考纲。

rows.name: 保密制度的指明人士及可接收资料者

points: 指明人士包含现任/前任相关职员、代理、顾问和协助者
保密覆盖履职得知事项而不限标注机密文件
司法、检控、纪律、法律意见及特定机关等有法定披露路径
接收者未必能自由再披露，须区别主管当局及获准接收人

tested.point: 主体范围及机密性质

snapshot.en: The duty binds a person who was formerly a consultant, agent or adviser of a relevant authority, as well as a person who still holds such a role.
snapshot.tc: 保密責任約束曾屬有關當局顧問或代理人的人，亦約束現屬有關當局顧問或代理人的人。

snapshot.en: The duty covers a matter that comes to a specified person's knowledge in the course of assisting another person in performing a function under the Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 保密責任涵蓋指明人士在協助另一人根據本條例某條文執行職能的過程中獲悉的事宜。

snapshot.en: Despite the duty, a specified person may disclose information in performing a function under the Ordinance, or information already made available to the public.
snapshot.tc: 儘管有保密責任，指明人士可在根據本條例執行職能的過程中披露資料，亦可披露公眾已可得到的資料。

snapshot.en: The duty extends to a record that came into a specified person's possession in performing a function under the Ordinance, provided the record is marked as confidential.
snapshot.tc: 保密責任延及指明人士在根據本條例執行職能的過程中得以管有的紀錄，但以該紀錄註明為機密者為限。

tested.point: 审裁处/清盘人/申诉专员/司法执法机关和有条件披露

snapshot.en: The Review Tribunal, and a liquidator appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance, are among those to whom a relevant authority may disclose information.
snapshot.tc: 覆核審裁處及根據《公司(清盤及雜項條文)條例》獲委任為清盤人的人，均屬有關當局可向其披露資料的對象。

snapshot.en: A relevant authority may disclose information to The Ombudsman, as a listed recipient, only if satisfied that this is desirable or expedient, having regard to the public interest, the interest of the investing public and the recipient's need.
snapshot.tc: 有關當局須經顧及公眾利益、投資大眾的利益及接收者的需要而信納披露屬可取或合宜，方可向列明的申訴專員披露資料。

snapshot.en: Information obtained by an authorized person in a routine inspection may be disclosed to the Secretary for Justice, the Commissioner of Police or the Commissioner of the Independent Commission Against Corruption.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人在例行視察中取得的資料，有關當局可向律政司司長、警務處處長或廉政專員披露。

snapshot.en: Where information obtained from one person relates to a different person, the relevant authority may disclose it with the consent of both the person who gave it and the person it relates to.
snapshot.tc: 如從某人處取得的資料與另一人有關，有關當局可在該人及該另一人均同意的情況下披露該等資料。

snapshot.en: When disclosing information in these cases, a relevant authority may impose any condition it considers appropriate, and knowingly contravening such a condition is an offence.
snapshot.tc: 有關當局在該等情況下披露資料時，可施加其認為適當的條件，任何人明知有該條件而違反該條件，即屬犯罪。

tested.point: 视察及法律意见/纪律、下游限制及通知例外

snapshot.en: An operator on which an authorized person has imposed a requirement must not disclose information obtained in the course of it to any other person, unless the relevant authority consents or a specified condition is met.
snapshot.tc: 被獲授權人施加要求的經營者，不得向任何其他人披露在該過程中取得的資料，除非有關當局同意或指明的條件獲符合。

snapshot.en: The operator may disclose such information to seek advice from counsel, a solicitor or another professional adviser acting, or proposing to act, professionally on a matter under the Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 該經營者可為向以(或擬以)專業身分行事的大律師、律師或其他專業顧問就根據本條例引起的事宜徵詢意見，而披露該等資料。

snapshot.en: An operator notified of the Commissioner's decision to take disciplinary action against it must not disclose information obtained from the notice, unless the Commissioner consents or a specified condition is met.
snapshot.tc: 經營者獲關長通知對其採取紀律行動的決定後，不得披露自該通知獲得的資料，除非關長同意或指明的條件獲符合。

snapshot.en: A solicitor to whom the operator discloses the information to obtain advice must not disclose it to another person, unless the relevant authority consents or another specified condition is met.
snapshot.tc: 經營者為徵詢意見而向律師披露資料後，該律師亦不得向另一人披露該資料，除非有關當局同意或另一項指明的條件獲符合。

snapshot.en: The restriction on disclosing information obtained from a notice applies to an operator that the Commissioner notifies of the suspension of its licence, as it applies to a notice of disciplinary action.
snapshot.tc: 就自通知獲得的資料而設的披露限制，適用於獲關長通知其牌照被暫時吊銷的經營者，一如適用於紀律行動通知。

rows.notes: Ombudsman、廉政专员、警务处处长的此处功能是法定接收者，不能据此声称其所有一般职能已测试；一般机关职能由源01/02审计。本次不扩张非 MSO 监管保密细则。

rows.name: 经营处所与住宅处所的主体同意

points: MSO 的经营处所依许可证所列处所判断
住宅处所须每名占用人书面同意授权进入，区别只要业主同意
处所占用者并不自动是持牌人、申请人或最终拥有人

tested.point: 视察业务处所定义

snapshot.en: For the purposes of routine inspection, the operator's business premises are any premises that it uses in connection with its business of operating a money service.
snapshot.tc: 就例行視察而言，該經營者的業務處所指其在與經營金錢服務的業務有關連的情況下使用的任何處所。

tested.point: 每名占用人的同意

snapshot.en: where the premises are domestic premises, the applicant must secured the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for the purpose of exercising the powers as conferred by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Cap. 615 (AMLO)
snapshot.tc: （如該處所屬住宅處所）申請人須確保取得該處所的每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人為行使第615 章《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（打擊洗錢條例）所授予的權力而進入該處所。

tested.point: 占用人撤回同意的后果

snapshot.en: Where the licensee operates at domestic premises and an occupant revokes the written consent for authorized persons to enter, the Commissioner must revoke the licence.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人在住宅處所經營，而佔用人撤銷其讓獲授權人進入的書面同意，關長必須撤銷牌照。

rows.notes: 没有独立的住宅处所法定释义可据源10构造额外定义缺口；有关每名占用人与业主区分已包含题句，发牌资料另与源01/FAQ交叉。

rows.name: 能力评核：目的、公司资格及发牌评估

points: 确保高层具备反洗钱知识并监督制度
评核成绩是适当人选的重要因素而非自动发牌
合格属公司为本资格

tested.point: 高层监督、目的与发牌的关系

snapshot.en: The Assessment aims at ensuring that the compliance officer of a licensed MSO has a fundamental knowledge and clear understanding of AML/CFT to duly oversee its AML/CFT systems.
snapshot.tc: 能力評核旨在確保持牌金錢服務經營者的合規主任對打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集具備基本知識並清楚了解，以便妥為監督有關制度。

snapshot.en: According to the Guidance Notes, the Assessment helps to raise compliance standards across the MSO sector and to safeguard the integrity of the AML/CFT regime the AMLO establishes.
snapshot.tc: 《須知》指能力評核有助提升金錢服務業整體的合規水平，亦可捍衛按《打擊洗錢條例》建立的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度。

snapshot.en: In the evaluation of overall fit and proper status, the Assessment result carries a substantial weighting, and it is one of the factors the CCE has regard to in considering a grant or renewal.
snapshot.tc: 在評定整體的適當人選資格時，能力評核的成績會佔相當比重，屬關長考慮批給牌照或將牌照續期時會顧及的因素之一。

snapshot.en: An invitation to the Assessment does not imply that the candidate has fully met the licensing requirements, as the vetting process is still in progress.
snapshot.tc: 鑑於牌照的審批程序仍在進行中，即使應考者已獲邀應考能力評核，亦不代表其已完全符合各項發牌規定。

snapshot.en: A pass in the Assessment does not necessarily make an applicant eligible for a licence; for the grant, the licensing requirements in the AMLO and the Licensing Guide must also be met.
snapshot.tc: 即使在能力評核取得合格成績，亦不代表合資格取得牌照；申請人要獲批給牌照，必須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及《牌照指引》訂明的規定。

tested.point: 公司资格及关长酌情附条件继续营业

snapshot.en: The CCE treats a pass as a company-based qualification, which is also one of the fit and proper statuses to be associated with the business.
snapshot.tc: 關長將在能力評核取得合格成績視作以公司為單位取得的資格，這亦關乎是否屬與業務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: The qualification becomes void automatically when the licensee no longer has at least one member of its senior management who passed.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人的高級管理層中不再有最少一名成員在能力評核取得合格成績，此項資格將自動失效。

snapshot.en: On the merits of each case, the CCE may allow a licensee with no eligible person who has passed to continue its business, imposing licensing conditions.
snapshot.tc: 關長經考慮個案情況後，即使持牌人已沒有合資格人士取得合格成績，仍可容許其繼續經營，並會施加發牌條件。

rows.name: 能力评核须知：文件用途

points: 为考生说明考试形式及评核标准

tested.point: 明确测试文件用途

snapshot.en: The Guidance Notes aim to give candidates more information on the Assessment, especially on its examination format and its criteria, so that they can better prepare for it.
snapshot.tc: 《須知》旨在向應考者提供更多有關能力評核的資料，尤其是考試形式及能力評核準則方面，讓應考者為考試作好準備。

rows.name: 能力评核合资格人士／高层身份

points: 监督业务、直接参与政策与管治决策、对合规职能和制度负责
独资经营者、合伙人、属自然人的董事

tested.point: 监督及决策；合伙人和自然人董事

snapshot.en: An eligible person must be senior management overseeing the money service business and directly involved in decisions on company policy and governance.
snapshot.tc: 合資格人士必須是監督金錢服務業務運作的高級管理層，並直接參與公司政策及管治安排的決策。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant or licensee is a partnership, not more than three of its partners can be nominated to participate in the Assessment.
snapshot.tc: 如牌照申請人或持牌人屬合夥，可獲提名應考能力評核的合夥人不得超過三名。

snapshot.en: Where the applicant or licensee is a corporation, the directors it may nominate include a director that is itself a corporation.
snapshot.tc: 如牌照申請人或持牌人屬法團，可獲提名應考能力評核的董事包括本身屬法團的董事。

tested.point: 独资经营者或合伙人／董事参加并通过

snapshot.en: The sole proprietor, or any one of the partners and directors, of an applicant or licensee must pass the Competence Assessment conducted by C&ED; the Guidance Notes on it give further details.
snapshot.tc: 申請人或持牌人的獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在由海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，詳情可參閱《金錢服務經營者適用的能力評核須知》。

untested.point: 合资格人士须对公司的合规职能及制度负责；现有资格题只写监督和参与决策
untested.quote_en: is held accountable in the compliance functions and systems of the company.
untested.quote_tc: 要對公司的合規職能及制度負責。

rows.notes: 仅补资格定义的责任层面；不是新增泛化的高层合规职责。

rows.name: 海关／关长：评核决定、安排、覆检

points: 评估不合适者可拒牌；无合格者可酌情附条件继续
安排变更、残疾证明、覆检及最终决定

tested.point: 评核失败下关长拒续牌判断

snapshot.en: If all its eligible persons still fail before the licence expires, the renewal could be refused where the CCE considers the licensee no longer fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 如所有合資格人士在牌照屆滿前仍未取得合格成績，關長若認為持牌人不再屬適當人選，可拒絕續牌申請。

tested.point: 酌情及牌照条件

snapshot.en: On the merits of each case, the CCE may allow a licensee with no eligible person who has passed to continue its business, imposing licensing conditions.
snapshot.tc: 關長經考慮個案情況後，即使持牌人已沒有合資格人士取得合格成績，仍可容許其繼續經營，並會施加發牌條件。

tested.point: 技术覆检及不披露分数

snapshot.en: A re-check looks at the answer sheet for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies, and its result is final.
snapshot.tc: 覆檢答題紙時會留意輸入分數出錯及數據前後不一等技術錯誤，而覆檢結果將視作最終成績。

snapshot.en: Once a re-check is completed, C&ED will disclose to the candidate, on request, the exact score that the candidate obtained.
snapshot.tc: 完成覆檢後，海關會應要求向應考者披露其在能力評核取得的實際分數。

tested.point: 变更通知、残疾证明、最终决定

snapshot.en: Where the C&ED requires changes to the Assessment arrangements, candidates will be informed by email before the Assessment as soon as practicable.
snapshot.tc: 如海關須更改能力評核的安排，海關將於能力評核舉行前盡快以電郵通知應考者有關更改。

snapshot.en: The C&ED may require candidates, as appropriate, to produce medical proof confirming their disabilities in order to make suitable arrangements for them.
snapshot.tc: 海關或會在有需要時要求應考者出示醫學證明，以便在確定其殘疾情況後作出適當的應考安排。

snapshot.en: Candidates should not, without permission, enter any area of the centre not open to them, and in any dispute the decision of the C&ED is final and conclusive.
snapshot.tc: 未經准許，應考者不應進入試場內沒有向應考者開放的範圍；如有任何爭議，一概以海關的最終決定為準。

rows.notes: 考务角色；优先级低于业务监管。

rows.name: 监考员：身份核实与离场管理

points: 考生遵从监考员指示
核实身份、必要时复制证件
准许离场并收回答卷

tested.point: 违规后果及疑有身份问题时复制证件

snapshot.en: A candidate who violates the rules or acts dishonestly during the Assessment is liable to be disqualified, and may also be asked to leave the centre immediately.
snapshot.tc: 應試者如違反規定或以不誠實的行為應考，可被取消考試資格，亦可能被要求立即離開能力評核試場。

snapshot.en: Where the invigilator has any doubt on a candidate's identity, the invigilator may copy the identification document at the centre for further verification when required.
snapshot.tc: 如監考員對應試者的身份有懷疑，可於試場複印其身份證明文件，以便在有需要時作進一步核實。

untested.point: 离场须得监考员许可，提早离场要确认答卷及物品已收回
untested.quote_en: Do not leave the Assessment centre without permission from the invigilator. Early leavers must make sure the answer scripts and related materials have been collected by the invigilator on the spot.
untested.quote_tc: 除非獲得監考員准許，否則不得離開試場。如應考者要提早離開，必須確保答卷及相關物品已即場由監考員收回。

rows.notes: 另有核实身份时脱口罩细节，按E12各语言原文；属于考务参考，不应优先补题。

rows.name: 主考员：指导填写答题纸资料

points: 指导考生填写公司、申请、个人及日期签署资料

untested.point: 按主考员指示填写答题纸资料
untested.quote_en: Before going to the questions, you have to write down the following particulars on the multiple-choice answer sheet as instructed by the Presiding Invigilator:
untested.quote_tc: 作答前，須根據主考員指示，在選擇題答題紙上填寫下列資料：

rows.notes: 低价值考务角色，完整收录但不建议先补。

rows.name: 牌照管制课：接收评核覆检要求

points: 接收考生的书面覆检要求

tested.point: 覆检期限；未点名接收单位

snapshot.en: A candidate dissatisfied with the result may ask in writing for a re-check within 14 days after the date of issuance of the result notification.
snapshot.tc: 應考者如對其能力評核成績不滿，可在發出成績通知當日起計14日內以書面要求覆檢。

untested.point: 书面覆检要求的接收单位为牌照管制课
untested.quote_en: write to the Licensing Control Division
untested.quote_tc: 致函牌照管制課

rows.notes: 单位名称缺口，考务价值低。

rows.name: 香港天文台：天气警告来源

points: 发出热带气旋／暴雨信号供考试安排判断

tested.point: 明确香港天文台为发出信号机构

snapshot.en: As a general rule, the Assessment is held as scheduled when typhoon signal No. 3 or lower, or the Amber or Red rainstorm signal, is issued by the Hong Kong Observatory.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，如天文台發出三號或以下的熱帶氣旋信號，或「黃色」或「紅色」暴雨警告信號，考試會如期舉行。

rows.notes: 不扩写天文台其他职能。

rows.name: 金钱服务经营者牌照系统（MSOS）

points: 公布考试替代安排
电子申请及公开登记册
提交定期申报表

tested.point: 公布替代考试安排

snapshot.en: Alternative arrangements, if any, will be published on the website of the MSO Licensing System on the first working day that follows.
snapshot.tc: 如因惡劣天氣而需另作安排，金錢服務經營者牌照系統網頁將於隨後首個工作日公布有關安排。

tested.point: 提供申请及指引

snapshot.en: The application form and the submission guidelines for the Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau or C&ED's website.
snapshot.tc: 申請表格及有關遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策的指引，可在金錢服務監理科索取，或從海關網站下載。

tested.point: 通过牌照系统提交申报表

snapshot.en: New periodic returns must be submitted through the MSOS, and C&ED no longer accepts periodic returns submitted in paper form.
snapshot.tc: 新定期申報表須經牌照系統遞交，海關亦不再接受以紙本形式遞交的定期申報表。

rows.notes: 用途分别测试；并非独立监管机构。22技术FAQ的浏览器品牌、PDF阅读器为技术参考，不增设职责。

rows.name: 金钱服务监理科（MSSB）

points: 收取牌照申请及提供表格／查询
从反洗钱角度研究申请人整项业务运作，理解拟营业务及模式

tested.point: 申请接收地点／渠道及提供表格

snapshot.en: The completed application, with photocopies of the requisite documents, must be lodged by the applicant in person at the Money Service Supervision Bureau of C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 填妥的申請文件連同所需文件的複本，必須由申請人親自遞交至香港海關金錢服務監理科。

snapshot.en: The application form and the submission guidelines for the Business Plan and AML Policy can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau or C&ED's website.
snapshot.tc: 申請表格及有關遞交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策的指引，可在金錢服務監理科索取，或從海關網站下載。

untested.point: 监理科有责任从反洗钱及反恐融资角度研究整项业务运作
untested.quote_en: The MSSB is obliged to look into the applicant’s entire business operation from the anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (“AML/CFT”) perspective.
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務監理科有責任從打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的角度研究申請人整項業務運作。

rows.name: 海关／关长：发牌、监管及执法当局

points: 规管金钱服务经营者；发牌和适当人选审查
拒牌、停牌撤牌、批准重要变更、收取通知及申报
纪律处分及例行检查

tested.point: 向关长申请及豁免边界

snapshot.en: A person who wishes to operate a money service is required to apply for a licence, and must apply to the CCE before operating the service.
snapshot.tc: 擬經營金錢服務的人須申請牌照，並必須在經營金錢服務前向關長提出申請。

snapshot.en: The CCE will not accept an application for the grant or renewal of a licence from an applicant that has been exempted from the licensing requirements.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人本身獲豁免於發牌規定，關長將不會接納其提出的批給牌照或牌照續期申請。

tested.point: 关长发牌判断

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a partnership, each partner in the partnership must be a fit and proper person to operate a money service.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥，該合夥的每名合夥人均須屬經營金錢服務的適當人選。

snapshot.en: If a corporate applicant has an ultimate owner, the ultimate owner must be fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 如就屬法團的申請人有最終擁有人，該名最終擁有人須屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied that every director and every shareholder is fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法團的申請人而言，關長須信納其每名董事及每名股東均屬與經營金錢服務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For an application to operate at particular premises, the Commissioner must be satisfied that the premises are suitable for operating a money service.
snapshot.tc: 就要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請而言，關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務。

snapshot.en: Once satisfied of every matter that the Ordinance requires, the Commissioner must grant the licence to the applicant.
snapshot.tc: 關長一經信納條例規定的所有事宜均已符合，便必須向申請人批給牌照。

tested.point: 海关处理申请、面见、查验及简报

snapshot.en: On receipt of a licence application, the applicant is given an acknowledgment receipt, and a reminder for any outstanding documents is issued where necessary.
snapshot.tc: 海關收到牌照申請書後，會向申請人發出確認收到申請書通知，並在有需要時發信催交尚欠文件。

snapshot.en: At the interview the original documents are verified, and the applicant is required to sign the application for an MSO licence in the presence of a Justice of the Peace.
snapshot.tc: 在會面時，海關人員會查驗文件的正本，而申請人須於太平紳士面前在金錢服務經營者牌照申請書上簽署。

snapshot.en: The applicant is briefed on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements applicable to MSOs, so that it can fully understand and fulfil a licensee's obligations.
snapshot.tc: 人員會向申請人簡介金錢服務經營者適用的法定發牌及合規規定，確保其全面了解及符合持牌人的規定。

snapshot.en: The processing time may vary with factors including on-site inspection at the business premises and obtaining records from other authorities for the fit and proper person test.
snapshot.tc: 處理時間的長短，視乎在業務處所進行實地視察、為判定適當人選向其他機構索取紀錄所需的時間等因素。

tested.point: 向政府及执法机构核对资料

snapshot.en: The CCE's checks on a declaration form include vetting the details against information held by C&ED and by other government and law enforcement agencies.
snapshot.tc: 關長就適當人選聲明表格進行的查驗，包括將資料與海關、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對。

tested.point: 关长停撤牌

snapshot.en: The circumstances the Guide lists in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence are examples only, and the list is not exhaustive.
snapshot.tc: 《牌照指引》所列關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的情況只屬例子，並非詳盡無遺。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence whose holding fails to fulfil its purpose of providing a money service, for example where the licensee has never provided one.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人持有牌照而未能符合提供金錢服務的發牌目的，例如從未提供金錢服務，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee's LPS falls foul of the requirements set out in the Licensing Guide.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點未能符合《牌照指引》所載的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee's failure to appoint, or to maintain, a competent Compliance Officer or MLRO is one of the examples given for revocation or suspension.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人未能委任或維持具備合資格的合規主任或洗錢報告主任，是可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的例子之一。

snapshot.en: The CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where the licensee fails to comply with any requirement under the AMLO, including those in Part 5.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人未能遵從條例所訂的任何規定，包括條例第5部訂明的規定，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照。

snapshot.en: A licensee's failure to submit a periodic return on time is another of the examples in which the CCE may revoke or suspend its licence.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人未能按時遞交定期申報表，亦屬關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷其牌照的例子之一。

tested.point: 收申报及任命通知

snapshot.en: A licensee must submit its periodic return to the CCE in a timely manner, and must use the form that the CCE specifies for it.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人必須按時向關長遞交定期申報表，而申報表須採用關長指明的格式。

snapshot.en: A licensee must give notice of its appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as the AML Guideline requires, by way of supplementary information forms.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定遞交補充資料表格，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事作出具報。

tested.point: 预先批准最終拥有人

snapshot.en: A person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing.
snapshot.tc: 除非關長已應持牌人的申請而給予書面批准，否則任何人不得成為該持牌人的最終擁有人。

tested.point: 两套罚款权力

snapshot.en: Under the Disciplinary Action Guideline, the CCE may, amongst other disciplinary actions, impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any of the conditions of its licence.
snapshot.tc: 根據《施加罰款紀律行動指引》，持牌人如違反其牌照的任何條件，關長除其他紀律行動外，可以向該持牌人施加罰款。

snapshot.en: The Disciplinary Fining Guideline says that, for an MSO that contravenes a specified provision, the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty on its own or combine it with other disciplinary sanctions.
snapshot.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》訂明，金錢服務經營者如違反指明的條文，關長可單單施加罰款，亦可將罰款與其他紀律制裁一併實施。

snapshot.en: The Disciplinary Action Guideline indicates how the CCE will exercise the power to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11).
snapshot.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》示明關長如何行使權力，向違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文的金錢服務經營者施加罰款。

rows.notes: 02和10有更完整监管权限；本行记录03所述角色，不扩展为全部许可条件清单。

rows.name: 牌照指引：用途及适用对象

points: 对拟经营／已经营的个人和法团说明发牌、申请、持续责任及不当行为后果

tested.point: 发牌须符合条例及牌照指引

snapshot.en: A pass in the Assessment does not necessarily make an applicant eligible for a licence; for the grant, the licensing requirements in the AMLO and the Licensing Guide must also be met.
snapshot.tc: 即使在能力評核取得合格成績，亦不代表合資格取得牌照；申請人要獲批給牌照，必須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及《牌照指引》訂明的規定。

tested.point: 官方考试参考资料

snapshot.en: The Licensing Guide and the guidelines and circulars that the C&ED issues to MSOs are among the materials on which the questions are mainly set.
snapshot.tc: 海關向金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》、各類指引及通函，均屬選擇題大致取材的公開資料。

tested.point: 指引具体持续责任

snapshot.en: A licensee must comply with all the applicable provisions of the AMLO and the guidelines issued by the CCE, and must report on suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人務必遵從條例的所有適用條文及關長發出的指引，並必須報告可疑交易。

snapshot.en: A licensee must develop an AML Policy that is effective in mitigating ML/TF risks, and must also maintain that policy.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人必須制訂有效的打擊洗錢政策以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並維持該政策。

snapshot.en: A licensee operating without particular premises must ensure that its local management office can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，必須確保本地管理辦事處可作為與海關溝通的聯絡點。

snapshot.en: A licensee must submit its periodic return to the CCE in a timely manner, and must use the form that the CCE specifies for it.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人必須按時向關長遞交定期申報表，而申報表須採用關長指明的格式。

snapshot.en: A licensee must give notice of its appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as the AML Guideline requires, by way of supplementary information forms.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定遞交補充資料表格，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事作出具報。

rows.notes: 主要内容已有题，未另追求逐字复述文件前言。

rows.name: 金钱服务／金钱服务经营者

points: 货币兑换或汇款服务；经营者须申请
经营兑换或汇款的个人或机构为MSO

tested.point: 两类服务是或关系

snapshot.en: Operating only a money changing service, with no remittance service, is operating a money service, and so is operating only a remittance service.
snapshot.tc: 只經營貨幣兌換服務而沒有經營匯款服務，即屬經營金錢服務；只經營匯款服務亦然。

tested.point: 拟经营者向关长申领牌照

snapshot.en: A person who wishes to operate a money service is required to apply for a licence, and must apply to the CCE before operating the service.
snapshot.tc: 擬經營金錢服務的人須申請牌照，並必須在經營金錢服務前向關長提出申請。

rows.name: 货币兑换服务与附带业务／酒店例外

points: 香港作为业务经营的货币兑换
不包括附带于主业如零售接受外币
酒店内主要方便住客，且只以港币购买外币

tested.point: 酒店例外的方向、处所与主要用途

snapshot.en: To fall within the hotel exclusion, every transaction of the service must be a sale by the hotel manager of non-Hong Kong currencies for Hong Kong currency.
snapshot.tc: 要符合酒店的例外情況，有關服務的每宗交易均須是管理酒店的人收取港元貨幣而售出港元以外的貨幣。

snapshot.en: To fall within the hotel exclusion, the service must run within the hotel's premises with the convenience of hotel guests as its primary purpose.
snapshot.tc: 要符合酒店的例外情況，有關服務須在酒店的處所內經營，並以方便入住酒店的顧客為主要目的。

untested.point: 附带于主要业务的兑换服务例外，例如零售交易接受外币
untested.quote_en: but does not include such a service that is incidental to the main business e.g. retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions
untested.quote_tc: 但不包括附帶於主要業務的該等服務，例如在交易中接受外幣的零售業務

rows.notes: 与10的法定money changing service定义合并核对，勿与酒店例外混为一条。

rows.name: 汇款服务的三个方向

points: 送往／安排送往境外
从境外接收／安排接收
安排在境外收款

tested.point: 向境外发送／安排发送（题中为remittance transaction定义）

snapshot.en: For these requirements, a transaction is a remittance transaction if it is for sending money, or arranging for money to be sent, to a place outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 就有關規定而言，凡為將金錢送往香港以外地方或安排如此送交而進行的交易，即屬匯款交易。

tested.point: 安排境外接收

snapshot.en: A remittance service includes arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong, where the service is operated in Hong Kong as a business.
snapshot.tc: 在香港作為業務經營的匯款服務，包括安排在香港以外地方收取金錢的服務。

untested.point: 从香港以外接收或安排接收款项也是汇款服务
untested.quote_en: receiving, or arranging for the receipt of, money from a place outside Hong Kong;
untested.quote_tc: 從香港以外地方或安排從香港以外地方收取金錢；

rows.notes: 汇款服务范围不等同附表2非电传转帐汇款交易的操作定义；与10盘点合并。

rows.name: 牌照豁免中的机构类别

points: 政府、认可机构及附带经营金钱服务的指定金融机构类别

tested.point: 认可机构、保险人、系统营运者、持牌法团及放债人边界

snapshot.en: An authorized institution, even where the money service it operates is part of its principal business
snapshot.tc: 認可機構，即使其經營的金錢服務屬其主要業務的一部分

snapshot.en: An authorized insurer, for a money service that is ancillary to the insurer's own principal business
snapshot.tc: 獲授權保險人，而其經營的金錢服務附屬於該保險人本身的主要業務

snapshot.en: A designated retail payment system's system operator, for a money service ancillary to its business as system operator
snapshot.tc: 指定零售支付系統的系統營運者，其金錢服務附屬於其作為系統營運者的業務

snapshot.en: A licensed money lender that operates a money service ancillary to the money lender's principal business
snapshot.tc: 經營金錢服務的持牌放債人，而該服務附屬於該放債人的主要業務

snapshot.en: A licensed corporation that operates a money service forming part of the corporation's principal business
snapshot.tc: 經營金錢服務的持牌法團，而該服務屬該法團的主要業務的一部分

tested.point: 已获豁免者不受理；工具持牌人名词

snapshot.en: The CCE will not accept an application for the grant or renewal of a licence from an applicant that has been exempted from the licensing requirements.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人本身獲豁免於發牌規定，關長將不會接納其提出的批給牌照或牌照續期申請。

snapshot.en: An SVF licensee, as the exemption uses the term, is a person granted a licence under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 豁免條文所指的工具持牌人，是根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》獲批給牌照的人。

untested.point: 政府也不适用牌照要求；现有题没有直接命中该主体
untested.quote_en: the MSO licensing requirement does not apply to the Government
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務經營者的發牌規定不適用於政府

untested.point: 工具持牌人附属业务豁免，不能以只测工具持牌人名词替代
untested.quote_en: an SVF licensee that operates a money service that is ancillary to the licensee’s principal business;
untested.quote_tc: 經營金錢服務的工具持牌人（前提是該服務附屬於該持牌人的主要業務）；

rows.notes: 03保险名称已旧；按B2须用10现行第25条，包括持牌保险经纪公司、持牌个人保险代理及稳定币持牌人。保险范围及交收机构与10代理合并，勿据03旧称独立出题。

rows.name: 认可机构、持牌法团、保险中介、工具持牌人、系统营运者、交收机构的法例转介

points: 把各术语转介银行业、证券及期货、保险和支付系统法例；工具持牌人是获支付系统条例牌照者

tested.point: 工具持牌人及对应法例

snapshot.en: An SVF licensee, as the exemption uses the term, is a person granted a licence under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 豁免條文所指的工具持牌人，是根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》獲批給牌照的人。

rows.notes: 其余只是外部法例定义转介，归档03未解释完整内容，不从外部法例补写。保险旧称服从B2。对象已经在RO016的豁免边界保留。

rows.name: 适当人选：谁接受判断及关长如何判断

points: 逐一审核所列控制人；适当人选声明及考虑因素
关长发牌时按法定及其他相关因素判断
独资／每名合伙人／每名董事及最终拥有人；按个案及相关因素持续满足适当人选

tested.point: 被审核主体及关长裁量

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a partnership, each partner in the partnership must be a fit and proper person to operate a money service.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥，該合夥的每名合夥人均須屬經營金錢服務的適當人選。

snapshot.en: If a corporate applicant has an ultimate owner, the ultimate owner must be fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 如就屬法團的申請人有最終擁有人，該名最終擁有人須屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: For a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied that every director and every shareholder is fit and proper to be associated with the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法團的申請人而言，關長須信納其每名董事及每名股東均屬與經營金錢服務有聯繫的適當人選。

snapshot.en: Once satisfied of every matter that the Ordinance requires, the Commissioner must grant the licence to the applicant.
snapshot.tc: 關長一經信納條例規定的所有事宜均已符合，便必須向申請人批給牌照。

tested.point: 法定考虑因素

snapshot.en: A conviction of the person outside Hong Kong for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing
snapshot.tc: 該人在香港以外地方因關乎洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的罪行而被定罪

snapshot.en: A conviction of the person in Hong Kong for any offence that carries a possible sentence of imprisonment
snapshot.tc: 該人在香港因任何一項可判處監禁的刑事罪行而被裁定有罪

snapshot.en: A persistent failure by the person to comply with requirements imposed under the AMLO or regulations made by the Commissioner
snapshot.tc: 該人屢次不遵從根據《打擊洗錢條例》施加的要求或關長訂立的規例

snapshot.en: For an individual, any adjudication of bankruptcy under the Bankruptcy Ordinance at any time in the past
snapshot.tc: （就個人而言）該人曾在任何時候根據《破產條例》被判定破產

snapshot.en: For a corporation, being in liquidation or the subject of a winding up order, or having a receiver appointed in relation to it
snapshot.tc: （就法團而言）該人正在清盤、屬清盤令的標的，或已有接管人就其獲委任

snapshot.en: A conviction of the person for the offence under the AMLO of knowingly contravening a specified provision
snapshot.tc: 該人因《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的明知而違反指明的條文的罪行而被定罪

tested.point: 公司每名董事和最终拥有人

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a corporation, each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation is required to apply for the fit and proper person test.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬法團，則法團的每名董事以及每名最終擁有人，均須申請進行適當人選判定。

tested.point: 持续适当人选

snapshot.en: Like the licensee's partners and directors, an ultimate owner in relation to a licensee must remain fit and proper at all times.
snapshot.tc: 與持牌人的合夥人及董事一樣，與持牌人有關的最終擁有人在任何時間均必須是適當人選。

tested.point: 不因单项失败自动否决

snapshot.en: Under the Supplementary F&P Guideline, the CCE may still be satisfied that a person who fails to comply with one of its individual elements is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 根據《適當人選補充指引》，某人即使未有符合其中個別項目，關長仍可能信納其屬適當人選。

rows.notes: B9/B10区分经营业务与和业务有联系；不把每项不当行为列成新名词。

rows.name: 最终拥有人：个人、合伙、法团的控制标准

points: 个人：最终拥有／控制者或被代表人
合伙：资本利润／投票权超过25%或最终管理控制
法团：股本／投票权超过25%或最终管理控制

tested.point: 个人、合伙管理控制、董事不是当然最终拥有人

snapshot.en: For an individual applicant or licensee, a second individual who ultimately owns or controls its money service business is an ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人或持牌人是個人，另一名最終擁有或控制其金錢服務業務的個人屬最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: If an individual applicant or licensee is acting on behalf of someone else, the ultimate owner is that someone else.
snapshot.tc: 如屬個人的申請人或持牌人是代表另一人行事，該另一人即屬最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: In a partnership, an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the partnership is an ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 就屬合夥的申請人或持牌人而言，行使對該合夥的管理最終的控制權的個人屬最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: Each director of a corporate applicant or licensee is one of its ultimate owners by virtue of holding that office.
snapshot.tc: 屬法團的申請人或持牌人的每名董事，均因擔任董事職位而屬其最終擁有人。

tested.point: 合伙须为个人；个人代表他人

snapshot.en: A corporation that controls more than a 25% share of a partnership's capital or profits is, in relation to that partnership, its ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 控制某合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的法團，就該合夥而言屬其最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: Where a licensee who is an individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person is the licensee's ultimate owner.
snapshot.tc: 如屬個人的持牌人代表另一人行事，該另一人即屬該持牌人的最終擁有人。

untested.point: 合伙的投票权超过25%路径未直接测试
untested.quote_en: is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 25% of the voting rights in the partnership;
untested.quote_tc: 直接或間接地有權行使在該合夥的投票權的25%以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使；

untested.point: 法团最终拥有人：直接或间接拥有／控制股本超过25%（包括信托／持票人股份），不能以客户实益拥有人题替代
untested.quote_en: owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital of the corporation;
untested.quote_tc: 直接或間接地擁有或控制(包括透過信託或持票人股份持有)該法團已發行股本的25%以上；

untested.point: 法团最终拥有人的另外两条路径：投票权超过25%或最终管理控制；董事身份本身不足
untested.quote_en: is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings of the corporation; or (c) exercises ultimate control over the management of the corporation.
untested.quote_tc: 直接或間接地有權行使在該法團的成員大會上的投票權的25%以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使；或 (c) 可行使對該法團的管理最終的控制權。

rows.notes: 与10第24条盘点合并。m3-274及m6-342问beneficial owner，不直接覆盖licensee的ultimate owner。管理控制双语差异受E14约束。

rows.name: 特定处所与没有特定处所的业务

points: 经营货币兑换／汇款的处所；占用／宣传会客／经常控制的例子
仅访客或客户不属特定处所；上门／客户办公室／移动电子设备例子

tested.point: 处所核心定义、访客例外、客户办公室例子

snapshot.en: The particular premises that need to be registered are those in which the licensee operates a money changing service and/or a remittance service.
snapshot.tc: 需要登記的特定處所，是持牌人用以經營貨幣兌換服務及／或匯款服務的處所。

snapshot.en: Premises where the licensee is only a visitor or a customer, such as a dining establishment or a bank, are not treated as its particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人只是食肆或銀行等處所的訪客或顧客，有關處所不被視為其特定處所。

snapshot.en: Going to a customer's office to meet the customer there is not considered to be operating a money service at particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人前往顧客的辦事處與顧客會面，不被視為在特定處所經營金錢服務。

untested.point: 宣传为会见客户地点的处所例子
untested.quote_en: the premises are advertised (including a signboard on display) for meeting customers there;
untested.quote_tc: 該處所被宣傳（包括展示招牌）為用作會見客戶的處所；

untested.point: 没有固定处所的上门服务例子未被题句直接覆盖
untested.quote_en: operating a money service without any fixed premises, e.g. door‐to‐door service;
untested.quote_tc: 在沒有固定處所的情況下經營金錢服務，例如提供上門服務；

untested.point: 特定处所的经常控制例子：持牌人为业主或租户
untested.quote_en: the premises are regularly controlled by the licensee, i.e. being a landlord or a tenant.
untested.quote_tc: 該處所經常受到持牌人的控制，即以業主或租戶的身分。

untested.point: 没有特定处所的移动电子设备交易例子；双语only差异受E13约束
untested.quote_en: conducting transactions with the use of mobile electronic devices.
untested.quote_tc: 只使用流動電子設備進行交易。

rows.notes: 移动设备例子双语范围差异按E13；本行只盘点概念边界，不把所有适合处所条件纳入。

rows.name: 本地管理办事处（LMO）及驻守人员

points: 无特定处所者的香港实体管理／通讯地点
可亲访及电话联络海关并收文件
独资经营者、合伙人、董事、最终拥有人或合规主任作联络点

tested.point: 适用情况、人员、联络

snapshot.en: The licensees operating with or without particular premises must maintain a LMO
snapshot.tc: 無論持牌人會或不會在特定處所經營金錢服務，都須維持本地管理辦事處。

snapshot.en: LMO must be staffed by the compliance officer, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處須駐有持牌人的合規主任、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: LMO can be reached in person and through telephone by the C&ED officers
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處可讓海關人員親身前往及以電話聯絡。

tested.point: 与海关沟通联络点

snapshot.en: A licensee operating without particular premises must ensure that its local management office can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人在沒有特定處所的情況下經營，必須確保本地管理辦事處可作為與海關溝通的聯絡點。

rows.notes: 与LPS功能有明确题句区分。收文件是联络功能的一部分；住宅禁限／业主许可属一般处所条件，已在旧覆盖审计L011，不在本专项重复造缺口。

rows.name: 本地储存帐目及纪录地点（LPS）

points: 所有申请人均须有；本港实体地点保存全套交易记录
受持牌人控制供海关依法查阅

tested.point: 适用人、定义、控制及查阅职能

snapshot.en: Every applicant is required to have an LPS, including an applicant that will operate its money service at particular premises.
snapshot.tc: 所有申請人均須有本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，包括擬在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人。

snapshot.en: The LPS is a physical place in Hong Kong for keeping the full set of books and records of the licensee's money service transactions.
snapshot.tc: 本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點是在香港用作儲存完整金錢服務交易帳目及紀錄的實體地點。

snapshot.en: The LPS must be under the licensee's control, so that C&ED officers have access to the books and records to perform their functions under the AMLO.
snapshot.tc: 本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點必須由持牌人控制，以便海關人員前往有關地點執行條例賦予的職能。

rows.name: 获授权人：关长授权检查者

points: 关长根据第9(12)条授权任何人
住宅处所须获每名占用人同意供获授权人执行法定权力

tested.point: 由有关当局书面授权，提供授权副本

snapshot.en: Any person, or any person in a class of persons, may be authorized in writing by a relevant authority to act as an authorized person in routine inspections.
snapshot.tc: 任何人或某類別人士中的任何人，均可由有關當局藉書面授權為獲授權人，以進行例行視察。

snapshot.en: Each authorized person must be given, by the relevant authority that authorized him or her, a copy of that authority's authorization.
snapshot.tc: 授權某人進行例行視察的有關當局，須向該獲授權人提供該當局所發出的授權書的文本。

tested.point: 例行检查者权力及证明授权

snapshot.en: The authorized person may enter the business premises of the operator at any time, to ascertain whether it is complying with a prescribed requirement.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人可於任何時間進入該經營者的業務處所，以確定其是否正遵從訂明規定。

snapshot.en: The authorized person may require the operator to give access to a specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified by the authorized person.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人可要求該經營者讓其取覽指明業務紀錄，並在其指明的限期內及指明的地點交出該等紀錄。

snapshot.en: The authorized person may make inquiries of an information holder only with reasonable cause to believe the information cannot be obtained from the operator.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人須有合理因由相信不能藉向該經營者查訊取得所尋求的資料，方可向資料持有人查訊。

snapshot.en: Where a person does not answer for lack of knowledge of the information, the authorized person may in writing require that fact and reason to be verified by statutory declaration.
snapshot.tc: 如某人以不知悉有關資料為理由而沒有回答問題，獲授權人可藉書面要求該人藉法定聲明核實該事實及理由。

snapshot.en: When exercising a power, the authorized person must as soon as reasonably practicable produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization for inspection.
snapshot.tc: 獲授權人在行使權力時，須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快出示有關當局的授權書文本，以供查閱。

tested.point: 住宅进入执行权力

snapshot.en: where the premises are domestic premises, the applicant must secured the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for the purpose of exercising the powers as conferred by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Cap. 615 (AMLO)
snapshot.tc: （如該處所屬住宅處所）申請人須確保取得該處所的每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人為行使第615 章《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（打擊洗錢條例）所授予的權力而進入該處所。

rows.notes: 与第24条authorized officer不是同一概念；对应10代理的两个定义。

rows.name: 合规主任与洗钱报告主任：职责及聘任身份

points: 合规主任为制度与合规监督中心；洗钱报告主任为报告中央联络点
除业主／合伙人／董事／最终拥有人兼任外须为雇员
有足够资历权力的合规主任监督制度建立及维持
合规职能与报告职能、汇报线

tested.point: 两个岗位及雇佣条例身份

snapshot.en: An applicant must appoint a competent CO as the focal point for overseeing its AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, and an MLRO as the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions.
snapshot.tc: 申請人須委任一名合資格的合規主任，作為監督其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度及合規措施的中心點，以及洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。

snapshot.en: Where persons other than the sole proprietor, a partner, a director or an ultimate owner act as CO and MLRO, they must be the applicant's employees under the Employees' Compensation Ordinance.
snapshot.tc: 如由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人以外的人擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，他們必須為根據《僱員補償條例》所界定受聘於申請人的僱員。

tested.point: 错换为MLRO的职责陷阱

snapshot.en: On whether effective AML/CFT systems are established, the example is that the person must have a competent MLRO of sufficient seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee them.
snapshot.tc: 所舉有效打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度的例子，是該人必須在持牌人內有具一定資歷及權力的合資格洗錢報告主任監督。

tested.point: 任命通知

snapshot.en: A licensee must give notice of its appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as the AML Guideline requires, by way of supplementary information forms.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定遞交補充資料表格，就委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任一事作出具報。

tested.point: MLRO与JFIU联络及报告决定

snapshot.en: The MLRO is the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任是報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點，也是與財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點

snapshot.en: The MLRO's functions include oversight of the review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and deciding whether a JFIU report is necessary
snapshot.tc: 洗錢報告主任的職能包括監督覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否須向財富情報組報告

rows.notes: 详细岗位职责由02盘点；这里只关联重复出处。

rows.name: 税务局局长、商业登记条例及商业登记证

points: 税务局局长发商业登记证；在港经营业务须登记

tested.point: 把发证者错换公司注册处处长的陷阱；持续持有有效证

snapshot.en: Any person carrying on business in Hong Kong must register it, and an applicant must hold a valid Business Registration Certificate issued by the Registrar of Companies before C&ED processes its application.
snapshot.tc: 任何在香港經營業務的人須登記其業務，而申請人必須持有由公司註冊處處長發出的有效商業登記證，海關才會處理其牌照申請。

snapshot.en: Applicants and licensees alike must have a valid Business Registration Certificate, and a licensee that does not have one is liable to have its licence suspended or revoked by the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 申請人及持牌人均須持有有效商業登記證；如已批給牌照的持牌人沒有有效商業登記證，關長仍可暫時吊銷及／或撤銷其牌照。

rows.notes: 不用公司注册证明书替代商业登记证。

rows.name: 适当人选声明的见证人及核实／证明职责

points: 海关获授权人员、执业专业人士、公证人、太平绅士
核对正本资料并证明真实；证明在其面前签署

tested.point: 可担任见证人的类别及须核对正本

snapshot.en: Appendix I to Form 3A must be signed before a witness who is an authorized officer of C&ED, a practising professional, a notary public or a Justice of the Peace.
snapshot.tc: 表格3A的附錄I須在見證人在場下簽署，見證人包括海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士、公證人或太平紳士。

snapshot.en: The witness must check the particulars stated in Appendix I against the original, or a certified copy, of the declarant's identity documents.
snapshot.tc: 見證人須將附錄I內載列的個人資料，與聲明人的身份證明文件的正本或核證副本互相核對。

untested.point: 见证人还须证明声明人在其面前签署，不止检查正本
untested.quote_en: The witness shall also certify that this Appendix I is signed by the declarant in his or her presence.
untested.quote_tc: 見證人亦須證明聲明人在其在場情況下簽署該附錄I。

rows.notes: 原文明确证明确认职责；专业人士的其他职能不在归档中扩写。

rows.name: 牌照申请面见代表及授权者

points: 独资本人；合伙由全体合伙人书面授权合伙人或职员；法团由董事局书面授权董事或职员

tested.point: 合伙须全体而非任一合伙人授权

snapshot.en: Where the applicant is a partnership, a staff member of the applicant may attend the interview if any one of the partners has authorized the staff member in writing.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥業務，申請人的員工如已獲任何一名合夥人以書面授權，即可代表申請人出席會面。

tested.point: 申请授权书由全体合伙人或董事局签署

snapshot.en: A copy of the authorization letter signed by all partners where the applicant is a partnership, or by the board of directors where it is a corporation
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬合夥，經所有合夥人簽署的授權書複本；如屬法團，則為經董事局簽署的授權書複本

untested.point: 法团参加面见者为董事局书面授权的董事或职员；区别参加能力评核必须自然人董事
untested.quote_en: the directors or staff member(s) of the applicant authorized in writing by the board of directors, where the applicant belongs to corporation.
untested.quote_tc: 董事局以書面授權的申請人的董事或員工（如申請人屬法團）。

rows.notes: 与应考人RO003形成实质角色区别；现有授权书题未说明谁可面见。

rows.name: 打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集覆核审裁处

points: 覆核关长拒批牌照或停撤牌决定

tested.point: 审裁处覆核指定决定与权限

snapshot.en: A person aggrieved by a specified decision made in relation to the person may apply for a review within the period ending 21 days after the notice of it is sent.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如因就其作出的指明決定感到受屈，可在告知該決定的通知送出後的21日期間申請覆核。

snapshot.en: The specified authority that made the decision may by order extend the time within which an application for review may be made.
snapshot.tc: 作出該指明決定的指明當局，可藉命令延展有關的人向審裁處提出覆核申請的限期。

snapshot.en: An application for review must be made in writing and must state the grounds on which the person makes the application.
snapshot.tc: 向審裁處提出的覆核申請，須藉書面提出，並須述明該申請所據的理由。

snapshot.en: When varying a decision, the Tribunal may make it more onerous than the original, if it is a decision the specified authority had power to make.
snapshot.tc: 審裁處更改指明決定時，可作出較原決定嚴苛的決定，只要該決定是指明當局本有權作出的。

snapshot.en: For the purposes of proceedings before the Tribunal, matters of fact are to be established on a balance of probabilities.
snapshot.tc: 就在審裁處進行的法律程序而言，任何事實事宜須在相對可能性的衡量下予以確立。

tested.point: 撤牌覆核及暂缓执行

snapshot.en: The decision to revoke the licence is a specified decision, which the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal to review.
snapshot.tc: 撤銷牌照的決定屬指明決定，該持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。

snapshot.en: Applying for a review does not by itself stay the revocation, but the licensee may apply to the Tribunal for a stay before the review is determined.
snapshot.tc: 提出覆核申請本身不具暫緩執行撤銷決定的效力，但持牌人可在覆核裁定前向審裁處申請暫緩執行。

snapshot.en: If the licensee applies for a stay, the Tribunal must conduct a hearing to determine that application as soon as reasonably practicable.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人如申請暫緩執行，審裁處須在合理地切實可行的範圍內盡快進行聆訊，以裁定該申請。

rows.notes: 能力评核结果的最终性不消灭牌照决定覆核，按N2区分；完整权力在10盘点。

rows.name: 业务计划及其提交指引

points: 综合概述运作模式、架构、支付、客户、人员及财政
供监理科了解整项拟营业务；涵盖运作及合规目标

tested.point: 业务计划定义、无账户运作及面见说明

snapshot.en: The Business Plan should be a comprehensive overview of the business, with components including its detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customers, staffing and finance.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應綜合概述業務，內容項目包括但不限於公司的詳細運作模式、組織架構、支付系統、客戶對象、職員編制及財政。

snapshot.en: An applicant that intends to operate a money service without using a bank account is required to provide details of how its money service business is operated in that circumstance.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人擬不使用銀行帳戶經營金錢服務，便須就如何在此情況下經營金錢服務業務提供相關細節。

snapshot.en: At the interview, the applicant is required to clarify and elaborate any information in the documents it submitted, such as its Business Plan and AML Policy.
snapshot.tc: 會面時，申請人須就所遞交文件的資料作出澄清及闡述，例如為申請而提交的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。

tested.point: 资金、资金保障、财政及法定确认

snapshot.en: The source of the applicant's capital, and whether the applicant is associated with or controlled by any entities or group company
snapshot.tc: 申請人的資金來源，以及申請人是否與任何實體或集團公司有聯繫或受其控制

snapshot.en: The measures taken to protect customer funds against loss if another agent or MSO, in or outside Hong Kong, fails to fulfil its part
snapshot.tc: 如其他在香港及香港以外的代理人或金錢服務經營者未能履行承諾，保障客戶資金免受損失的措施

snapshot.en: The expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital
snapshot.tc: 未來兩年每類產品及服務的預計利潤幅度和營業額，以及業務日常運作的營運資本

snapshot.en: A written confirmation that it is well aware of, and will comply with, the duty to notify a change in particulars within one month
snapshot.tc: 書面確認全然知悉並會遵從須在詳情改變後一個月內藉書面向關長具報的法定規定

tested.point: 业务各组成部分

snapshot.en: The plan should give the company name, business name, website address, business logo and trademark that will be used to promote the money service business.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應就將用作推廣金錢服務業務的公司名稱、業務名稱、網址、業務標誌及商標提供資料。

snapshot.en: The plan should give the nationality, employment history, qualification and education level of each and every member of the applicant's staff.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應就申請人旗下每一名職員的國籍、曾任職位、資歷及教育水平分別提供資料。

snapshot.en: The plan should state where senior management is located, being the place of key business decisions, and the purpose and whereabouts of any back-end office in or outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應述明作出重要業務決策的高級管理層所在位置，以及香港或香港以外任何後勤辦事處的職能及位置。

snapshot.en: On its customers, the plan should give the geographical location and nationality of its potential and expected customers and its mode of contacting them.
snapshot.tc: 就客戶而言，業務計劃應就準客戶及預期客戶的地理位置及國籍，以及聯絡客戶的方式等提供資料。

snapshot.en: The plan should elaborate the business operation to take place in Hong Kong, detailing the entire transaction process, and the reason for obtaining a licence locally.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應詳述將在香港進行的業務運作（須詳載完整的交易過程）及在本地領取牌照的理由。

snapshot.en: A third party's bank account may be used for the business, provided that the plan gives that account's number and the name of its owner.
snapshot.tc: 如業務計劃已提供帳戶號碼及戶口擁有人的資料，申請人的業務可使用第三方的銀行戶口經營。

rows.notes: MSSB审阅职责单列RO010。具体每项计划栏目覆盖属于既有覆盖审计，不全部重复为名词缺口。

rows.name: 打击洗钱政策／制度及政策提交指引

points: 自有政策、程序及管控以减低风险并履行要求
policy为政策程序管控的合称；基于自身风险
规定合规、报告、审计、培训、与海关／执法合作
AML/CFT Systems为政策、程序、管控合称

tested.point: 政策目的及筛查例子

snapshot.en: The AML Policy should set out the applicant's own policies, procedures and controls in its relevant operational areas with a view to eliminating the ML/TF risks it is exposed to.
snapshot.tc: 打擊洗錢政策應載列申請人就本身相關經營領域而制訂的政策、程序及管控措施，以消除申請人面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: For example, the AML Policy must elaborate the company's payment or settlement system for remittance transactions and its mechanism for sanction screening and screening of high-risk customers.
snapshot.tc: 舉例來說，申請人須在打擊洗錢政策闡述公司執行匯款交易時使用的支付／結算系統，以及公司篩查制裁名單及篩查高風險客戶的機制。

tested.point: 制度包括政策、程序与管控

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the term “AML/CFT Systems” used in the Guideline means AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.
snapshot.tc: 根據詞彙部分，本指引所用的「打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」指打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施。

tested.point: 合规主任职责

snapshot.en: Developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory requirements and are effective
snapshot.tc: 制定及／或持續覆核金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，以確保其反映現況、符合現行法定規定並且有效

snapshot.en: Overseeing all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including monitoring their effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary
snapshot.tc: 監督金錢服務經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的所有方面，包括監察其成效並在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序

snapshot.en: Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including, where appropriate, significant compliance deficiencies
snapshot.tc: 與高級管理層就打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的主要問題進行溝通，包括（如適用）重大的合規不足情況

snapshot.en: Ensuring that the AML/CFT training provided to the staff of the MSO is adequate, appropriate and effective
snapshot.tc: 確保向金錢服務經營者的職員所提供的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓充足、適當及有效

tested.point: 独立审计职能

snapshot.en: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核

snapshot.en: The audit function should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應設有與該經營者高級管理層直接溝通的渠道及途徑

snapshot.en: The audit function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，以使其能夠履行其職責

snapshot.en: The audit function's reviews are carried out under the direction of the Compliance Officer, to whom the function reports
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能的有關覆核在合規主任的指示下進行，並向合規主任作出匯報

tested.point: 海关与其他执法机构协作边界

snapshot.en: The policy states that the applicant will cooperate with the Customs and Excise Department about its routine inspection or investigation.
snapshot.tc: 在配合監管機構及執法機構方面，政策述明申請人將配合香港海關的例行視察或調查。

snapshot.en: The policy states that the applicant will also cooperate with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of any jurisdiction.
snapshot.tc: 政策述明申請人亦將按照任何司法管轄區的法例規定，配合其他執法機構。

tested.point: 培训记录、非穷尽清单

snapshot.en: The MSO will monitor, and keep records of, which staff have been trained, when they received the training and what type of training it was.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者將就職員接受培訓的情況，包括誰人、何時及培訓類別，進行監察並備存紀錄。

snapshot.en: The items tabulated are by no means exhaustive, and the applicant must consider other important issues peculiar to its business model.
snapshot.tc: 所列項目並非詳盡無遺，申請人必須顧及本身業務模式獨有的其他重要事項。

rows.notes: 07所提ML/TF/PF、STR、tipping-off、CDD、CRA、SDD、EDD、PEP、SoF/SoW、TFS均要求申请人解释，并未在07另给定义；实质定义由02及10盘点，22的具体补充见后续行。

rows.name: 适当人选准则指引与补充指引

points: 说明关长考虑因素；适用申请及持牌者，指导性质非穷尽
提供其他相关事项例子，须与主指引并读；适用申请／续牌及持牌者

tested.point: 适用、并读、个别失败非自动否决、指导性质及更新

snapshot.en: The F&P Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence, and is applicable both to the applicant for a licence and to the person who will hold the licence.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選指引》適用於每名牌照申請人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將會持有牌照的人士。

snapshot.en: The Supplementary F&P Guideline must be read in conjunction with the F&P Guideline for determining whether an applicant or a licensee is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 《適當人選補充指引》須與《適當人選指引》一併閱讀，以決定申請人或持牌人是否適當人選。

snapshot.en: Under the Supplementary F&P Guideline, the CCE may still be satisfied that a person who fails to comply with one of its individual elements is fit and proper.
snapshot.tc: 根據《適當人選補充指引》，某人即使未有符合其中個別項目，關長仍可能信納其屬適當人選。

snapshot.en: Each of the two guidelines describes itself as binding on applicants for a licence and on licensees, rather than as advisory.
snapshot.tc: 兩份指引均各自表明，其本身是一份對金錢服務經營者牌照申請人及持牌人具約束力的文件。

snapshot.en: Each of the two guidelines will be kept under review and may be revised or updated from time to time as considered appropriate.
snapshot.tc: 當局會持續檢討《適當人選指引》及《適當人選補充指引》的內容，並按情況不時作出修訂或更新。

tested.point: 列举其他相关事项

snapshot.en: Whether the person has any record of non-compliance with the AMLO or relevant regulation that resulted in administrative action, prosecution, a written warning or discipline by the CCE
snapshot.tc: 該人是否有任何不遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或相關規例的紀錄，以致關長採取行政制裁行動、檢控、發出警告信或作出紀律處分

snapshot.en: Whether the person is in compliance with guidelines promulgated for money service operators in the regulatory regime, such as the Licensing Guide and the AML/CFT Guideline
snapshot.tc: 該人是否遵從在監管制度下為金錢服務經營者頒布的指引，例如《牌照指引》及《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been the subject of any criminal or disciplinary proceedings, or notified of any potential proceedings or any investigation which might lead to those proceedings, under any law in any jurisdiction
snapshot.tc: 該人是否曾面對任何刑事或紀律程序，或曾否獲告知有任何擬執行的程序或調查，而有關調查可能引致在任何司法管轄區根據任何法例執行該等程序

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been untruthful, or omitted material information to the CCE, or has been uncooperative with the C&ED in the performance of a function under the AMLO
snapshot.tc: 該人是否曾不誠實或遺漏要項資料而未有向關長提供，或在海關根據《打擊洗錢條例》執行職能時對海關採取不合作態度

snapshot.en: Whether the person has been refused or restricted from the right to carry on any trade, business or profession for which a specific licence, registration or other authorization is required by law in Hong Kong or elsewhere
snapshot.tc: 該人是否被拒絕或限制享有權利，以進行根據香港或其他地方的法律規定須獲發指定牌照、註冊或其他認可方可進行的行業、業務或專業

tested.point: 补充判断事项

snapshot.en: On whether effective AML/CFT systems are established, the example is that the person must have a competent MLRO of sufficient seniority and authority within the licensee to oversee them.
snapshot.tc: 所舉有效打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度的例子，是該人必須在持牌人內有具一定資歷及權力的合資格洗錢報告主任監督。

snapshot.en: In assessing the person's skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism for the business's functions, the person is generally expected to display an understanding of the statutory and regulatory requirements that apply.
snapshot.tc: 在評核該人是否具備所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業意識時，該人一般需要展示明白業務適用的法定及監管規定。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is whether a regulatory authority or professional body, in Hong Kong or elsewhere, has censured, disciplined or publicly criticized the person.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人曾否遭受任何監管機構或專業團體（不論在香港或其他地方）譴責、紀律處分或公開批評。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is whether the person has put in place the infrastructure and internal control systems necessary to eliminate risk, avoid conflicts of interest and leave a proper audit trail.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人是否設有所需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，藉以消除風險、避免利益衝突，並留存適當的審計線索。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is the state of affairs of any other business the person carries on, proposes to carry on or has any business relationship with, such as one exposing it to potential money laundering risk.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人正經營、擬經營或有任何業務關係的任何其他業務的狀況，例如有其他業務使該人面對潛在的洗錢風險。

snapshot.en: Among the matters is whether the person has established an organizational structure and staffing that meet the legislative or regulatory requirements relevant to it.
snapshot.tc: 所列事宜包括該人有否確立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構，並配備符合規定的人事安排。

rows.notes: 05的person可指个人或法团；现有企业及个人适当人选题已有实际应用，不另算缺口。

rows.name: 两套罚款指引与纪律／行政行动的区分

points: 第43条针对牌照条件、规例及指定发牌规定；公布罚款行使方式并须考虑指引；个别及一般阻吓
第21条针对第5(11)条指明条文；可单独或连同其他纪律制裁；指引约束考虑方式
谴责、纠正命令、罚款；停撤牌是另项权力

tested.point: 两指引所管违法类别及罚款权区分

snapshot.en: Under the Disciplinary Action Guideline, the CCE may, amongst other disciplinary actions, impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any of the conditions of its licence.
snapshot.tc: 根據《施加罰款紀律行動指引》，持牌人如違反其牌照的任何條件，關長除其他紀律行動外，可以向該持牌人施加罰款。

snapshot.en: The Disciplinary Fining Guideline says that, for an MSO that contravenes a specified provision, the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty on its own or combine it with other disciplinary sanctions.
snapshot.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》訂明，金錢服務經營者如違反指明的條文，關長可單單施加罰款，亦可將罰款與其他紀律制裁一併實施。

snapshot.en: The Disciplinary Action Guideline indicates how the CCE will exercise the power to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11).
snapshot.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》示明關長如何行使權力，向違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文的金錢服務經營者施加罰款。

tested.point: 公布决定及阻吓用途

snapshot.en: As a matter of policy, the CCE will usually make public all of its decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO.
snapshot.tc: 按照目前的政策，關長通常會公布所有向金錢服務經營者施加罰款的決定。

snapshot.en: The CCE's aim in imposing a pecuniary penalty is to deter the MSO concerned and, as a general deterrent, other MSOs too.
snapshot.tc: 關長施加罰款，旨在阻嚇有關金錢服務經營者，同時對其他金錢服務經營者起一般的阻嚇作用。

tested.point: 另行撤牌决定

snapshot.en: The decision to revoke the licence is a specified decision, which the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal to review.
snapshot.tc: 撤銷牌照的決定屬指明決定，該持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定。

snapshot.en: Applying for a review does not by itself stay the revocation, but the licensee may apply to the Tribunal for a stay before the review is determined.
snapshot.tc: 提出覆核申請本身不具暫緩執行撤銷決定的效力，但持牌人可在覆核裁定前向審裁處申請暫緩執行。

rows.notes: W6明确停撤牌为另项权力。一般罚款计算／因素缺口不归本次名称职责专项。

rows.name: 代理人／主事人、外判服务商、支付平台、后勤办公室

points: 要求说明自身或各服务商、代理／主事关系、平台的实际职能；并未给这些类别一套通用法定职责

tested.point: 后勤办公室位置与用途

snapshot.en: The plan should state where senior management is located, being the place of key business decisions, and the purpose and whereabouts of any back-end office in or outside Hong Kong.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應述明作出重要業務決策的高級管理層所在位置，以及香港或香港以外任何後勤辦事處的職能及位置。

tested.point: 集团、外判、系统供应商、运钞及其他监管者信息

snapshot.en: The plan should attach an organizational chart of the applicant's group of companies in Hong Kong, with a brief description of each entity in the group and the business it carries out.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃需夾附申請人在香港的公司集團的組織圖，並概述集團內每個實體的資料及經營的業務。

snapshot.en: For AML/CFT purposes, any outsourced service the applicant uses, e.g. an external audit function or a specified intermediary, should be named in the plan together with its nature.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應列出申請人為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集目的而外判的任何服務的名稱，例如外部審核職能或指明的中介人，並說明其性質。

snapshot.en: The plan should elaborate the computerized and other automation systems used in the business, for example naming the commercial service or database provider for automated AML solution and sanction screening.
snapshot.tc: 業務計劃應闡述用於業務的電腦系統及其他自動化系統，例如自動化打擊洗錢方案及篩查制裁名單的商業服務或數據庫提供者的名稱。

snapshot.en: Where the business involves physical cash movement, whether local or cross-boundary, the plan should name the company or person involved in those activities.
snapshot.tc: 業務如涉及本地或跨境的實體現金流動活動，業務計劃需提供參與這類活動的公司或人士的名稱或姓名。

snapshot.en: If the applicant's local business, or the international group it belongs to, holds a licence granted by another regulator or competent authority, the plan should name that body.
snapshot.tc: 如申請人的本地業務或其所屬的國際公司集團持有其他監管機構／主管當局批給的牌照，業務計劃需提供有關名稱。

rows.notes: 项目15代理／主事关系、16平台职能及12人员汇报线未逐项成题，但属于计划须披露的信息，不能据此杜撰机构通用职能；旧审计L028另记录表格内容缺口。

rows.name: 银行：业务账户的证明与确认

points: 有关银行签发账户拥有人证明，并确认账户用于金钱服务业务

tested.point: 银行确认业务用途

snapshot.en: An acknowledgement from the bank that the bank account held by the applicant is used for operating the money service business
snapshot.tc: 確認由申請人持有的銀行帳戶是用作經營金錢服務業務的銀行確認書

untested.point: 有关银行签发业务账户拥有人证明
untested.quote_en: Proof of bank account ownership issued by bank concerned
untested.quote_tc: 由銀行發出證明持有銀行帳戶的文件

rows.notes: 仅为申请文件的签发角色，不推演银行监管权限。

rows.name: 持牌人登记册及关长证明书

points: 列持牌人名称及业务／通信地址；供公众现场和网上查阅

tested.point: 登记地址、公开查阅及关长证明效力

snapshot.en: For a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises, the register must contain the address of every premises at which it may operate a money service.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有其可經營金錢服務的每一個處所的地址。

snapshot.en: For a licensee not licensed to operate at specified premises, the register must contain the correspondence address of the licensee instead.
snapshot.tc: 如持牌人並非獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務，登記冊須載有該持牌人的通訊地址。

snapshot.en: Members of the public may inspect the register during normal office hours on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3.
snapshot.tc: 公眾人士須繳付附表3指明的費用，方可在通常辦公時間內查閱登記冊。

snapshot.en: A certificate purporting to be signed by the Commissioner, stating that a person's name has not been entered on the register, is conclusive evidence of that fact.
snapshot.tc: 看來是經關長簽署並述明某人的姓名或名稱未有名列於登記冊的證明書，可作為該事實的確證。

snapshot.en: A copy of the register purporting to be certified by the Commissioner is conclusive evidence, in any criminal or civil proceedings, of the facts stated in it.
snapshot.tc: 看來是經關長核證的登記冊複本，在任何刑事或民事法律程序中，可作為該複本所述事實的確證。

rows.notes: 登记册完整法定内容由10盘点；03不新增行政机关名称。

rows.name: 跨境现金类物品条例及特別组织建议32

points: 落实建议32，防范跨境运送现金类物品洗钱及恐怖融资

tested.point: 明确条例与建议32及防范目的

snapshot.en: The Ordinance implements Recommendation 32 of the FATF to strengthen the prevention of ML and TF through the cross-boundary transportation of CBNIs.
snapshot.tc: 《條例》落實財務行動特別組織第32項建議，以加強防止透過跨境運送現金類物品進行洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集活動。

rows.notes: CBNI在此为currency and bearer negotiable instruments缩写，归档通函没有逐类法定票据定义，不从外部第629章扩展。

rows.name: 海关关员：旅客现金类物品申报

points: 接收入境申报；按要求披露时关员提出要求
现场接收旅客二维码作申报

tested.point: 关员收申报及提出披露要求

snapshot.en: A traveller arriving in Hong Kong via a specified control point with a large quantity of CBNIs must make a written declaration to a Customs officer, using the Red Channel.
snapshot.tc: 經指明管制站抵達香港並管有大量現金類物品的旅客，須使用紅綠通道系統下的紅通道，向海關人員作出書面申報。

snapshot.en: A traveller who is about to leave Hong Kong with a large quantity of CBNIs must make a written declaration to a Customs officer, using the Red Channel.
snapshot.tc: 即將離開香港並管有大量現金類物品的旅客，須使用紅綠通道系統下的紅通道，向海關人員作出書面申報。

snapshot.en: A traveller arriving not via a specified control point must disclose, on a Customs officer's request, whether he or she has a large quantity of CBNIs.
snapshot.tc: 非經指明管制站抵達香港的旅客，須在海關人員要求下，披露是否管有大量現金類物品。

tested.point: 二维码现场向关员申报

snapshot.en: Under the declaration procedures, after obtaining the QR code, the traveller presents it to a Customs officer on the spot to make the declaration.
snapshot.tc: 按電子表格的申報流程，旅客在預先填寫資料並獲取二維碼後，於現場向海關人員出示二維碼以完成申報。

rows.name: 货物现金类物品申报系统与旅客电子表格

points: 货物托运现金类物品预先申报系统
旅客预填资料获二维码；减少现场时间但仍现场申报

tested.point: 货物预先申报系统用途

snapshot.en: For a large quantity of CBNIs imported or exported in a cargo consignment, an advance declaration must be made through the Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments Declaration System.
snapshot.tc: 進口或出口同一批次屬貨物的大量現金類物品，必須利用海關網上的「現金類物品申報系統」，預先向海關作出申報。

tested.point: 旅客电子表格与现场申报区别

snapshot.en: The E-form lets travellers, before arriving in or departing from Hong Kong, pre-fill information on CBNIs with a total value of more than HKD120,000 and obtain a QR code.
snapshot.tc: 電子表格供旅客在抵達或離開香港之前，預先填寫總價值高於12萬港元的現金類物品資料，以取得作申報用的二維碼。

snapshot.en: As MSOs' business may require them to declare CBNIs carried through the passenger channel, the C&ED invites them to use the E-form, which may reduce clearance time on the spot.
snapshot.tc: 鑑於金錢服務經營者的業務或需經旅客通道跨境運送現金類物品及申報，海關誠邀它們使用電子表格，以節省現場清關時間。

snapshot.en: Under the declaration procedures, after obtaining the QR code, the traveller presents it to a Customs officer on the spot to make the declaration.
snapshot.tc: 按電子表格的申報流程，旅客在預先填寫資料並獲取二維碼後，於現場向海關人員出示二維碼以完成申報。

rows.name: 海关财富调查科

points: Customs Financial Investigation Bureau为通函查询联络单位

rows.notes: 通函仅给查询联络方式，没有解释调查职权；不能与JFIU名称相近就赋相同职责。

rows.name: 机构风险评估与风险为本管控

points: 识别、评估及了解整个业务风险；客户、司法区、产品服务、交付渠道四维度；管控与风险相称

tested.point: 业务模式、交付渠道及风险相称管控

snapshot.en: To ensure their AML/CFT controls are appropriate and effective, MSOs should review the adequacy of their institutional risk assessment in response to emerging threats arising from original or changed modes of operation.
snapshot.tc: 為確保打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施適當而有效，金錢服務經營者須因應原本經營模式或其轉變後帶來的潛在威脅，覆核機構層面風險評估是否合適。

snapshot.en: When establishing or maintaining business relationships with customers, business partners and/or counterparties in their delivery channels, MSOs should exercise caution in assessing how vulnerable these channels are to ML/TF abuse.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者與屬其交付渠道一部分的客戶、業務夥伴及／或交易對手建立或維持業務關係時，應審慎評估此等渠道面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度。

snapshot.en: All MSOs are required to establish and maintain adequate and appropriate risk-based controls to protect consumer interest and address any ML/TF risks emanating from the use of particular delivery channels.
snapshot.tc: 所有金錢服務經營者須設立及維持適當的風險為本的管控措施，足以保障消費者利益，並應對因使用特定交付渠道而造成的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: The C&ED expects each MSO to have a comprehensive risk assessment before engaging other parties in its business model, and to pay attention to the relevant risks associated with delivery channels.
snapshot.tc: 海關要求各金錢服務經營者在其業務模式下與其他各方開展合作之前，先進行全面風險評估，並留意涉及交付渠道的風險。

tested.point: 目标市场、业务性质、交付渠道；盈利能力非列出因素

snapshot.en: The MSO’s target market and customer segments
