snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的目標市場及客戶類別

snapshot.en: The profitability of the MSO’s business
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者業務的盈利能力

snapshot.en: The nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the MSO’s business
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者業務的性質、規模、多元程度及複雜程度

snapshot.en: The delivery channels of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的交付渠道

rows.notes: 完整IRA、CRA和RBA定义及区别由02盘点。

rows.name: 交付渠道中的客户、业务伙伴及交易对手

points: 渠道包括执行汇款所用客户、业务伙伴、交易对手，不只客户本身

tested.point: 准确列出三类及引入其他参与方前风险评估

snapshot.en: When establishing or maintaining business relationships with customers, business partners and/or counterparties in their delivery channels, MSOs should exercise caution in assessing how vulnerable these channels are to ML/TF abuse.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者與屬其交付渠道一部分的客戶、業務夥伴及／或交易對手建立或維持業務關係時，應審慎評估此等渠道面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度。

snapshot.en: The C&ED expects each MSO to have a comprehensive risk assessment before engaging other parties in its business model, and to pay attention to the relevant risks associated with delivery channels.
snapshot.tc: 海關要求各金錢服務經營者在其業務模式下與其他各方開展合作之前，先進行全面風險評估，並留意涉及交付渠道的風險。

rows.notes: 域外监管机关及执法机关冻结资金是事件背景，m6-380#1已测；不补其域外法定职能。

rows.name: 可公诉罪行：境外行为按香港标准判断

points: 境外发生但若在港即构成可公诉罪行的行为也包括在内

tested.point: 不以当地是否合法决定香港有关得益规则

snapshot.en: Property shown to have come from identifiable acts committed overseas is caught by section 25(1) of the OSCO if that conduct constituted an indictable offence in Hong Kong, whatever its legal position where it took place.
snapshot.tc: 若有證據顯示相關財產來自於海外犯下的可識別行為，而該行為在香港構成可公訴罪行，則無論其發生地的法律地位如何，均受《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25(1)條囿制。

rows.name: 客户尽调监管发现通函：监管期望与良好作业例子

points: 海关合规检查发现缺陷；提供监管标准及非穷尽作业例子；持续监测、执法及监管导引

tested.point: 监管发现具体内容及非唯一满足要求的方法

snapshot.en: An MSO should identify and categorise money laundering and terrorist financing risks at the customer level, differentiate higher-risk customers and apply enhanced measures to eliminate the risk.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應妥為識別客戶的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險水平並予以分類，辨別擁有較高風險的客戶，並實施更嚴格的措施以消除該風險。

snapshot.en: An MSO should ensure its staff follow up on inconsistent information given by customers to establish accurate profiles, and keep proper records of customer risk assessments with relevant documents.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應確保其員工就客戶所提供的不一致資料作出跟進以建立準確的客戶檔案，並將客戶風險評估的適當紀錄與相關文件一同保存。

snapshot.en: Among the deficiencies found, some MSOs failed to identify the corporate customer and treated the person purporting to act on its behalf as the customer instead.
snapshot.tc: 合規視察發現的缺失或不足之處，包括部分金錢服務經營者沒有識別公司客戶，並把看似代表客戶行事的人當成客戶處理。

snapshot.en: The examples of good practices are not meant to be exhaustive and should not be regarded as the only ways of meeting the regulatory requirements.
snapshot.tc: 通函所提供的良好手法例子並非詳盡無遺，金錢服務經營者不應把這些例子視為遵從規管性規定的僅有方式。

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt a framework of procedures for assessing who would ordinarily be a PPTA for each customer segment, with each department setting its own approach and rationale.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取有系統的程序，評估每個客戶類別中通常被視為看似代表客戶行事的人，並由各部門自行訂定方法及理據。

snapshot.en: Depending on the associated risks, MSOs should corroborate ownership and shareholding information collected from the customer with publicly available information, such as annual returns.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據相關風險，使用公開資料（例如年報、重要控制人登記冊）核對從客戶收集的擁有權及股權資料。

tested.point: 海关调查明知及未发现警讯的情况（08的重叠执法职能）

snapshot.en: The C&ED will investigate cases where MSOs appear to have failed to detect and act on red flags, not only those where they are suspected of knowingly facilitating third party payments.
snapshot.tc: 海關會調查金錢服務經營者看似未能偵察可疑交易訊號並作出相應行動的情況，而不只是有理由懷疑其明知而促成第三方支付的情況。

rows.notes: 通函的教育／监督用途已有情境题。

rows.name: 实益拥有人与公司客户／所有权链

points: 客户与实益拥有人须分别识别核实；全体拥有或控制者；筛查不能只筛客户；沿所有权链至实益拥有人

tested.point: 股本／投票权／合伙资本定义

snapshot.en: An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of a corporation's issued share capital is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地擁有或控制（包括透過信託或持票人股份持有）法團已發行股本的25%以上的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is, directly or indirectly, entitled to exercise or control the exercise of more than 10% of the voting rights at a corporation's general meetings is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地有權行使在法團的成員大會上的投票權的10%以上，或支配該比重的投票權的行使的個人，是法團的實益擁有人。

snapshot.en: An individual who is entitled to or controls, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of a partnership is its beneficial owner.
snapshot.tc: 直接或間接地有權攤分或控制合夥的資本或利潤的25%以上的個人，是合夥的實益擁有人。

tested.point: 公开所有权及股权资料核对

snapshot.en: Depending on the associated risks, MSOs should corroborate ownership and shareholding information collected from the customer with publicly available information, such as annual returns.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據相關風險，使用公開資料（例如年報、重要控制人登記冊）核對從客戶收集的擁有權及股權資料。

tested.point: PEP筛查含实益拥有人

snapshot.en: The name screening procedures for identifying PEPs must cover not only the customer but also any beneficial owners of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 用以識別政治人物的姓名篩查程序，須涵蓋客戶，以及客戶的任何實益擁有人。

tested.point: 制裁筛查不因客户低风险免除

snapshot.en: An MSO should screen its customers and any beneficial owners of its customers whatever risk profile it has attributed to the customer, low risk customers included.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應對其客戶及客戶的任何實益擁有人進行篩查，即使客戶被評定的風險狀況屬於低亦然。

rows.notes: 完整BO定义及其管理控制／被代表人分支由02、10盘点；13复述部分不再独立重复造缺口。

rows.name: 看似代表客户行事的人（PPTA）、授权签署人与客户的区分

points: 不能把代表误当公司客户；按角色、获授权活动及风险决定；各部门逻辑一致；每法人通常至少一代表
FATF建议10与AMLO要求识别但不定义范围；非每一授权签署人都是PPTA；低风险可用独立部门确认名单

tested.point: 角色判断、法规边界、名单、签署人、至少一名代表

snapshot.en: Whether a person is a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of the person's roles and authorised activities, and the ML/TF risks associated with those roles and activities.
snapshot.tc: 判斷某人是否看似代表客戶行事的人，應依據該人所擔任角色及其獲授權進行活動的性質，以及此等角色及活動所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

snapshot.en: Although FATF Recommendation 10 and the AMLO require any PPTA to be identified and verified, neither the FATF Recommendations nor the AMLO defines the scope of a PPTA.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織第10項建議及《打擊洗錢條例》雖要求識別及核實任何看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，但兩者均沒有界定其涵蓋範圍。

snapshot.en: Where a business relationship presents a high ML/TF risk, the MSO could verify the PPTAs' identities by reference to a list of PPTAs confirmed by an independent department of the customer.
snapshot.tc: 如業務關係的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險被評為屬於高，金錢服務經營者可根據經客戶內部獨立部門核實的清單，核實看似代表客戶行事的人的身分。

snapshot.en: An MSO is not required to identify and verify every authorized signatory of a customer: signatories are only required to be identified and verified if they are PPTAs.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者無須識別及核實客戶的所有獲授權簽署人；僅當獲授權簽署人為看似代表客戶行事的人時，才需要進行識別及核實。

snapshot.en: As a general proposition, each legal person customer should have at least one PPTA, namely the person acting on its behalf to establish the business relationship with the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，每名法人客戶應有至少一名看似代表客戶行事的人，即代表客戶行事以與金錢服務經營者建立業務關係的人。

tested.point: 客户与代表、跨部门一致

snapshot.en: Among the deficiencies found, some MSOs failed to identify the corporate customer and treated the person purporting to act on its behalf as the customer instead.
snapshot.tc: 合規視察發現的缺失或不足之處，包括部分金錢服務經營者沒有識別公司客戶，並把看似代表客戶行事的人當成客戶處理。

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt a framework of procedures for assessing who would ordinarily be a PPTA for each customer segment, with each department setting its own approach and rationale.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採取有系統的程序，評估每個客戶類別中通常被視為看似代表客戶行事的人，並由各部門自行訂定方法及理據。

tested.point: 董事局决议或类似书面授权

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

rows.notes: PPTA须取哪些个人资料属于一般CDD操作缺口（旧C008/L049），不借本专项再次算名词职责缺口。

rows.name: 第三方及第三方支付

points: 第三方是客户之外的任何人；支付可掩饰实益拥有人和资金来源

tested.point: 定义、风险、汇入方向

snapshot.en: Accepting payment from third parties exacerbates some MSOs' vulnerabilities, as criminals would attempt to use such payments to obscure the beneficial owner's identity or the source of illicit funds.
snapshot.tc: 由於罪犯可藉使用第三方支付進行交易以掩飾實益擁有人的身分或非法資金的來源，接受第三方支付的金錢服務經營者有更大可能遭到利用。

snapshot.en: Among cross-boundary remittance services, the circular singles out outward remittance initiated by transient customers as one that could be exploited as a conduit for crime proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 通函特別指出，在金錢服務經營者提供的跨境匯款服務中，短期客戶要求進行的匯出服務可被利用作轉移犯罪得益的管道。

snapshot.en: A third party means any person other than the customer, and an MSO should exercise care if it suspects that a customer may be effecting a transaction on behalf of one.
snapshot.tc: 「第三方」指客戶以外的任何人；如懷疑客戶可能正為第三方進行交易，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。

rows.name: 第三方付款人与真正实益拥有人

points: 第三方付款人有可能是真正实益拥有人；须警觉相关风险

tested.point: 支付掩饰实益拥有人身份的概括风险

snapshot.en: Accepting payment from third parties exacerbates some MSOs' vulnerabilities, as criminals would attempt to use such payments to obscure the beneficial owner's identity or the source of illicit funds.
snapshot.tc: 由於罪犯可藉使用第三方支付進行交易以掩飾實益擁有人的身分或非法資金的來源，接受第三方支付的金錢服務經營者有更大可能遭到利用。

untested.point: 第三方付款人本身可能是真正实益拥有人，尚无题句直接区分这一关系
untested.quote_en: MSOs should be alert to the possibility that the third-party payer is the true beneficial owner, and the risks to which that may give rise.
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務經營者應就第三方付款人即真正實益擁有人的可能以及從而產生的風險保持警覺。

rows.name: 澳门「换钱党」：通函限定的类型定义

points: 非法大额兑换及向澳门赌客放高利贷的团体，试图绕过内地外汇管制及境外提款限制

untested.point: 通函明定「换钱党」的活动与目的；不能等同所有兑换商
untested.quote_en: “money exchange gangs” refers to illicit groups that unlawfully provide large-amount currency exchange services for individuals and entities, as well as offer high-interest loan services to gamblers in Macao.
untested.quote_tc: 「換錢黨」指非法向個人及實體提供大額貨幣兌換服務，以及向澳門賭客提供高利貸服務的非法團體。

rows.notes: 背景类型定义，较低考试价值。公安部、澳门治安警察局、新華通訊社只在事件／报道背景中出现，不扩写通用职权。

rows.name: 第三方支付：高层、相关职能高层及指定执行人员

points: 高层批准政策；有相关AML职能的高层批准付款接纳；指定经理／职员落实及接受指引

tested.point: 管理批准及错归MLRO的政策审批

snapshot.en: An MSO that accepts third party payments should put in place clear and detailed policies and procedures for scrutinising them, and ensure that their acceptance is subject to stringent management approval.
snapshot.tc: 接受第三方支付的金錢服務經營者應設立清晰詳細的政策及程序予以審查，並確保須經過管理層嚴格審批方可接受第三方支付。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT Systems for third party payments should be approved by the MLRO, effectively communicated to all relevant staff members and enforced through robust compliance monitoring programmes.
snapshot.tc: 有關第三方支付的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度應由洗錢報告主任審批、有效傳達所有有關職員，並經嚴格合規監察計劃執行。

tested.point: 具相关反洗钱职能高层批准付款

snapshot.en: The due diligence process for assessing a third party payment should include obtaining approval for its acceptance from senior management with a relevant AML/CFT role at the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 評估第三方支付的盡職審查程序應包括就接納該次支付，取得擔任打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集相關職位的高級管理層批准。

tested.point: 指定经理或职员执行

snapshot.en: The policies and procedures on third party payments should address the respective designated managers or staff members who are responsible for carrying them out.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者有關第三方支付的政策及程序，應處理專責實施該等政策及程序的經理或職員的事宜。

tested.point: 评估职员指引，非海关预批付款人名单

snapshot.en: Staff responsible for evaluating whether a third party payment is acceptable should be given clear and sufficient guidance, including a list of third-party payers approved in advance by the C&ED.
snapshot.tc: 應向負責評估第三方支付是否可接納的職員提供清晰和充足的導引，當中包括經海關預先批核的第三方付款人名單。

rows.name: 联合财富情报组：收取可疑交易报告

points: 知道／怀疑即尽快向JFIU报告
交易监察出现怀疑即提交
报告第三方支付怀疑
报告JFIU属适当制度

tested.point: 报告对象与时间，不能改为关长

snapshot.en: Once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an STR should be filed even where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 知悉或懷疑一旦確立，即使沒有交易由或透過金錢服務經營者進行，也應提交可疑交易報告。

snapshot.en: The STR must be made as soon as reasonably practical after the transaction giving rise to the suspicion has been completed.
snapshot.tc: 可疑交易報告必須在引起懷疑的該項交易完成後，在切實可行範圍內盡快提交。

snapshot.en: The obligation to report suspicions of ML/TF applies irrespective of the amount involved, and also covers attempted transactions.
snapshot.tc: 舉報懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的責任不論所涉金額均適用，並涵蓋試圖進行的交易。

snapshot.en: A person who knows or suspects that any property is terrorist property must, as soon as reasonable, file an STR with the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 任何人如知道或懷疑任何財產是恐怖分子財產，須在合理範圍內盡快向關長提交可疑交易報告。

tested.point: 第三方支付报告

snapshot.en: The policies and procedures should address the enhanced monitoring of client accounts involving third party payments, and the reporting of any ML/TF suspicions identified to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 有關政策及程序應處理更嚴格監察涉及第三方支付的客戶帳戶，以及在識辨出任何懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況時向財富情報組報告。

tested.point: 怀疑无需确认罪行才报告

snapshot.en: Identification of potentially suspicious transactions involving third party payments should prompt follow-up enquiries and further investigation, with an STR made to the JFIU once ML or TF has been confirmed.
snapshot.tc: 識辨出涉及第三方支付的潛在可疑交易時，應及時作跟進查詢及進一步調查，並在確定涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集後向財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

tested.point: 官方报告制度

snapshot.en: implementing clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, reporting to the Joint Financial Investigation Unit, post-reporting risk mitigation and prevention of tipping off
snapshot.tc: 就內部報告、向財富情報組作出報告、作出報告後如何減低風險及防止通風報訊執行清晰的政策和程序

rows.notes: B21保留官方例题Investigation一词，不以该名称单字设假。详细情报职能只按02来源。

rows.name: 海关及香港警方：冒认网站的报告对象

points: 建议通知公众，并向海关和香港警方报告

tested.point: 明确两报告对象；个人资料私隐专员是错加名单

snapshot.en: If an MSO encounters a suspected fraudulent website related to its own business identity, the circular recommends that the MSO notify the public.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者遇到與其本身業務身分有關的疑似欺詐網站，該通函建議其向公眾發出通知。

snapshot.en: If an MSO encounters a suspected fraudulent website related to its own business identity, the circular recommends reporting it to the C&ED, the Police and the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者遇到與其業務身分有關的疑似欺詐網站，通函建議其向海關、香港警務處及個人資料私隱專員報案。

rows.notes: 仅通知／报告功能；不推断调查分工。

rows.name: 定期申报表：监管用途

points: 掌握行业最新趋势并制定有效适当监管措施，收取币种、司法区及渠道资料

tested.point: 系统提交及新增资料种类

snapshot.en: New periodic returns must be submitted through the MSOS, and C&ED no longer accepts periodic returns submitted in paper form.
snapshot.tc: 新定期申報表須經牌照系統遞交，海關亦不再接受以紙本形式遞交的定期申報表。

snapshot.en: Licensees must give further information in the new return, including the jurisdictions involved in, and the delivery channels used for, remittances.
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在新定期申報表提供額外資料，包括匯款交易所涉司法管轄區及匯款交易使用的交付渠道。

untested.point: 收取新增资料的监管目的：紧贴趋势、制定措施
untested.quote_en: For the purpose of staying abreast of the latest trend in the money service industry and formulating effective and appropriate regulatory measures for the money service business
untested.quote_tc: 為緊貼金錢服務業的最新趨勢並制定有效和適當的金錢服務業務規管措施

rows.notes: 不把附件的金额、比例、期限等普通填报细节加入本专项。

rows.name: 货币兑换商条例：交易单据和汇率展示

points: 兑换服务须注意第34章附表2及3有关交易单据和展示汇率的责任

tested.point: 法例及两类责任

snapshot.en: According to the C&ED's reminder to MSOs, the MCO, Cap. 34, has been amended, with the amended Ordinance in effect from 24 August 2025.
snapshot.tc: 海關提醒金錢服務經營者，《貨幣兌換商條例》（第34章）已於2025年8月24日通過修訂並生效。

snapshot.en: Statutory obligations on transaction notes and rates display, set out in Schedules 2 and 3 to the MCO, are ones that MSOs carrying out money changing services should note.
snapshot.tc: 《貨幣兌換商條例》附表2及3內有關交易單據及展示匯率的法定責任，是經營貨幣兌換服務的金錢服務經營者需留意的。

rows.notes: 归档通函仅提示两类责任，没有完整法例条文；不扩写具体单据格式或豁免。

rows.name: 贸易洗钱、空壳公司及虚假贸易文件

points: 借贸易活动掩饰犯罪得益及转移价值；虚假合同发票造假交易；壳公司掩饰控制者／来源；无实质资产人员业务的新设实体风险

tested.point: 贸易洗钱定义与典型手法

snapshot.en: TBML is the process of disguising the proceeds of crime and moving value through trade activities, in an attempt to legitimise their illegal origins or finance criminal activities.
snapshot.tc: 貿易洗錢為通過利用貿易活動掩飾犯罪得益或轉移價值的過程，以試圖合法化其非法來源，或為其非法活動提供資金。

snapshot.en: Recent TBML typologies involve the use of falsified trade documents, such as fake contracts and invoices, to create bogus transaction records.
snapshot.tc: 近期的貿易洗錢手法涉及使用偽造貿易文件（如假合同及發票），用於製造虛假的交易記錄。

snapshot.en: Domestic and foreign criminal activities would attempt to use shell companies and fabricated documents to obscure the identity of the beneficial owner or the source of illicit funds.
snapshot.tc: 境內外的犯罪活動可能會使用空殼公司及偽造文件來掩飾實益擁有人的身份或非法資金的來源。

snapshot.en: Newly established legal entities without significant assets, employees and/or active business operations pose much higher ML and TF risks, to which MSOs should pay attention.
snapshot.tc: 新成立而缺乏顯著資產、員工，及／或活躍業務運作的法律實體帶來較高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，金錢服務經營者應予注意。

rows.notes: 严格按E32各语言and/or；原文未提供shell company的独立法定定义，不补百科定义。

rows.name: 特別组织：贸易洗钱风险指标的设计者

points: FATF设计风险指标，提升识别贸易洗钱可疑活动能力

tested.point: 将设计者错换JFIU的主体陷阱

snapshot.en: The risk indicators provided to enhance MSOs' ability to identify suspicious activities associated with TBML were designed by the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應參閱由聯合財富情報組設定的風險指標，以加強識別與貿易洗錢相關的可疑活動的能力。

rows.name: 贸易洗钱：高层升级及第一、第二防线

points: 多个风险指标时升报高层；培训／导引支持两道防线风险意识

tested.point: 升报高层及两防线培训

snapshot.en: Where multiple risk indicators are present on customers, the cases should be flagged and escalated to the MSO's senior management.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶出現多項風險指標，金錢服務經營者便應將相關情況作出標記及上報至高級管理層。

snapshot.en: Adequate training and guidance to staff are needed to facilitate sufficient ML/TF risk awareness in both the first and second lines of defence.
snapshot.tc: 需有足夠員工培訓及指導，使第一及第二道防線均具備充足的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險意識。

rows.notes: 19只提防线而未定义各防线成员；完整三道防线职责由02盘点。

rows.name: 特別组织高风险呼吁名单与加强监察名单

points: 高风险EDD、最严重时针对措施；加强监察名单为承诺限期改善者，成员风险分析考虑资料
公开声明要求相称EDD；持续进展名单并非自动强制EDD，但影响客户风险

tested.point: 名单等级、措施、监察资料及本版地区

snapshot.en: The FATF calls on all members and urges all jurisdictions to apply enhanced due diligence to the countries identified as high-risk and, in the most serious cases, countermeasures.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求所有成員及促請所有司法管轄區對被識別為高風險的國家採取更嚴格的盡職審查，並在最嚴重的情況下採取針對措施。

snapshot.en: Besides the DPRK and Iran, Myanmar is also a jurisdiction subject to a FATF call for applying countermeasures to protect the international financial system.
snapshot.tc: 除朝鮮民主主義人民共和國及伊朗外，緬甸亦屬需遵從特別組織要求而採取針對措施的司法管轄區，以免國際金融體系受損。

snapshot.en: The countermeasures listed by the FATF include terminating correspondent relationships with DPRK banks and limiting business relationships with DPRK persons.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織列出的針對措施包括終止與朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的銀行的代理關係，以及限制與朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的人士的業務關係。

snapshot.en: The FATF requires its members to take into account, in their risk analysis, the information in its updated statement on jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 特別組織要求其成員在進行風險分析時，參考其發布的有關被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新聲明所載述的資料。

snapshot.en: MSOs are reminded that two jurisdictions, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Iraq, were newly added to the list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring.
snapshot.tc: 被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新名單加入了兩個司法管轄區，即波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那及伊拉克。

tested.point: 呼吁EDD及关长书面指定针对措施

snapshot.en: EDD measures proportionate to the risks should be applied to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons from jurisdictions for which the FATF calls for this.
snapshot.tc: 對於與來自特別組織對其作出呼籲的司法管轄區的自然人和法人的業務關係及交易，應執行合乎風險比例的更嚴格盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: Where the FATF calls for mandatory EDD or countermeasures, the CCE may, by notice in writing, require MSOs to undertake specific countermeasures described in the notice.
snapshot.tc: 如特別組織呼籲執行更嚴格的盡職審查或採取針對措施，關長可透過書面通知，要求金錢服務經營者採取通知內所述的特定針對措施。

untested.point: 加强监察／持续进展名单不自动强制EDD，仍须纳入整体风险判断
untested.quote_en: conducting EDD is not mandatory for customers connected to jurisdictions listed in the FATF statement: “Improving Global Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (“AML/CFT”) Compliance: On-going Process”.
untested.quote_tc: 對與題為“改善全球打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的合規情況：持續進展”的特別組織聲明所列司法管轄區有關連的客戶採取更嚴格盡職審查措施並非強制性規定。

rows.notes: FAQ采用旧声明标题；与20的新标题对应按功能说明，不杜撰各国最新状态；与02盘点合并。

rows.name: 特別组织建议16修订及支付透明度指引咨询

points: 未来实施加强跨境支付透明度及防诈防错工具
咨询错误支付与校正检查、新支付方式、数据保护及隐私协调

tested.point: 修订方向、未来时间、新支付方式

snapshot.en: The FATF agreed in June 2025 to revise Recommendation 16 so that it keeps pace with changes in the payment landscape.
snapshot.tc: FATF在2025年6月通過修訂第16項建議，使該建議與支付格局的變化同步。

snapshot.en: The revisions increase the transparency of information accompanying cross-border payments and require tools to protect against fraud and error.
snapshot.tc: 第16項建議的修訂將提升跨境支付資訊的透明度，並要求引入防止詐騙及錯誤的工具。

snapshot.en: The end of 2028 is the date by which all jurisdictions around the world are expected to be ready to implement the changes.
snapshot.tc: 全球各司法區預計需在2028年底前，完成實施經修訂的第16項建議所帶來的相關變更。

snapshot.en: Feedback is invited on whether the guidance gives sufficient clarity on how Recommendation 16 applies to digital wallets and mobile money.
snapshot.tc: FATF邀請的意見範圍包括指引是否清晰說明第16項建議如何適用於電子錢包與移動支付等新興支付方式。

untested.point: 咨询亦涵盖落实建议16与数据保护／隐私要求的协调
untested.quote_en: Implementing Recommendation 16 and meeting data protection and privacy requirements together.
untested.quote_tc: 落實第16項建議並同時符合資料保護及隱私的要求。

rows.notes: 仅咨询内容，不是已经生效的额外MSO义务；校正检查细节须另附来源首项目，不从链接抓新材料。

rows.name: 联合国安理会决议2270、巴勒莫公约及FATF全会

points: 制裁与伊朗合规讨论的背景；链接全会成果

rows.notes: 归档只提公约名称、决议及个案背景，无完整公约／决议职权或全会决策机制；不从外链扩写。

rows.name: 资金来源与财富来源

points: 资金来源是特定款项／资产的起源，不止转出地点，包含产生资金的活动
财富来源要求按高风险适用；非每客均须完整调查

tested.point: 二者定义区别、资金产生活动、财富来源适用范围

snapshot.en: Source of wealth refers to the origin of the particular funds or other assets that are the subject of the business relationship between an individual and the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 財富來源是指個人與金錢服務經營者的業務關係中，所涉及的特定資金或其他資產的源頭。

snapshot.en: Source of funds information should not simply be limited to knowing from where the funds may have been transferred, but should also cover the activity that generates them.
snapshot.tc: 追查資金來源時，所得資料不應僅限於了解資金從何轉帳，亦要知悉衍生該等資金的活動。

snapshot.en: Under a risk-based approach, an MSO is required to establish source of wealth in high risk situations, and is not expected to do so for each and every customer.
snapshot.tc: 在風險為本的方法下，金錢服務經營者須在高度風險的情況下確立財富來源，但無須就每名客戶確立財富來源。

tested.point: 第三方高风险应查资金来源而非误换财富来源

snapshot.en: MSOs should apply enhanced scrutiny to third-party payers which might pose higher risks, and establish the source of wealth of the relevant customer or beneficial owner involved in the corresponding transactions.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應對具有較高風險的第三方付款人進行更嚴格的審查，並確立相應交易所涉客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源。

rows.notes: 02有完整SoW定义；非高风险资料深度及数十年前证据属于一般审查比例，不重复计入机构名词缺口。

rows.name: 入境事务处处长及国家机关：身份证明文件签发者

points: 政府／国家签发的身份证、国家主管机关签发的驾照；入境事务处处长签发澳门居民证；海员证按ILO公约签发

tested.point: 入境事务处处长签发澳门居民证、国家驾照与国际驾驶许可证区别

snapshot.en: The Permit for residents of Macau issued by the Director of Immigration and the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents constitute travel documents for identity verification.
snapshot.tc: 由入境事務處處長簽發的澳門居民旅遊證及台灣居民往來內地通行證，均為可作身分核實用途的旅遊證件。

snapshot.en: For a non-resident who is not physically present in Hong Kong, an international driving permit bearing the individual's photograph is acceptable for verifying identity.
snapshot.tc: 至於沒有現身香港的非香港居民，金錢服務經營者可接納附有其照片的國際駕駛許可證，用以核實其身分。

tested.point: 政府签发附照驾驶执照作为来源

snapshot.en: An individual's driving licence, issued to the individual by a governmental body and bearing the individual's own photograph
snapshot.tc: 由政府機構發給個人並載有該名個人本身相片的駕駛執照

rows.notes: 国际劳工组织及1958年海员身份证明公约只用于证件例子，未给机构职能，作为reference关联，不扩展公约内容。

rows.name: 公司注册处：电子公司注册证及记录来源

points: 香港公司注册处可电子签发公司注册证；直接从可靠官网下载文件不再核证
公司须向公司注册处呈交周年申报表等文件

tested.point: 公司注册处官网是可靠来源，电子文件可靠性

snapshot.en: Where the MSO itself downloads a document from a reliable source, such as the Hong Kong Companies Registry's website, instead of receiving a print copy, no corroboration is required.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者自行從可靠的來源（例如香港公司註冊處的網頁）下載文件，而非收取其印刷本，便無須進行核對。

snapshot.en: If a customer cannot produce an original identification document, for example because it is in electronic form, the MSO should take appropriate measures to ensure the reliability of the documents obtained.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶無法出示識別文件的正本（例如正本為電子版本），金錢服務經營者應採取適當措施確保取得的識別文件屬可靠。

tested.point: 周年申报表提交公司注册处

snapshot.en: For a local company applicant, a copy of every annual return it has filed with the Companies Registry since incorporation
snapshot.tc: 如申請人屬本地公司，其自成立以來向公司註冊處存檔的每一份周年申報表的複本

untested.point: 公司注册处是电子公司注册证的签发机关；区别税务局局长的商业登记证
untested.quote_en: an original certificate of incorporation issued by the Hong Kong Companies Registry is available in electronic form.
untested.quote_tc: 由香港公司註冊處發出的公司註冊證書正本可以電子形式出示。

rows.name: 主要营业地点与注册办事处地址

points: 主要营业地点为主要经营／活动所在地，可与注册办事处相同或不同；可靠文件可证明注册地址

tested.point: 法人须取主要营业地点资料

snapshot.en: Principal place of business
snapshot.tc: 主要營業地點

tested.point: 注册地址的可靠来源证明

snapshot.en: A document from a reliable and independent source that includes the registered office address, such as a certificate of incumbency, may be accepted as evidence of it unless the MSO knows it is out of date.
snapshot.tc: 載有註冊辦事處地址的可靠及獨立來源文件（例如職權證明書）可作該地址的證據，除非金錢服務經營者知悉地址不能反映現況。

untested.point: 主要营业地点的实质定义及与注册地址可以相同或不同
untested.quote_en: The “principal place of business” means the location where a legal person primarily operates or the place of its main activities. It can be the same as, or differ from, the address of registered office.
untested.quote_tc: “主要營業地點”指法人營運主要所在地或其主要活動的地點。主要營業地點可與註冊辦事處地址相同或不同。

rows.notes: 仅出现字段名称不能替代定义覆盖；地址异常的查询程序非本次名词核心。

rows.name: 拥有权架构表与中间层公司

points: 架构图便于理解拥有权／控制但非一律必取；识别中间层而非例行逐一核实

tested.point: 图表目的、非硬性及中间层与复杂结构

snapshot.en: Obtaining an ownership chart from the customer is the most convenient way of understanding its ownership and control structure, but there is no strict requirement to obtain one.
snapshot.tc: 向客戶索取擁有權架構表雖是了解其擁有權及控制權結構最方便的方法，但金錢服務經營者並無強制規定要索取。

snapshot.en: Although an MSO needs to identify any intermediate layers, it need not, as a matter of routine, verify the details of the intermediate companies in the ownership structure.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者雖然需要識別任何中介層，但不必把核實擁有權結構內中介層公司的細節列作例行事項。

snapshot.en: Where a customer has a complex ownership or control structure, the MSO should obtain sufficient information to satisfy itself that there is a legitimate reason behind that structure.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶的擁有權或控制權結構複雜，金錢服務經營者應索取足夠資料，從而使本身信納採用該結構具有合法理由。

rows.name: 无拥有权下的最终控制：实益拥有人补充例子

points: 藉与25%以上拥有人的私人关系控制
参与融资、亲密家庭关系、历史／合约联系、违约支付产生控制；实际未行使仍可推定

tested.point: 无资料显示有最终控制人时，不须主动寻找；未测这些具体控制方式

snapshot.en: Where nothing obtained in the CDD process suggests that a person exercising ultimate control over the customer exists, there is no requirement to actively identify such a person.
snapshot.tc: 如在客戶盡職審查過程中所得資料並沒有顯示有人能對客戶行使最終控制權，則無要求積極地識別該人。

untested.point: 融资／家庭／历史或合约联系、支付违约可产生无拥有权控制；无需已实际行使
untested.quote_en: A natural person who exerts control without ownership by participating in the financing of the enterprise, or because of close and intimate family relationships, historical or contractual associations, or if a company defaults on certain payments. Furthermore, control may be presumed even if control is never actually exercised, such as using, enjoying or benefiting from the assets owned by the legal person.
untested.quote_tc: 某自然人透過參與法團融資，或由於密切及親密家庭關係、歷史或合約聯繋，或因某公司違反特定支付約定，而在沒有擁有權下對法團施加控制。此外，有關控制即使從未被實際行使，例如使用、享受或得益於法人擁有的資產，亦可被推定存在。

untested.point: 透过与持有25%以上股份或投票权者的私人关系施加控制
untested.quote_en: A natural person who exerts control of a legal person through means such as personal connections to persons who would be beneficial owners due to owning more than 25% of the shares or voting rights.
untested.quote_tc: 某自然人透過與若干人等的私人關連對法人施加控制，而有關人等因擁有25%以上股份或投票權而成爲實益擁有人。

rows.notes: 私人关系例子是同组来源要点，须与无拥有权控制一并设计；不将实际持股门槛题误当控制方式的覆盖。02／10的BO基本定义须合并。

rows.name: 法人开户代表：授权签署人与董事／实益拥有人

points: 开户代表获董事局决议或类似书面授权；不必是董事或实益拥有人；不必全体董事到场

tested.point: 书面授权、非必须董事／BO、董事不必全部出席、本人核实与风险

snapshot.en: The MSO should verify the authority of each person purporting to act on behalf of the customer by appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution or similar written authorization.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應根據適當的文件證據（例如董事會的決議案或類似書面授權），核實每名看似代表客戶行事的人的授權。

snapshot.en: The Guideline does not mandate that the natural person be a director or a beneficial owner of the customer, so long as that person has been properly authorised to act on the customer's behalf.
snapshot.tc: 《打擊洗錢指引》並沒有強制規定該自然人須為客戶的董事或實益擁有人，只要該自然人已妥善地獲授權代表客戶行事。

snapshot.en: If the business relationship is established through a face-to-face channel, at least two natural persons authorised to establish it should be physically present at the time of account opening.
snapshot.tc: 若業務關係透過面對面的方式建立，至少兩名獲客戶授權建立業務關係的自然人應於開立戶口時現身。

snapshot.en: If the business relationship is established through a non-face-to-face channel, the MSO should mitigate any increased risk, for example by applying additional due diligence measures.
snapshot.tc: 如業務關係透過非面對面的渠道建立，金錢服務經營者仍應減低任何增加的風險，例如執行額外的盡職審查措施。

rows.name: 外语文件译者与可靠翻译来源

points: 不强制专业第三方如律师翻译；MSO取得可靠来源翻译以了解内容

tested.point: 专业第三方非强制及常用翻译工具例子

snapshot.en: There is no requirement that a foreign-language document be translated by a professional third party; the MSO may obtain a translation from a reliable source, such as commonly used translation tools.
snapshot.tc: 現時並無規定以外語書寫的文件須由專業第三方翻譯；金錢服務經營者可透過可靠來源（包括常用的翻譯工具）取得譯本。

rows.notes: 律师在这里是非强制翻译者例子，不据此补法律服务职责。FAQ27身份文件认证的操作范围沿用总体覆盖表，不扩张本专项；认证人职能在02核对。

rows.name: 国际组织、联合国机构与国际组织政治人物

points: 联合国机构属于国际组织
实体由成员国以具有国际条约地位的正式政治协议成立；成员法律承认，非所在国常驻机构单位
不符定义但相似的组织也影响风险判断

tested.point: 联合国机构类别

snapshot.en: Agencies of the United Nations, such as those listed on the UN website, are international organisations for the purposes of establishing PEP status.
snapshot.tc: 就確定政治人物地位而言，聯合國的機構（例如聯合國網站所列者）屬於國際組織。

tested.point: 公职类别、法律承认／非居民机构标准、相似组织与官方例子

snapshot.en: An individual who is or has been entrusted with a prominent function by an international organisation, such as a deputy director or a member of its board, is an international organisation PEP.
snapshot.tc: 在國際組織擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人，包括該組織的副總監或理事會成員等高級管理層成員，屬國際組織政治人物。

snapshot.en: Under the Guideline's definition, international organisations are recognised by law in their member countries and are not treated as resident institutional units of the countries where they are located.
snapshot.tc: 根據指引的界定，國際組織的地位獲成員國的法律認可，而且國際組織不會被視作其所處國家的常駐機構單位。

snapshot.en: If a customer holds a prominent function at an organisation that resembles but does not meet the definition of an international organisation, the MSO should consider whether this impacts the customer's risk profile.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶在與國際組織相似但不符合其定義的組織擔任重要公職，金錢服務經營者應考慮會否影響該客戶的風險狀況。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the International Maritime Organization, the Council of Europe, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and the World Trade Organization.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括國際海事組織、歐洲理事會、北大西洋公約組織及世界貿易組織。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, an economic organisation, and the International Olympic Committee.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括東南亞國家協會及國際奧林匹克委員會等國際組織。

untested.point: 国际组织定义的成立依据：成员国的正式政治协议且具有国际条约地位
untested.quote_en: entities established by formal political agreements between their member States that have the status of international treaties
untested.quote_tc: 由成員國根據具有國際條約地位的正式政治協議成立的實體

rows.notes: 纠正旧覆盖过宽：m6-367#2仅覆盖定义后两部分；解释引文出现全部定义不等于题句已测。与02同定义合并。

rows.name: 政治人物：审批高层的人选与前任身份退出

points: 前任PEP不再高风险且须高层批准才可停止特定EDD；须适当风险评估
MSO按自身组织结构确定有足够资历的审批者，以清晰书面政策列明；职衔人数视规模类型及IRA，可包括海外人员

tested.point: 审批者可在海外；拒绝按固定年限自动不再PEP

snapshot.en: Senior management approving a PEP relationship may include personnel in another jurisdiction, if this reflects the MSO's organisational structure and risk management practices.
snapshot.tc: 如能反映組織結構及風險管理方法，批准與政治人物建立業務關係的高級管理層可包括其他司法管轄區的人員。

snapshot.en: Once a former non-Hong Kong PEP has been out of office for a prescribed length of time, the MSO may stop applying EDD measures to that customer.
snapshot.tc: 前非香港政治人物卸任已滿訂明期間後，金錢服務經營者即可停止對其執行更嚴格的盡職審查措施。

untested.point: 决定不再对前任PEP实施特定EDD，须高层批准且不再构成高风险
untested.quote_en: Such decision can only be made with the approval of the MSO’s senior management and on the basis that the PEP no longer presents a high risk of ML/TF.
untested.quote_tc: 有關決定須獲金錢服務經營者的高級管理層批准，而該政治人物須不再構成高度洗錢/恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

untested.point: MSO以清晰书面政策指明PEP关系审批人，并须具足够资历
untested.quote_en: MSOs should maintain clear and documented policies setting out the persons within the institution who are able to approve PEP customer onboarding and a continued business relationship. In any event, it should only include those with sufficient seniority.
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務經營者應維持有明文依據的清晰政策，列出機構內能夠批准與政治人物客戶建立及維持業務關係的人選。在任何情況下，人選必須具有一定的資歷。

rows.notes: 不是重新补所有PEP程序；只记录谁有权决定及批准角色资格。与02高级管理层／前PEP段落工作包合并。

rows.name: 中介人：执行CDD与持续监察的职责边界

points: 法定依赖中介人机制只适用于第2条CDD，不涵盖第5条持续CDD和交易监察；可代收和更新资料协助MSO

tested.point: 可以通过中介人收集进一步资料及更新

snapshot.en: An MSO may use an intermediary to collect further documents, data and information, and to provide or coordinate updates, to help keep its CDD records up-to-date and relevant.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可藉中介人收集進一步的文件、數據和資料，及提供或協調相關更新，以協助確保其盡職審查紀錄反映現況及仍屬相關。

tested.point: CDD与持续监察区别

snapshot.en: Continuously monitoring a business relationship is a separate duty, and is not one of the measures that the AMLO defines as customer due diligence measures.
snapshot.tc: 持續監察業務關係是另一項獨立的責任，並不屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的客戶盡職審查措施之一。

untested.point: 不得依赖中介人持续监察关系，包括持续CDD和交易监察；代收更新资料不转移监控责任
untested.quote_en: an MSO cannot rely on an intermediary to continuously monitor its business relationships with a customer (i.e., ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring).
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務經營者不能依賴中介人持續監察其與客戶的業務關係（即持續的客戶盡職審查及交易監察）。

rows.notes: 须与02和10的中介人工作包合并，避免把一般可依赖CDD题当作持续监察禁限已有题。

rows.name: 外界人士或内部审核职能：独立核实交易监察

points: 外部人士或内部审计可独立核实；后者须分工、足够专业知识和资源

tested.point: 外部人士或内部审计核实

snapshot.en: The independent validation of the MSO's transaction monitoring systems and processes can be performed by an external party or by its internal audit function.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者的交易監察系統及程序的獨立核實工作，可由外界人士或其內部審核職能執行。

tested.point: 独立审计职能与范围

snapshot.en: An MSO should establish an independent audit function to carry out independent reviews of its AML/CFT Systems
snapshot.tc: 經營者應設立獨立審核職能，以對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度作獨立覆核

snapshot.en: The audit function should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應設有與該經營者高級管理層直接溝通的渠道及途徑

snapshot.en: The audit function should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能應具備充足的專門知識及資源，以使其能夠履行其職責

snapshot.en: The audit function's reviews are carried out under the direction of the Compliance Officer, to whom the function reports
snapshot.tc: 該審核職能的有關覆核在合規主任的指示下進行，並向合規主任作出匯報

rows.name: 跨境付款的六类相关方与制裁筛查

points: 最低限度为汇款人、收款人、汇款机构、中介机构、收款机构、付款讯息具名者

tested.point: 明确测试中介机构及付款讯息具名者

snapshot.en: In a cross-border wire transfer or remittance transaction, the relevant parties to be screened at a minimum include the intermediary institution and the named parties in the payment message.
snapshot.tc: 在跨境電傳轉帳或匯款交易中，金錢服務經營者最低限度應篩查的相關各方，包括中介機構及撥付訊息中被具名的人士。

tested.point: 相关方须执行前筛查，但未枚举类别

snapshot.en: The MSO should screen the relevant parties to a cross-border wire transfer, remittance transactions included, against the current database as soon as practicable once it has executed the transfer.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應在執行跨境電傳轉帳（包括匯款交易）後，在切實可行範圍內盡快根據當時的數據庫對相關各方進行篩查。

untested.point: 最低名单还明确包括汇款人、收款人、汇款机构与收款机构；现有题仅枚举其余两类
untested.quote_en: An MSO should, at a minimum, screen the following relevant parties in cross border / cross boundary wire transfer and remittance transaction: (a) originator; (b) recipient; (c) ordering institution; (d) intermediary institution; (e) beneficiary institution; and (f) named parties (e.g., individuals, companies, banks etc) in the payment message.
untested.quote_tc: 在跨境電傳轉帳或匯款交易中，金錢服務經營者最低限度應篩查以下相關各方：(a) 匯款人；(b) 收款人；(c) 匯款機構；(d) 中介機構；(e) 收款機構；及(f) 撥付訊息中被具名的人士（例如個人、公司、銀行等）。

rows.notes: 角色的电传转帐定义和各机构责任由02／10另盘点。本行只记录筛查名单的实质角色范围；m6-355长引文不能充当未出现于题句的四方已测试证据。

rows.name: 汇款机构：核实汇款人资料与地址用途

points: 已按法例／指引核实身份即视资料准确，通常不再核实但可酌情；地址助辨位置、筛查和AML监察

tested.point: 身份已核实的准确性及是否重查

snapshot.en: The required originator information is deemed to be accurate if the originator's identity has been verified in compliance with the AMLO and the Guideline.
snapshot.tc: 如匯款人的身分已根據《打擊洗錢條例》及《打擊洗錢指引》的規定核實，所需的匯款人資料便視為準確。

snapshot.en: No further verification of the originator information is normally required, although an ordering institution may exercise its discretion to verify it further in individual cases.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，匯款機構無需再進一步核實匯款人資料，但仍可運用酌情權，就個別個案作進一步核實。

tested.point: 地址识别位置及邮政信箱边界

snapshot.en: Address information accompanying a wire transfer or remittance should identify clearly where the parties are, for sanctions screening and AML/CFT monitoring, so a PO box should be avoided unless no alternative exists.
snapshot.tc: 電傳轉帳及匯款交易附隨的地址資料應足以清楚識別各方位置，以便篩查受制裁名單及為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集而監察，故除非別無選擇，應避免以郵政信箱為地址。

points: 邮政署长与MSO同受AMLO法定义务约束；关长是两者的有关当局

untested.point: 邮政署长亦受AMLO法定义务约束；名称虽不是MSO但来源明确列明
untested.quote_en: Money Service Operators (“MSOs”) and the Postmaster General as well as other specified financial institutions.
untested.quote_tc: 金錢服務經營者及郵政署署長，以及其他指定的金融機構需受「打擊洗錢條例」的法律約束。

untested.point: 关长是邮政署长以及MSO在AMLO下的有关当局
untested.quote_en: Who is the relevant authority for the “MSOs” and the Postmaster General under the “AMLO”? A4 The Commissioner of Customs & Excise (“CCE”) is the relevant authority under the “AMLO”.
untested.quote_tc: 在「打擊洗錢條例」下，誰是金錢服務經營者及郵政署署長的有關當局? 答.4 海關關長(「關長」)是「打擊洗錢條例」下的有關當局。

snapshot.en: The licensee must display the original or the copy of the licence in a conspicuous place at the specified premises
snapshot.tc: 持牌人須在指明的處所內的一處顯眼地方，展示該牌照的正本或複本。

snapshot.en: where the premises are domestic premises, the applicant must secured the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for the purpose of exercising the powers as conferred by the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Cap. 615 (AMLO)

snapshot.en: If there is any change in the particulars that are provided to the Commissioner in connection with a licensee’s application for licence or renewal of licence, the licensee must notify the Commissioner in writing of the change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place
snapshot.tc: 如在與持牌人提出的牌照申請或牌照續期申請有關連情況下提供予關長的詳情有改變，該持牌人須在自改變發生之日起計的一個月內，藉書面向關長具報有關改變。

snapshot.en: If a licensee intends to cease to operate a money service, it is required to notify the Commissioner of Customs & Excise in writing of the intention before the date of cessation

snapshot.en: Identifying the customer and verifying the customer’s identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a governmental body
snapshot.tc: 識別客户的身分，及根據政府機構所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實該客户的身分。

snapshot.en: MSO must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者不得開立或維持匿名戶口。

snapshot.en: MSO must continuously monitor the business relationship with a customer by conducting appropriate scrutiny of transactions carried out for the customer to ensure that they are consistent with its knowledge of the customer and the customer’s business and risk profile
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須藉對為客戶執行的交易進行適當的審查，以確保它們符合其對客戶、客戶的業務及風險狀況的認知，以持續監察與客戶的業務關係。

snapshot.en: Before carrying out a remittance transaction involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, MSO must verify the identity of the originator by reference to the originator’s identification document
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者在進行涉及相等於$8,000或以上的款額的匯款交易前，須藉參考匯款人的識別文件，核實匯款人的身分。

snapshot.en: The licensees operating with or without particular premises must maintain a LMO
snapshot.tc: 無論持牌人會或不會在特定處所經營金錢服務，都須維持本地管理辦事處。

snapshot.en: LMO must be staffed by the compliance officer, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處須駐有持牌人的合規主任、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人。

snapshot.en: LMO can be reached in person and through telephone by the C&ED officers
snapshot.tc: 本地管理辦事處可讓海關人員親身前往及以電話聯絡。

snapshot.en: If an MSO licensee fails to maintain the LMO, it may result in the suspension and revocation of the MSO licence.
snapshot.tc: 如金錢服務經營者持牌人未能維持本地管理辦事處，將可能會導致暫時吊銷及撤銷金錢服務經營者牌照。

rows.name: 洗錢（ML）

points: 掩飾可公訴罪行收益的行為
直接／間接及全部／部分收益
境外行為按香港可公訴罪行判定

tested.point: 定義、地域及收益範圍

snapshot.en: The definition of money laundering covers property that represents the proceeds of an indictable offence in part, or indirectly, as well as property that is itself such proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 「洗錢」定義所涵蓋的財產，除本身屬可公訴罪行收益的財產外，亦包括部分或間接代表該等收益的財產。

snapshot.en: Proceeds of conduct that would constitute an indictable offence under Hong Kong law, had it occurred in Hong Kong, can be the subject of money laundering as defined.
snapshot.tc: 作出假使在香港發生即屬犯香港法律所訂可公訴罪行的作為而獲取的收益，亦屬「洗錢」定義所涵蓋的收益。

snapshot.en: The definition of money laundering extends to the proceeds of any offence under the laws of Hong Kong, summary offences as well as indictable ones.
snapshot.tc: 「洗錢」的定義涵蓋干犯香港法律所訂任何罪行而獲取的收益，簡易程序罪行與可公訴罪行同樣在內。

snapshot.en: Under the AMLO, money laundering means any act that has the effect of making the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be such proceeds.
snapshot.tc: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「洗錢」指具有使可公訴罪行收益看似並非該等收益的效果的任何行為。

rows.name: 恐怖分子資金籌集（TF）

points: 提供／籌集財產或金融服務的範圍及主觀狀態
資金可來自合法或非法來源

tested.point: 法定定義及與其他罪行的邊界

snapshot.en: Collecting property knowing that it will be used, in whole or in part, to commit a terrorist act is terrorist financing, whether or not it is actually so used.
snapshot.tc: 知道財產的全部或部分將會用於作出恐怖主義行為而籌集該財產，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集，不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用。

snapshot.en: Providing property by any means, while being reckless as to whether it will be used to commit one or more terrorist acts, is terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 以任何方法提供財產，而罔顧該財產是否會用於作出一項或多於一項恐怖主義行為，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Soliciting financial (or related) services for the benefit of a person, being reckless as to whether the person is a terrorist associate, is terrorist financing.
snapshot.tc: 罔顧某人是否與恐怖分子有聯繫者，而為該人的利益尋求金融（或有關的）服務，即屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Making property available to a person known to be a terrorist is terrorist financing, provided that the property is then used to commit a terrorist act.
snapshot.tc: 明知某人是恐怖分子而向該人提供財產，須該財產其後被用於作出恐怖主義行為，方屬恐怖分子資金籌集。

snapshot.en: Dealing with any property, knowing that it is terrorist property, is one of the acts that the definition of terrorist financing covers.
snapshot.tc: 在知道任何財產屬恐怖分子財產的情況下處理該財產，屬於恐怖分子資金籌集的法定定義所涵蓋的行為之一。

snapshot.en: The meanings of terrorist, terrorist act and terrorist associate in this definition are those given to the terms by the UNATMO.
snapshot.tc: 此定義中的恐怖分子、恐怖主義行為及與恐怖分子有聯繫者，其涵義取自《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》。

tested.point: 合法及非法資金來源

snapshot.en: Whether their funds are from a legitimate or an illegitimate source, terrorist groups must similarly find ways to launder them, to use them unnoticed by the authorities.
snapshot.tc: 不論資金來源是否合法，恐怖分子集團同樣必須尋找清洗資金的途徑，以便在不被當局發現的情況下使用資金。

rows.name: 洗錢的三個階段

points: 存放
分層交易
整合及各階段作用

tested.point: 不只考名稱，也考作用

snapshot.en: Of the three common stages of money laundering, placement is the one at which cash proceeds derived from illegal activities are disposed of into the financial system.
snapshot.tc: 在洗錢的3個常見階段中，「存放」是處置來自非法活動的現金得益並將其注入金融體系的階段。

snapshot.en: Of the three common stages of money laundering, layering is the one at which the impression of apparent legitimacy is created for criminally derived wealth.
snapshot.tc: 在洗錢的3個常見階段中，為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性的，是「分層交易」這一階段。

snapshot.en: In layering, complex layers of financial transactions separate illicit proceeds from their source, so as to disguise where the money came from, subvert the audit trail and provide anonymity.
snapshot.tc: 在分層交易中，複雜多層的金融交易把非法得益與其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源、掩飾審計線索及隱藏擁有人身分。

snapshot.en: Where layering succeeds, integration schemes return the laundered proceeds to the general financial system, where they appear connected to legitimate business activities.
snapshot.tc: 當分層交易的過程成功，整合計劃便把經清洗的得益回流到一般金融體系，令人以為有關收益來自或涉及合法的商業活動。

rows.name: AML/CFT Systems、FI、EDD 等指引用語

points: AML/CFT Systems 是政策、程序及管控措施
FI 通常依 FATF 定義但 AMLO 特指除外
EDD 簡稱；ML/TF 不等於 PF

tested.point: 用語解釋及適用定義

snapshot.en: The Guideline's terms and abbreviations should be read by reference to its Glossary, and other words or phrases, where applicable, as the AMLO sets them out.
snapshot.tc: 本指引的用語及縮寫應參照其詞彙部分的釋義；如適用的話，其他詞語或短語則應按照《打擊洗錢條例》所載列的釋義詮釋。

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the term “AML/CFT Systems” used in the Guideline means AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.
snapshot.tc: 根據詞彙部分，本指引所用的「打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度」指打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施。

snapshot.en: Unless specified otherwise, for example an FI as defined in the AMLO, the Guideline's term “financial institutions” has the same definition as in the FATF Recommendations.
snapshot.tc: 除另有指明外（例如符合《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構），「金融機構」一詞的定義與特別組織建議所載者相同。

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the abbreviation “EDD” used in the Guideline stands for enhanced customer due diligence.
snapshot.tc: 根據本指引的詞彙部分，指引所用的「更嚴格的盡職審查」一詞，其涵義為更嚴格的客戶盡職審查。

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the abbreviation “ML/TF” used in the Guideline stands for money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing.
snapshot.tc: 根據詞彙部分，本指引所用的「洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集」指洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集。

rows.notes: 只記本行明列的用語；其他詞彙表項目在各概念／機構行另查，不以縮寫背誦代替職能覆蓋。

rows.name: 風險為本方法及客戶風險評估

points: 按風險決定措施程度
客戶風險評估不決定是否可免除法定措施
框架與業務性質規模相稱
識別、評估及理解風險；採取相稱措施以管理及減低風險

tested.point: 風險評估的作用與高低風險措施

snapshot.en: The assessment conducted at the initial stage of the CDD process determines whether any statutory CDD measures need to be applied, rather than the extent of the measures to be applied
snapshot.tc: 在客戶盡職審查程序初期所作的評估，決定的是是否需要採取任何盡職審查措施，而非需採取何種程度的盡職審查措施

snapshot.en: The assessment is of no assistance in differentiating between the risks of individual customers and business relationships, since the same CDD measures are applied to every relationship
snapshot.tc: 該評估無助於分辨個別客戶與業務關係所涉的風險，因為每項業務關係均採取相同的盡職審查措施

snapshot.en: An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, an exercise usually referred to as a customer risk assessment
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應評估與客戶或擬開展的業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，這類評估一般稱為客戶風險評估

snapshot.en: Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher, the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased
snapshot.tc: 如與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較高，便需索取數量及類別更多的資料，並以更嚴謹的方式核實資料

snapshot.en: Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower, the information obtained and the extent of its verification may be simplified
snapshot.tc: 如與業務關係有關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較低，金錢服務經營者則可簡化審查程序

tested.point: 框架比例原則

snapshot.en: The MSO should use an RBA in designing its customer risk assessment framework, whose complexity should be proportionate to the nature and size of its business.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應採用風險為本的方法制訂客戶風險評估框架，而框架的複雜程度應與其業務的性質和規模相稱。

tested.point: 一般RBA的識別／評估／理解、相稱措施、管理減低而非消除風險

snapshot.en: An MSO should adopt an RBA in both the design and the implementation of its AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者制訂和執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施時，均應採用風險為本的方法。

snapshot.en: The AML/CFT measures an RBA expects an MSO to take are commensurate with its ML/TF risks and are meant to eliminate those risks.
snapshot.tc: 風險為本的方法預期金錢服務經營者採取與有關風險相稱的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集措施，旨在消除有關風險。

snapshot.en: An RBA lets an MSO apply preventive measures commensurate with the nature and level of risks, so as to focus its AML/CFT efforts most effectively.
snapshot.tc: 風險為本的方法讓金錢服務經營者採取與風險性質及水平相稱的預防措施，以最有效的方式着力於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集工作。

snapshot.en: Jurisdictions, competent authorities, MSOs and their agents are all expected, under an RBA, to identify, assess and understand the ML/TF risks they face.
snapshot.tc: 按風險為本的方法，預期要識別、評估和了解本身所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險者，包括司法管轄區、主管當局、金錢服務經營者及其代理人。

snapshot.en: The institutional ML/TF risk assessment forms the basis of the RBA, enabling an MSO to understand how and to what extent it is vulnerable to ML/TF.
snapshot.tc: 機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估是風險為本方法的基礎，讓金錢服務經營者了解本身如何受到洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的影響及所受影響的程度。

rows.name: 一般／簡化／更嚴格盡職審查與持續監察

points: 盡調措施與持續監察分開
低風險可簡化但非自動豁免
EDD 應合乎比例
持續監察包括持續盡調及交易監察

tested.point: 持續監察不屬法定 CDD 定義

snapshot.en: Continuously monitoring a business relationship is a separate duty, and is not one of the measures that the AMLO defines as customer due diligence measures.
snapshot.tc: 持續監察業務關係是另一項獨立的責任，並不屬《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的客戶盡職審查措施之一。

tested.point: CDD 內容及對象

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by the relevant authority or by any other relevant authority.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據有關當局或任何其他有關主管當局所提供的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO may verify the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by any other source, so long as that source is reliable and independent.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者可根據任何其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料核實客戶的身分，只要該來源屬可靠及獨立即可。

snapshot.en: For any beneficial owner of the customer, the CDD measures call for identifying it and for reasonable measures to verify its identity, so that the MSO is satisfied it knows who that owner is.
snapshot.tc: 就客戶的任何實益擁有人，客戶盡職審查措施規定須識別該實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，使金錢服務經營者信納知道其為何人。

snapshot.en: Where an occasional transaction is to be carried out, the CDD measures include obtaining information on the purpose and intended nature of the transaction, unless they are obvious.
snapshot.tc: 如將執行非經常交易，客戶盡職審查措施包括取得關於該交易的目的及擬具有的性質的資料，但如有關目的及性質屬顯而易見則除外。

tested.point: SDD 的概念及邊界

snapshot.en: Because the extent of CDD measures should be commensurate with the ML/TF risks of a business relationship, an MSO must apply SDD measures in a low risk situation.
snapshot.tc: 盡職審查措施的程度應與洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱，因此在低風險的情況下，金錢服務經營者必須採取簡化盡職審查措施。

snapshot.en: An MSO's assessment that a business relationship or transaction presents low risks should be supported by an adequate analysis of the ML/TF risks by the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者如將業務關係或交易的風險評為低，應輔以其對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的適當分析。

snapshot.en: Once a change in its risk assessment means that the MSO no longer considers there to be a low degree of ML/TF risk, it should not continue to apply SDD measures.
snapshot.tc: 風險評估改變後，如金錢服務經營者判斷洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險已不屬於低，便應停止執行簡化盡職審查措施。

tested.point: EDD 比例及不必逐項照做全部例子

snapshot.en: EDD measures should be applied to an extent that is proportionate, appropriate and discriminating, and that the MSO is able to justify to the CCE.
snapshot.tc: 更嚴格的盡職審查措施的執行程度應合乎比例、適當及因情況而異，金錢服務經營者並應能夠就此向關長提供理據。

snapshot.en: For each business relationship presenting a high risk, an MSO is not expected to carry out every one of the examples of possible EDD measures that the Guideline gives.
snapshot.tc: 就每項可引致高度風險的業務關係而言，金錢服務經營者按期望無需執行指引所列所有可能執行的更嚴格的盡職審查措施的例子。

tested.point: 持續監察的兩個方面

snapshot.en: Ongoing monitoring of a business relationship has three aspects: ongoing CDD, transaction monitoring, and regular screening of the customer against sanctions lists.
snapshot.tc: 持續監察業務關係涵蓋三個方面：持續的盡職審查、監察交易，以及定期根據制裁名單篩查客戶。

rows.notes: 本行只評概念區分；各項義務、例外及最低資料缺口仍見原覆蓋表。

rows.name: 可靠消息來源（credible sources）

points: 有良好聲譽且廣為認可的組織所提供及廣泛公開的資訊
FATF／地區組織及 IMF、世銀、Egmont 等例子

tested.point: 已考 IMF、世銀、Egmont 例子

snapshot.en: The credible sources that identify jurisdictions of greater vulnerability may include the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the Egmont Group
snapshot.tc: 用以識別具有較大漏洞的司法管轄區的可靠消息來源，可包括國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特金融情報組織

untested.point: 來源的可靠性及公開傳播特徵；不能只記機構名單
untested.quote_en: “Credible sources” refers to information that is produced by reputable and universally recognised international organisations and other bodies that make such information publicly and widely available.
untested.quote_tc: 「可靠消息來源」是指由一些有良好聲譽和廣為人知的國際組織及其他組織所提供及廣泛流傳 的資訊。

rows.name: 客戶與交易第三方

points: 客戶是建立業務關係或進行交易的人
一般不包括交易第三方
無其他關係的匯出電匯收款人並非匯款 MSO 的客戶

tested.point: 第三方指客戶以外的人

snapshot.en: A third party means any person other than the customer, and an MSO should exercise care if it suspects that a customer may be effecting a transaction on behalf of one.
snapshot.tc: 「第三方」指客戶以外的任何人；如懷疑客戶可能正為第三方進行交易，金錢服務經營者便應格外留神。

tested.point: 代表公司的人不取代公司作為客戶

snapshot.en: Among the deficiencies found, some MSOs failed to identify the corporate customer and treated the person purporting to act on its behalf as the customer instead.
snapshot.tc: 合規視察發現的缺失或不足之處，包括部分金錢服務經營者沒有識別公司客戶，並把看似代表客戶行事的人當成客戶處理。

untested.point: 匯出電匯收款人沒有其他關係時，不是匯款 MSO 的客戶
untested.quote_en: in an outward wire transfer transaction does not regard the beneficiary (who has no other relationship with the MSO) as its customer.
untested.quote_tc: 例如，在付款電傳轉帳交易中，一間匯款金錢服務經營者 並不會視其收款人（而收款人與金錢服務經營者並沒有其他關係） 為其客戶。

rows.name: 法人（legal person）及法律安排邊界

points: 法人不以是否註冊成立為唯一判斷
自然人以外能建立永久客戶關係或擁有財產的實體
信託及類似法律安排另有盡調框架

tested.point: 法人不以註冊成立為必要條件

snapshot.en: For the purposes of the AMLO's customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements, a body of persons has to be incorporated before it can count as a legal person.
snapshot.tc: 就《打擊洗錢條例》的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定而言，任何團體均須屬法團，方可算是法人。

tested.point: 信託及受託人的不同身分

snapshot.en: If the trustee enters into a business relationship or carries out occasional transactions on behalf of the trust, the MSO should also regard the trustee as its customer, and identify and verify the trustee's identity.
snapshot.tc: 如受託人代表信託建立業務關係或執行非經常交易，金錢服務經營者應把受託人視作客戶，並識別和核實其身分。

snapshot.en: The MSO should identify the settlor, the trustee, any protector or enforcer, the beneficiaries or class of beneficiaries, and any other natural person exercising ultimate control over the trust.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者應識別信託的財產授予人、受託人、保護人或執行人（如有）、受益人或某類別受益人，及任何行使最終控制權的自然人。

untested.point: 法人完整定義的自然人排除及客戶關係／財產條件；只否定必須註冊成立未測這些條件
untested.quote_en: Legal person refers to any entities other than natural person that can establish a permanent customer relationship with an MSO or otherwise own property.
untested.quote_tc: 法人指任何自然人以外能夠與金錢服務經營者建立永久客戶關係或以其他形式擁有財產的實 體，包括公司、法人團體、基金會、機構（anstalt）、合夥、協會或其他相關類似實體。

rows.notes: 法律安排的外文例子 fiducie、treuhand、fideicomiso 為說明例子，不據此要求另背三個名稱。信託定義另列。

rows.name: 信託的定義

points: 明示信託或附具法律約束力文書的類似安排

untested.point: 指引所指信託的定義；既有信託盡調題不等於已考這一定義
untested.quote_en: For the purpose of this guideline, a trust means an express trust or any similar arrangement for which a legal-binding document (i.e. a trust deed or in any other forms) is in place.
untested.quote_tc: 就本指引而言，信託是指明示信託或附有具法律約束力文件(即信託契據或任何其他形式)的 任何類似安排。

rows.notes: m6-344 涵蓋信託盡調，但沒有題句直接判定信託定義。

rows.name: 以專業身分行事的受託人

points: 在包含信託管理服務的行業／業務中管理信託
其書面確認是信託身分核實文件的一個例子

untested.point: 專業身分是按業務服務性質判定，不只是稱為受託人
untested.quote_en: “Trustees acting in their professional capacity” in this context means that they act in the course of a profession or business which consists of or includes the provision of services in connection with the administration or management of trusts (or a particular aspect of the administration or management of trusts).
untested.quote_tc: 「以專業身分行事的受託人」是指他們在包含或包括提供信託管理服務(或某方 面的信託管理服務)的行業或業務的過程中管理信託。

rows.notes: 與認證文件的專業人士資格分開，不把一般受託人一律視為專業受託人。

rows.name: 有關連者（connected parties）

points: 公司董事
合夥人
信託受託人或同等身分
其他實體高層／掌握執行權力者
與客戶／BO／PPTA 身分重疊時另須核實

tested.point: 一般收姓名；公司董事及其他實體高層

snapshot.en: For a customer that is a legal person, the MSO should identify all of the customer's connected parties by obtaining their names and by verifying their identities.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法人的客戶而言，金錢服務經營者應為識別該客戶的所有有關連者，收集其姓名並核實他們的身分。

snapshot.en: For a customer that is a corporation, the connected parties that the MSO should identify by obtaining their names are the customer's directors and its shareholders.
snapshot.tc: 就屬法團的客戶而言，金錢服務經營者應收集其姓名以作識別的有關連者，是該客戶的董事及股東。

snapshot.en: For a legal person customer that is neither a corporation nor a partnership, a connected party means a natural person holding a senior management position or executive authority in it.
snapshot.tc: 就既非法團亦非合夥的法人客戶而言，有關連者指任何為該客戶擔任高級管理職位或掌握執行權力的自然人。

untested.point: 合夥及信託的有關連者分別是合夥人及受託人
untested.quote_en: (b) in relation to a partnership, means a partner of the customer; (c) in relation to a trust or other similar legal arrangement, means a trustee (or equivalent) of the customer;
untested.quote_tc: (b) 就合夥而言，指該客戶的合夥人； (c) 就信託或其他類似法律安排而言，指該客戶的受託人（或同等 身分的人）；

untested.point: 兼屬客戶、BO 或 PPTA 時，須按相應規定識別及核實
untested.quote_en: For the avoidance of doubt, if a connected party also satisfies the definition of a customer, a beneficial owner of the customer or a person purporting to act on behalf of the customer, the MSO has to identify and verify the identity of that person with reference to relevant requirements set out in this Guideline.
untested.quote_tc: 為免生疑問，如有關連者符合客戶、客戶的實益擁有人或看似代表客戶行事的人的定義，則 金錢服務經營者必須參照本指引列載的相關規定，以識別和核實該人的身分。

rows.name: 國際組織的定義（政治人物判斷）

points: 成員國以具國際條約地位的正式政治協議設立
成員國法律認可
不視作所在地常駐機構單位

tested.point: 法律認可、非常駐機構、相似組織及例子

snapshot.en: Under the Guideline's definition, international organisations are recognised by law in their member countries and are not treated as resident institutional units of the countries where they are located.
snapshot.tc: 根據指引的界定，國際組織的地位獲成員國的法律認可，而且國際組織不會被視作其所處國家的常駐機構單位。

snapshot.en: If a customer holds a prominent function at an organisation that resembles but does not meet the definition of an international organisation, the MSO should consider whether this impacts the customer's risk profile.
snapshot.tc: 如客戶在與國際組織相似但不符合其定義的組織擔任重要公職，金錢服務經營者應考慮會否影響該客戶的風險狀況。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the International Maritime Organization, the Council of Europe, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and the World Trade Organization.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括國際海事組織、歐洲理事會、北大西洋公約組織及世界貿易組織。

snapshot.en: The examples of international organisations that the Guideline gives include the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, an economic organisation, and the International Olympic Committee.
snapshot.tc: 指引為識別國際組織政治人物而列出的國際組織例子，包括東南亞國家協會及國際奧林匹克委員會等國際組織。

untested.point: 成員國正式政治協議與國際條約地位的成立條件
untested.quote_en: International organisations referred to in paragraph [4.9.14] are entities established by formal political agreements between their member States that have the status of international treaties;
untested.quote_tc: 第[4.9.14]段所指的國際組織指由成員國根據具有國際條約地位 的正式政治協議成立的實體；

rows.name: 財富來源（SoW）與資金來源（SoF）

points: 財富來源指整體財富；資金來源指關係所涉特定資金
資金來源不只是哪間銀行轉來，還須了解產生資金的活動

tested.point: 財富／特定資金區分及應用範圍

snapshot.en: Source of wealth refers to the origin of the particular funds or other assets that are the subject of the business relationship between an individual and the MSO.
snapshot.tc: 財富來源是指個人與金錢服務經營者的業務關係中，所涉及的特定資金或其他資產的源頭。

snapshot.en: Source of funds information should not simply be limited to knowing from where the funds may have been transferred, but should also cover the activity that generates them.
snapshot.tc: 追查資金來源時，所得資料不應僅限於了解資金從何轉帳，亦要知悉衍生該等資金的活動。

snapshot.en: Under a risk-based approach, an MSO is required to establish source of wealth in high risk situations, and is not expected to do so for each and every customer.
snapshot.tc: 在風險為本的方法下，金錢服務經營者須在高度風險的情況下確立財富來源，但無須就每名客戶確立財富來源。

rows.notes: 主要概念已有直接判斷，不因兩者散在題句和解釋就算缺題。

rows.name: 知悉（knowledge）與懷疑（suspicion）

points: 實際知悉及合理人會推斷／查詢的情況
懷疑較主觀，少於確鑿證據
毋須知道相關罪行性質或證實資金來自罪行

tested.point: 合理查詢、懷疑證據標準及無需證實犯罪所得

snapshot.en: Knowledge is likely to include knowledge of circumstances which would put a reasonable person on inquiry.
snapshot.tc: 一般而言，知悉可能包括知悉某些會令合理的人提出查詢的情況。

snapshot.en: Suspicion is personal and subjective, but it must still rest on proof that is based on firm evidence.
snapshot.tc: 懷疑是個人及較為主觀的，但仍必須有確鑿的證據作為證明。

snapshot.en: A person need not know the nature of the underlying crime to have suspicion, but must know that the funds definitely arose from it.
snapshot.tc: 任何人無需知道相關犯罪活動的性質便可產生懷疑，但須知道資金確實從犯罪而來。

tested.point: 實際知悉及合理人推斷

snapshot.en: For the suspicious transaction reporting regime, knowledge is, generally speaking, likely to include actual knowledge and knowledge of circumstances which would indicate facts to a reasonable person.
snapshot.tc: 就可疑交易舉報制度而言，一般來說，知悉可能包括實際知悉，以及知悉一個合理的人會認為是事實的情況。

rows.name: 恐怖分子財產

points: 恐怖分子或有聯繫者的財產
擬用或曾用於資助／協助恐怖主義行為的其他財產

untested.point: 須理解所有權及用途兩條定義路徑；既有處理禁令題只使用名詞
untested.quote_en: According to section 2 of the UNATMO, terrorist property means the property of a terrorist or terrorist associate, or any other property that is intended to be used or was used to finance or assist the commission of terrorist acts.
untested.quote_tc: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第2條，恐怖分子財產指恐怖分子或與恐怖分子 有聯繫者的財產；或任何擬用於或曾用於資助或協助作出恐怖主義行為的財產。

rows.notes: m1-132、m7-157 考禁令／舉報，但未直接考此詞範圍。

rows.name: 財產（property）

points: 動產與不動產
金錢、土地及相關權益；將來／待確定權益不當然排除

tested.point: 任何財產不只現金

snapshot.en: For this purpose, “any property” includes both movable and immovable property within the meaning of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance, such as money and land.
snapshot.tc: 就這項責任而言，「任何財產」包括《釋義及通則條例》所指的動產及不動產，例如金錢及土地。

tested.point: 將來／待確定利益也包含在內

snapshot.en: Property includes obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit arising out of or incident to money, goods, choses in action or land, if present and vested.
snapshot.tc: 財產包括金錢、貨品、據法權產或土地所產生或附帶的義務、地役權及各類產業、權益及利潤，但以現有的及既有的為限。

rows.name: 客戶識別號碼與交易參考編號

points: 識別匯款人與追蹤交易是不同用途
客戶識別號碼對應發起機構持有紀錄

tested.point: 交易追蹤及持有紀錄的機構

snapshot.en: Any unique reference number that the ordering institution or the beneficiary institution assigns in place of an account number should permit traceability of the wire transfer.
snapshot.tc: 匯款機構或收款機構在沒有戶口號碼時所編配的獨特參考編號，應可用作追蹤有關的電傳轉帳。

snapshot.en: A customer identification number for the originator must refer to a record held by the beneficiary institution containing at least one of: the customer address, identification document number, or date and place of birth.
snapshot.tc: 匯款人的客戶識別號碼，必須參照由收款機構持有、最少載有客戶地址、識別文件號碼或出生日期及地點其中一項的紀錄。

untested.point: 客戶識別號碼與獨特交易參考編號不同，不可互換其意義
untested.quote_en: Customer identification number refers to a number which uniquely identifies the originator to the originating institution and is a different number from the unique transaction reference number referred to in paragraph [10.7].
untested.quote_tc: 客戶識別號碼指用作識別就發起機構而言屬匯款人的獨特號碼，與第[10.7]段所述的獨特交易 參考編號並不相同。

rows.name: 非電匯匯款交易的匯款人

points: 從其戶口付款者；無戶口時才是發出指示者
非電匯匯款與電傳轉帳制度分開

tested.point: 非電匯與電匯的制度區分

snapshot.en: A remittance transaction differs from a wire transfer, and for a transaction that is a wire transfer the MSO should have regard to the Guideline's wire transfer chapter in meeting the special requirements for wire transfers.
snapshot.tc: 匯款交易與電傳轉帳是不同的；如交易是電傳轉帳，金錢服務經營者在遵守電傳轉帳的特別規定時，應顧及指引第10章關於電傳轉帳的導引。

untested.point: 非電匯匯款人的戶口持有人優先／無戶口才看指示者
untested.quote_en: Pursuant to the AMLO, an originator of a remittance transaction is the person from whose account with the MSO the money for the remittance is paid; or in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the MSO to carry out the remittance transaction.
untested.quote_tc: 根據打擊洗錢條例，匯款交易的匯款人是指該人在金錢服務經營者開立 戶口，而該項交易所涉金錢，是自該戶口匯出的；或如沒有此戶口，匯 款交易的匯款人是指示金錢服務經營者進行該項交易的人。

rows.notes: m3-292#4 測的是電匯匯款人，不能直接視為已測非電匯情境；與源10同一定義合併。

rows.name: 通風報訊（tipping off）

points: 可能妨礙調查的披露
已內部報告但未交 JFIU 也適用
真誠查詢不等同通風報訊
知道或懷疑已曾作出披露是罪行條件

tested.point: 定義適用範圍及善意查詢邊界

snapshot.en: Telling a customer that a report has been made would prejudice the investigation, and an offence would be committed.
snapshot.tc: 如有人告知客戶已作出報告，這會影響調查工作，因而已屬犯罪。

snapshot.en: The tipping-off provision covers a suspicion raised internally within an MSO that has not yet been reported to the JFIU.
snapshot.tc: 通風報訊的條文包括已於金錢服務經營者內部提出懷疑，但尚未報告財富情報組的情況。

snapshot.en: Making enquiries to customers, when conducted properly and in good faith, will not constitute tipping off.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者憑誠信適當地向客戶作出詢問，並不構成通風報訊。

untested.quote_en: A person commits an offence if, knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made, he discloses to any other person any matter which is likely to prejudice any investigation which might be conducted following that first-mentioned disclosure.
untested.quote_tc: 任何人如知道或懷疑已曾作出披露，而仍向其他人披露任何相當可能損害為跟進首述披露而進行的調查的事宜，即屬犯罪。
untested.point: 知道或懷疑已曾作出披露這一主觀條件，尚未直接考查

rows.notes: 遵守既定W10；不重判m7-158#1原有具體告知場景，這裡記錄較完整罪行定義的缺口。

rows.name: 針對性金融制裁

points: 資產凍結及禁止直接／間接向被指認者提供資金或資產

tested.point: 兩部分的定義

snapshot.en: Targeted financial sanctions cover asset freezing and prohibitions on making funds or other assets available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities.
snapshot.tc: 針對性金融制裁一併指凍結資產，以及禁止為被指認的個人及實體的利益而直接或間接提供資金或其他資產。

rows.name: 擴散資金籌集（PF）及大規模毀滅武器服務

points: PF 指大規模毀滅武器擴散的資金籌集
WMD相關服務及財務資助範圍
ML/TF縮寫與PF分開

tested.point: 懷疑涉及PF的服務禁制

snapshot.en: The WMD(CPS)O prohibits providing any services where the provider believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that they may be connected to PF.
snapshot.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》禁止任何人提供任何基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關的服務。

tested.point: 發展、生產、取得、貯存、投射及財務資助

snapshot.en: Services that will or may assist in developing, producing, acquiring or stockpiling weapons of mass destruction fall under the WMD(CPS)O's control.
snapshot.tc: 將會或可能協助發展、生產、取得或貯存大規模毀滅武器的服務，受《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》管制。

snapshot.en: Services that will or may assist the means of delivery of weapons capable of causing mass destruction are also within the WMD(CPS)O's control.
snapshot.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》亦管制將會或可能協助可造成大規模毀滅的武器的投射工具的服務。

snapshot.en: Under the WMD(CPS)O, the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance is included in the provision of services, which is widely defined.
snapshot.tc: 根據《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》，提供服務的定義廣泛，借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助亦包括在內。

tested.point: ML/TF不能直接等同含PF

snapshot.en: According to the Glossary, the abbreviation “ML/TF” used in the Guideline stands for money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing.
snapshot.tc: 根據詞彙部分，本指引所用的「洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集」指洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集。

rows.notes: 題干m1-131也展開PF全稱；本行列已考的服務與資助範圍，不宣稱涵蓋歸檔以外的完整國際PF定義。

rows.name: 旅遊證件的定義

points: 附照片並能確定身分及國籍、原居地或永久居留地
符合資格的證件例子

tested.point: 澳門居民旅遊證及台灣居民往來內地通行證

snapshot.en: The Permit for residents of Macau issued by the Director of Immigration and the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents constitute travel documents for identity verification.
snapshot.tc: 由入境事務處處長簽發的澳門居民旅遊證及台灣居民往來內地通行證，均為可作身分核實用途的旅遊證件。

untested.quote_en: Travel document means a passport or some other document furnished with a photograph of the holder establishing the identity and nationality, domicile or place of permanent residence of the holder.
untested.quote_tc: 旅遊證件是指附有持有人照片，能確定持有人的身分及國籍、原居地或永久居留地的護照或其他證件。
untested.point: 一般定義的照片及身分／國籍／居留地條件，尚未直接測試

rows.notes: 與總體表G072合併；其餘文件種類不逐種湊題。

rows.name: 特許秘書的認證資格

points: ICSA或其指定分部的現任正式會員

rows.notes: 認證人資格的低優先說明；可在綜合題選用，不要求單獨背機構縮寫或擴充機構職權。依歸檔稱呼，不聲稱機構名稱為官網最新版本。

reference_points.quote_en: A chartered secretary refers to a person who is a current full member of the Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators or its designated divisions.
reference_points.quote_tc: 特許秘書指屬英國特許秘書及行政人員公會或其指定分部現任正式會員的人。

rows.name: 保密號碼戶口

points: 用編號／代號取代日後文件的客戶姓名
不等於匿名戶口或免做CDD

tested.point: 仍須識別及核實，後續識別方式不同

snapshot.en: The MSO must verify the identity of a numbered account's customer and make it known to a sufficient number of staff, even though such an account offers additional confidentiality.
snapshot.tc: 金錢服務經營者須核實保密號碼戶口客戶的身分，並讓相當數目的職員知悉，即使這類戶口可加強保障客戶機密亦然。

snapshot.en: Where later documentation substitutes a number or code name for the customer's name, wire transfers and remittances from the numbered account must still reflect the holder's real name.
snapshot.tc: 保密號碼戶口其後的文件雖以戶口號碼或代號取代客戶姓名，但其電傳轉帳和匯款服務仍須顯示戶口持有人的真實姓名／名稱。

rows.name: 指引中 must／should 的效力

points: 兩者在本指引所述制度中均表示強制性規定

tested.point: 不把should誤作隨意遵守

snapshot.en: Where the Guideline uses “should” in relation to an action, consideration or measure, it indicates a mandatory requirement, as it does when it uses “must”.
snapshot.tc: 本指引提及行動、考慮或措施時採用「應／應該」字詞，與採用「須／必須」一樣，均表示該項屬強制規定。

rows.notes: 此為本指引明定的用語規則，不能概括成所有英文文件的should都等於must。

rows.name: DTROP／OSCO 的基本用途

points: DTROP調查懷疑販毒所得資產
OSCO限制／押記／沒收犯罪收益及可公訴罪行收益洗錢罪

tested.point: 兩條例的資產處理及罪行用途

snapshot.en: The OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to issue restraint orders and charging orders over the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法院司法管轄權，就被控觸犯該條例所指罪行的被告人的財產發出限制令及押記令。

snapshot.en: Under the OSCO, the Courts are given jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes, among other matters.
snapshot.tc: 除其他事項外，《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法院司法管轄權，沒收來自有組織及嚴重罪行的得益。

snapshot.en: One of the offences that the OSCO creates is an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences.
snapshot.tc: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》所增訂的罪行之一，是一項有關來自可公訴罪行得益的洗錢罪行。

snapshot.en: Assets that are suspected to be derived from drug trafficking activities may be investigated under provisions that the DTROP contains.
snapshot.tc: 涉嫌從販毒活動所得的資產，可根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》所載的條文進行調查。

rows.notes: 本行列基本用途對照；OSCO向法院提供資料以判斷加重刑罰的細節見RG015。

rows.name: UNATMO／UNSO／WMD(CPS)O 的不同用途

points: UNATMO防止恐怖主義及境外恐怖作戰資金籌集
UNSO實施聯合國制裁
WMD(CPS)O控制可能協助大規模毀滅武器的服務，包括財務資助

tested.point: 反恐條例目的及外國作戰資金籌集

snapshot.en: A decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) on preventing travel for the purpose of terrorist acts or terrorist training is further implemented by the UNATMO.
snapshot.tc: 安理會第2178 (2014)號決議有關防止為恐怖主義行為或恐怖主義培訓而進行旅程的決定，亦由《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》進一步實施。

snapshot.en: The UNATMO is principally directed towards implementing UNSCR decisions that seek to prevent the financing of terrorist acts and to combat the threat of foreign terrorist fighters.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》旨在實施安理會的相關決定，以防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金，並減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員的威脅。

snapshot.en: What the UNATMO implements is not limited to the mandatory elements of the relevant UNSCRs; it includes the more pressing elements of the FATF Recommendations specifically related to TF.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》所實施的並不限於安理會相關決議中的強制性措施，特別組織建議中明確與恐怖分子資金籌集有關且較具逼切性的部分亦在其內。

tested.point: UNSO及WMD法例的目的和範圍

snapshot.en: In Hong Kong, it is under the UNSO that most of the United Nations Security Council Resolutions (UNSCRs) are implemented.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國制裁條例》是香港實施大部分聯合國安全理事會（安理會）決議所依據的條例。

snapshot.en: The UNSO provides for the imposition of sanctions arising from Chapter 7 of the Charter of the United Nations.
snapshot.tc: 《聯合國制裁條例》訂定條文，就施加因《聯合國憲章》第七章所引起的制裁作出規定。

snapshot.en: Services that will or may assist in developing, producing, acquiring or stockpiling weapons of mass destruction fall under the WMD(CPS)O's control.
snapshot.tc: 將會或可能協助發展、生產、取得或貯存大規模毀滅武器的服務，受《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》管制。

snapshot.en: Services that will or may assist the means of delivery of weapons capable of causing mass destruction are also within the WMD(CPS)O's control.
snapshot.tc: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》亦管制將會或可能協助可造成大規模毀滅的武器的投射工具的服務。

snapshot.en: Under the WMD(CPS)O, the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance is included in the provision of services, which is widely defined.
snapshot.tc: 根據《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》，提供服務的定義廣泛，借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助亦包括在內。

rows.notes: 各機關訂規例、指定和特許權另見RG009–RG015，不能用基本法例用途題頂替具體權限。
